# **Best Pharma Franchise Company in India**

Algen Healthcare is one of the highly recongized ISO certified pharma company that offers best
quality pharmaceutical products for franchise business and third party manufacturing services. The
company work under the norms set by the (WHO) World Health Organisation and (GMP) Goods
Manufacturing Practice which enables us to match the global standard of the products and company.

ideal platform to get effective medicines for some special ranges. Our all products are widely

#### Molecule Highlights
* Molecule
  
  Jul. 6, 2026
  
  [Travere’s dual ETA/AT1 Antagonist, Sparsentan, Becomes First FDA-Approved Treatment for FSGS][34]
  [
  ][35]
  
  Sparsentan (Filspari®) is an orally bioavailable, dual ETA/AT1 antagonist that became the first
  FDA-approved therapy for FSGS in April 2026, adding to its 2024 approval as a
  non-immunosuppressive treatment for IgAN. Marketed by Travere Therapeutics, sparsentan was
  originally discovered by Bristol Myers Squibb as a potential treatment for hypertension before
  being repurposed for proteinuric glomerular diseases. By simultaneously blocking ETA and AT1
  signaling, sparsentan reduces proteinuria through complementary effects on intraglomerular
  pressure, vasoactive signaling, and glomerular injury.
  
  [

* Molecule
  
  Jul. 2, 2026
  
  [Amgen’s First-in-Class C5aR1 Antagonist for Vasculitis Hits Regulatory Headwinds Years After
  Approval][37]
  [
  ][38]
  
  Avacopan (Tavneos®), a first-in-class oral C5aR1 (C5a receptor 1) antagonist discovered at
  ChemoCentryx, has an uncertain future following the FDA’s request for its withdrawal from the
  market. After gaining approval for the treatment of ANCA-associated vasculitis in 2021, Amgen
  acquired the rights to the molecule in its $3.7B acquisition of ChemoCentryx. This case study will
  dive into the complement system and its role in AAV, avacopan’s path to FDA approval, and the
  precarious situation the drug currently faces.
* Molecule
  
  Jul. 1, 2026
  
  [Novel NRTTI Islatravir Receives FDA Approval in Combination with Doravirine for Chronic HIV as
  Idvynso®][39]
  [
  ][40]
  
  Islatravir is a novel NRTTI anti-HIV therapy that is active against drug-resistant HIV strains and
  selective against human DNA polymerase. Islatravir’s novel mechanism of action arises in part due
  to its 4’-ethynyl group, which prevents HIV reverse transcriptase from translocating, leading to
  inhibition of viral DNA synthesis. Low-dose islatravir in combination with doravirine met the
  primary endpoints in two non-inferiority Ph. 3 trials versus Biktarvy® and cARTs, leading to the
  approval of a one-pill, once-daily oral combination in April 2026 as Idvynso®.

## More Articles
* Article
  
  Jun. 30, 2026
  
  [May 2026 Patent Gazette][41]
  [
  ][42]
  
  This month’s Patent Highlights spotlight emerging strategies for difficult intracellular disease
  biology. Featured disclosures include Dewpoint’s β-catenin condensate modulators for Wnt-driven
  cancers, Merck’s tau-binding AUTACs for autophagy-mediated clearance of pathological tau, and
  Janssen’s BFL-1 inhibitors targeting an underexplored anti-apoptotic resistance node in
  hematologic malignancies. Together, they highlight the expansion of small molecule drug discovery
  into condensate biology, targeted autophagy, and apoptosis-pathway resistance.

Jun. 29, 2026

[Boron Neutron Capture Therapy: Precision Radiation With Targeted Delivery][52]
[
][53]

BNCT (boron neutron capture therapy) is a binary radiotherapeutic modality in which tumor-localized
¹⁰B captures thermal neutrons to generate short-range, high-LET particles that selectively kill
cancer cells while largely sparing surrounding tissue. By combining localized irradiation with
tumor-selective targeting, BNCT may improve tolerability relative to conventional radiotherapy.
Advances in accelerator-based neutron sources enabled the first approved BNCT therapy in Japan in
2020, and next-generation boron delivery systems may further expand the therapeutic potential of
BNCT.

# INNOVATIVE FORMULATIONS FOR ICONIC BRANDS

Formulation development and product manufacturing services for premium food, wellness and healthcare
brands.

[Explore][6]

## OUR VISION

Our vision is to drive innovation in formulation science by developing cutting-edge, sustainable
solutions that meet the evolving needs of industries and consumers. We prioritise flexibility in our
approach, ensuring our products and processes are adaptable, environmentally responsible, and
forward-thinking.

Our commitment to innovation and excellence drives us to push the boundaries of formulation science,
delivering unparalleled solutions to meet the evolving needs of our clients.

[Read More][7]
[formulation-excellence-line.webp]

## OUR SERVICES

Helping Big & Small Brands Innovate Faster.

### FORMULATION DEVELOPMENT

Our formulation development service combines scientific expertise with advanced research to deliver
bespoke, high-performance solutions. Whether you need to optimise an existing formulation or create
an entirely new product, we provide efficient, sustainable results tailored to your specific
requirements. From concept to final product, we ensure every formulation meets regulatory standards
and market demands.

[Chemical.webp]
[Formulation.webp]

### PRODUCT MANUFACTURING

With a reliable supply of premium raw materials, our certified, state-of-the-art facilities
manufacture products and ingredients to the highest standards of quality, safety, and consistency.
We continually invest in cutting-edge technology and expand our production capacity to meet evolving
market demands. Collaborating closely with clients, we tailor production processes to meet exact
specifications, delivering exceptional results every time.

### SAFETY &
### QUALITY ASSURANCE

Our rigorous quality control measures and unwavering commitment to compliance enable us to uphold
the highest industry standards, ensuring the safety and efficacy of the products we help bring to
market. From sourcing raw materials to final production, every step is carefully monitored, ensuring
that we deliver products of exceptional quality that customers can trust.

[FE.webp]
[RESPONSIBLE-SOURCING-FORMULATIONEXCELLENCE1.webp]

## WHY CHOOSE US

A Commitment to Innovative Formulation Development

As a leading formulation development and manufacturing company, we are committed to innovation at
every stage of the process. We work closely with trusted, transparent suppliers, ensuring full
traceability and ethical sourcing. Our dedication to sustainability is at the heart of everything we
do, from using eco-friendly ingredients to implementing responsible production practices that
respect nature. With a passion for quality and a forward-thinking approach, we create
high-performance products that not only meet market demands but also contribute to a more
sustainable future.

# Advancing world-class nanoscience research

The International Institute for Nanotechnology represents and unites more than $2.7 billion in
nanoscience research, educational programs, and supporting infrastructure.

As the first and largest institute of its kind in the United States, the IIN brings together
exceptional researchers across multiple disciplines to make groundbreaking scientific and
technological advances.

[Learn more about us][33]

News

### Three Leaders Honored with 2025 Kabiller Prize and Awards

[Read more][34]

### IIN Remembers Mark Ratner

[Read more][35]

### IIN’s Materials Discovery Work Meets Illinois’ Quantum Moment

[Read more][36]

### Northwestern researchers crack a long-standing problem in catalyst design

[Read more][37]

[See All News][38]
Our work

# Transformative research

Nanotechnology has the potential to dramatically improve the lives of people across the world. For
example, researchers at the IIN have developed diagnostic tests that can be used to detect harmful
viruses, bacteria, and genetic mutations, with greater sensitivities and selectivities than ever
before; organic solar cells that achieve incredible efficiencies; smart materials that remove
pollutants from drinking water; and many other astonishing systems enabled by nanotechnology.

From electronics and energy to therapeutics and biomaterials, the future is happening right now in
nanoscience research.

Our People

# Extraordinary people

Led by Chad Mirkin, the IIN has a deep talent pool of more than 230 affiliated faculty members from
35 departments across four schools at Northwestern University.

With insights from the forward-thinking business leaders on the IIN’s Executive Council and Steering
Committee, and support from an outstanding group of administrators, this is a unique and fertile
ground for collaboration and discovery.

  # Welcome To Kreative Organics
  
  ### Quality. Value. Delivered.
  
  [About us][1]

### Welcome to Kreative Organics

Kreative Organics Private Limited is a manufacturer of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
the world market. Kreative started operations in 1990.

Kreative was established by Dr. S. Krishnamohan. Dr. Krishnamohan was formerly with TIFR, BARC,
Caltech and NASA. He is a scientist of international repute and runs Kreative with professionalism
and a focus on innovation.

Kreative maintains strict quality standards and has developed a robust quality system around which
all of our products are manufactured.

[Read More][2]
[kreative-organics]

### The Management Team & Board

###### Dr. S Krishnamohan

Chairman of the Board and Managing Director

Dr. S. Krishnamohan founded Kreative Organics in 1990. Prior to promoting this company Dr. S.
Krishnamohan worked as a scientist with highly reputed institutions like the Tata Institute of
Fundamental Research (TIFR) in Bombay, the California Institute of Technology in Pasadena and NASA,
USA. Apart from bringing him international reputation, the work as a scientist has sharpened his R&D
acumen. This helped tremendously in making Kreative an R&D focused company.

###### Ravi Seelamsetty

Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Ravi Seelamsetty is an enthusiastic and seasoned organization builder with strong leadership,
operations and sales skills. Ravi has vast strategic sales experience and has lead sales and
marketing teams in both the US and India. Ravi has a bachelor’s degree from Osmania University,
Hyderabad and a master’s degree from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor.

###### Bala Bhaskara Rao Tummala

Chief Operating Officer (COO)

Bala Bhaskar holds a Master’s Degree in Science (Org. Chemistry). He has about 21 years of vast
experience in the pharmaceutical industry. He has versatile experience in all facets of Phamra
industry ranging from Research and Development (R&D), Project Development , Execution to Commercial
closures, Business Development responsibilities include all new products, in-licensing and
alliances, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain managements, Imports and
Exports. He is a certified Independent auditor for Quality Control & Regulatory Affairs. Prior to
joining Kreative Organics in 2017, Mr. Bala Bhaskara Rao was the Managing Director of M/s Kalvik
Laboratories Private Limited, API Manufacturing Facility located in Hyderabad.

###### Prasad Kandasani

General Manager- Regulatory Affairs

Prasad Kandasani is a post graduate in chemistry with specialization of Foods, Drugs and
Wateranalysis from Andhra University Campus. He has 14 years of professional experience in the field
ofquality assurance and regulatory affairs functions in high profile pharmaceutical industries.
Prior toKreative Organics, he was associated with Dr. Reddy’s, Watson Pharma Private Limited, Sai
LifeSciences and Hetero Labs Limited.His professional expertise includes strategic drug development
concepts fulfilling both traditionaland enhanced approaches, regulatory change management, ensure
customer delight by providingon-time support, high quality regulatory drug mater files submissions
to various regulatory agencieslike USFDA, TGA, Health Canada, EDQM and other EU regional
countries.He is familiar for application of current regulatory concepts as part of organizational
integral qualityand regulatory strategies for faster approval of dependent drug submissions.
* #### Large formulator in the US Kreative Organics has been an excellent partner as we look to
  #### expand our product list in the US. They have sound regulatory experience and have been
  #### extremely timely in their support.
* #### Leading trader in South America Great people to work with. Always deliver on time.
* #### Leading trader in the US Kreative Organics has been supportive of all of our customers needs.
  #### All of the customers that we have brought to visit the plant are extremely happy with plant.
  #### We will continue to work with them to identify new opportunities for growth.

With a commitment to sustainability, Nanoform aims to revolutionize drug formulation processes, making them more efficient and environmentally friendly.

# small is powerful^{Ⓡ}

*NanoImprove* the performance of your small- and large-molecule formulations — from early
development through to lifecycle management — by enabling higher drug loads in smaller tablets, in
subcutaneous injections, and alternative delivery formats.

## We can NanoImprove your Medicine:

[
][122]
[gSmall Molecules Logo]

## Small molecules

Achieve improved bioavailability, higher drug loading and novel drug delivery for your small
molecule therapeutics, enabled by best-in-class nanotechnology, expert formulation and scalable GMP
supply.

[ Learn more about
Nanoform Small Molecules ][123]
[
][124]

## Biologics

Achieve higher drug loading, long acting delivery and alternate routes of administration for your
proteins, peptides and bio formulations with unique bio nanoparticles that enable superior
performance.

[ Learn more about
Nanoform Biologics ][125]
[
][126]

## Formulation

Deliver optimized formulation and enable more acceptable tablet regimens, and alternative delivery
routes including subcutaneous and long-acting injectables, and inhaled dose forms.

[ Learn more about
Nanoform Formulation ][127]
[
][128]

## GMP Manufacturing

Reliable clinical- and commercial-scale GMP supply of nanoformed API through a scalable and green
process, including high potency handling.

[ Learn more about
Nanoform GMP Manufacturing ][129]
Previous 1 2 3 4 5 6 Next
[ Play ][130]

## Nanoforming Biologics & GLP-1s: From I.V. to Sub Q & Inhaled Delivery

Designing the most patient-centric and effective treatment options are key for those pharmaceutical
companies developing and marketing high value biological therapies. Nanoforming biologics and
peptides simplifies dose regimens and unlocks new delivery routes to enhance patient comfort,
compliance and reduce healthcare costs.

[ Learn more ][131]

## Improving bioavailability

Many of the latest generation of small molecule drugs in development exhibit increased molecular
weights and lipophilicity. Today’s novel, complex molecules present not only biopharmaceutical
challenges such as poor solubility and bioavailability, but also handling and manufacturing
challenges.

[ Learn more ][132]

## Enabling Subcutaneous Delivery for Improved Patient Compliance & Healthcare System Efficiencies

Nanoform Biologics’ high-dose subcutaneous delivery platform represents a significant advancement in
the field of biologics.

[ Learn more ][133]

## Expanding Opportunities for Inhaled Drug Delivery

Whether to treat localised respiratory disease, or because the lung provides a fast, non-invasive,
and efficient route of delivery for systemic effect, the administration of pharmaceuticals to the
lung is gaining increased attention; even beyond treatments for globally prevalent diseases like
asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

 

[ Play ][134]

## An overview of Nanoform’s Development Capabilities

Video showcases Nanoform’s state-of-the-art development capabilities, led by our Chief Commercial
Officer, Christian Jones.

[ Play ][135]

## An overview of Nanoform’s Manufacturing Capabilities

Video showcases Nanoform’s state-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities, led by our Head of
Manufacturing, Dr David Rowe.

## Nanoform Biologics

Nanoform Biologics can deliver your large molecule products in more stable powdered forms, as high
concentration injections, or for inhaled delivery.

[ Learn more about Nanoform Biologics ][136]

# small is powerful^{Ⓡ}

*NanoImprove* the performance of your small- and large-molecule formulations — from early
development through to lifecycle management — by enabling higher drug loads in smaller tablets, in
subcutaneous injections, and alternative delivery formats.

## We can NanoImprove your Medicine:

[
][122]
[gSmall Molecules Logo]

## Small molecules

Achieve improved bioavailability, higher drug loading and novel drug delivery for your small
molecule therapeutics, enabled by best-in-class nanotechnology, expert formulation and scalable GMP
supply.

[ Learn more about
Nanoform Small Molecules ][123]
[
][124]

## Biologics

Achieve higher drug loading, long acting delivery and alternate routes of administration for your
proteins, peptides and bio formulations with unique bio nanoparticles that enable superior
performance.

[ Learn more about
Nanoform Biologics ][125]
[
][126]

## Formulation

Deliver optimized formulation and enable more acceptable tablet regimens, and alternative delivery
routes including subcutaneous and long-acting injectables, and inhaled dose forms.

[ Learn more about
Nanoform Formulation ][127]
[
][128]

## GMP Manufacturing

Reliable clinical- and commercial-scale GMP supply of nanoformed API through a scalable and green
process, including high potency handling.

[ Learn more about
Nanoform GMP Manufacturing ][129]
Previous 1 2 3 4 5 6 Next
[ Play ][130]

## Nanoforming Biologics & GLP-1s: From I.V. to Sub Q & Inhaled Delivery

Designing the most patient-centric and effective treatment options are key for those pharmaceutical
companies developing and marketing high value biological therapies. Nanoforming biologics and
peptides simplifies dose regimens and unlocks new delivery routes to enhance patient comfort,
compliance and reduce healthcare costs.

[ Learn more ][131]

## Improving bioavailability

Many of the latest generation of small molecule drugs in development exhibit increased molecular
weights and lipophilicity. Today’s novel, complex molecules present not only biopharmaceutical
challenges such as poor solubility and bioavailability, but also handling and manufacturing
challenges.

[ Learn more ][132]

## Enabling Subcutaneous Delivery for Improved Patient Compliance & Healthcare System Efficiencies

Nanoform Biologics’ high-dose subcutaneous delivery platform represents a significant advancement in
the field of biologics.

[ Learn more ][133]

## Expanding Opportunities for Inhaled Drug Delivery

Whether to treat localised respiratory disease, or because the lung provides a fast, non-invasive,
and efficient route of delivery for systemic effect, the administration of pharmaceuticals to the
lung is gaining increased attention; even beyond treatments for globally prevalent diseases like
asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

 

[ Play ][134]

## An overview of Nanoform’s Development Capabilities

Video showcases Nanoform’s state-of-the-art development capabilities, led by our Chief Commercial
Officer, Christian Jones.

[ Play ][135]

## An overview of Nanoform’s Manufacturing Capabilities

Video showcases Nanoform’s state-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities, led by our Head of
Manufacturing, Dr David Rowe.

## Nanoform Biologics

Nanoform Biologics can deliver your large molecule products in more stable powdered forms, as high
concentration injections, or for inhaled delivery.

[ Learn more about Nanoform Biologics ][136]

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Nanoform is a cutting-edge pharmaceutical company specializing in the enhancement of small and large molecule formulations through its innovative nanoforming technology. The company focuses on improving drug delivery and efficacy by enabling higher drug loads in smaller tablets, catering to the needs of the pharmaceutical industry from early development to lifecycle management. With a commitment to sustainability, Nanoform aims to revolutionize drug formulation processes, making them more efficient and environmentally friendly.

## 125 Years of Driving Innovation

From developing precise atomic clocks to creating encryption standards to supporting manufacturing,
NIST plays a crucial role in *advancing technology.*

## What we do

From nanoscale devices that power the most advanced microchips to earthquake-resistant skyscrapers,
NIST’s measurements and research fuel innovation and improve the quality of life for all Americans.
We provide support and resources to U.S. manufacturing, helping to grow our economy and ensure our
national security.

Discover how our work makes America safer, healthier and more prosperous.

## 125 Years of Driving Innovation

From developing precise atomic clocks to creating encryption standards to supporting manufacturing,
NIST plays a crucial role in *advancing technology.*

## What we do

From nanoscale devices that power the most advanced microchips to earthquake-resistant skyscrapers,
NIST’s measurements and research fuel innovation and improve the quality of life for all Americans.
We provide support and resources to U.S. manufacturing, helping to grow our economy and ensure our
national security.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

modify, rectify, limit, delete and ask, if any, the portability of your personal data as well as a
right of opposition, if necessary subject to legitimate and imperative reasons, to the processing of
such data. You may also define guidelines for the use of your personal data in the event of death.

If you wish to exercise this option or if you have any questions regarding our [General Terms and
Conditions of Use, Privacy and Cookies Policy][100], please contact Aptar at:

Suche

Unser Antrieb

Ein besseres Leben für Millionen von Menschen

Mit unseren Produkten helfen wir mit, die Gesundheit von Millionen von Menschen zu schützen und
ermöglichen Betroffenen mehr Lebensqualität. «Innovating for a better life» lautet die Devise, nach
welcher rund 13'000 Gerresheimer Mitarbeitende auf drei Kontinenten täglich entwickeln und mit hoher
industrieller Kompetenz und Schlagkraft produzieren.

Nachhaltigkeit

Nachhaltigkeit auf allen Stufen

Bis 2030 bezieht Gerresheimer Strom nur noch aus erneuerbaren Energiequellen und senkt seine
CO2-Emissionen bis 2030 um 50%. Diese ambitionierten Nachhaltigkeitsziele setzen wir uns, weil wir
der festen Überzeugung sind, dass nur verantwortungsvoll und nachhaltig agierende Unternehmen eine
Zukunft haben.

Exzellente Leistung

Benchmark für Qualität

Qualität steht bei Gerresheimer an erster Stelle – als täglich gelebte Philosophie und Verpflichtung
unseren Kunden gegenüber. Unter Einsatz modernster Technologien stellen wir sicher, dass unsere
Produkte höchste Hygiene- und Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen und strengsten gesetzlichen Vorgaben
entsprechen.

Globale Ausrichtung

Global tätig und nah bei den Kunden

Gerresheimer entwickelt und produziert in 39 Produktionsstandorten in Europa, Amerika und Asien. Wir
kennen die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und die Märkte. So finden wir schneller die richtigen Lösungen
und können eine nachhaltige und umweltgerechte Produktion mit hoher Wertschöpfung an den einzelnen
Standorte sicherstellen.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Integral Biosystems is a drug delivery company specializing in the development of biocompatible formulations and complex dosage forms tailored for ophthalmic applications. Their innovative products, such as the NanoM Wafer™ Ocular Insert and OcuHeal™ LNP, enhance drug bioavailability and provide sustained release, targeting pharmaceutical companies and researchers in the ophthalmology sector. Additionally, they offer comprehensive Contract Research Organization (CRO) services, delivering high-end R&D support for various dosage forms to clients ranging from start-ups to large pharmaceutical firms.

# History, Business Model & Mission

# About Integral BioSystems | Biosystems Solutions

## Company Vision and Business Model

### Who We Are

Integral BioSystems is a drug delivery company developing complex dosage forms.

Founded in 2009 and fully operational in 2011, Integral BioSystems is situated in 10,000 square feet
of customized laboratory and office space at 23 Crosby Road, Suite 100A, Bedford, MA 01730. We are a
fully outfitted development and process engineering laboratory with an established [Quality
policy][73]. We have a quality system that can address both R&D and cGLP activities. Thus, we can be
nimble and flexible performing R&D exploratory and early development of dosage forms, as well as
establish a well-documented program for cGLP studies.

### What We Do

Our expertise is in drug delivery, in the development of biocompatible formulations that are
compatible with physiological fluids and tissues.

We have expertise in ophthalmic, oral, sublingual, intranasal, inhalation, otic, rectal, vaginal,
IV/IM and transdermal routes.

Integral BioSystems has a translational medicinal approach to drug development, customizing delivery
systems to accomplish the biologically effective objectives of the therapy.

Delivery systems are customized to achieve sustained release or targeted, tissue-focused delivery or
fast-release/instant delivery, depending upon the desired product attributes. We scale-up our
formulations to process engineering principles to develop process controls. We work with start-ups,
small companies and large pharma, whether it is to manage and develop the program from
“soup-to-nuts”, or take on projects to be an “extended R&D arm” for an established company.

# History, Business Model & Mission

# About Integral BioSystems | Biosystems Solutions

## Company Vision and Business Model

### Who We Are

Integral BioSystems is a drug delivery company developing complex dosage forms.

Founded in 2009 and fully operational in 2011, Integral BioSystems is situated in 10,000 square feet
of customized laboratory and office space at 23 Crosby Road, Suite 100A, Bedford, MA 01730. We are a
fully outfitted development and process engineering laboratory with an established [Quality
policy][73]. We have a quality system that can address both R&D and cGLP activities. Thus, we can be
nimble and flexible performing R&D exploratory and early development of dosage forms, as well as
establish a well-documented program for cGLP studies.

### What We Do

Our expertise is in drug delivery, in the development of biocompatible formulations that are
compatible with physiological fluids and tissues.

We have expertise in ophthalmic, oral, sublingual, intranasal, inhalation, otic, rectal, vaginal,
IV/IM and transdermal routes.

Integral BioSystems has a translational medicinal approach to drug development, customizing delivery
systems to accomplish the biologically effective objectives of the therapy.

Delivery systems are customized to achieve sustained release or targeted, tissue-focused delivery or
fast-release/instant delivery, depending upon the desired product attributes. We scale-up our
formulations to process engineering principles to develop process controls. We work with start-ups,
small companies and large pharma, whether it is to manage and develop the program from
“soup-to-nuts”, or take on projects to be an “extended R&D arm” for an established company.

## Specific Expertise

Integral BioSystems has specific expertise in [ophthalmic drug delivery][74], known as one of a
handful of CROs working in the field. We have worked on both back-of-the-eye and front-of-the-eye
indications.

Additionally, we are experts in [injectables][75], whether these are injections, infusions and
sustained release. We are experts in [microencapsulate][76]– and [nanocrystal-based delivery][77]
systems, taking the API from analytical development, pre-formulation and formulation prototype
development.

## Hybrid Business Model

Integral BioSystems has established our credibility in industry as a top-notch CRO
(fee-for-service). In addition, we have an out-licensing model. We have two proprietary drug
delivery systems that can be evaluated with your API for improved performance (**NanoM™, OcuHeal™**)

[Integral BioSystems Hybrid Business Model]

## Our Mission

Integral BioSystems mission as a **Contract Research Organization** (CRO) is to provide quality,
[high-end R&D and cGLP technical services][78] in specialty formulation development services for a
variety of dosage forms.

In our mission to “**Innovate to Improve**”, we have developed and patented two [proprietary
platform delivery systems][79] that can be applied with various APIs, routes and indications.

We have developed the [OcuHeal™ technology][80], developed for bioavailability enhancement. We have
developed the [NanoM Wafer™ technology][81] to provide sustained release technologies for use in
ophthalmology, urology and other tissue types. These technologies are patented, and are available
for licensing for development with your API.

## Collaborate with us

Whether you are looking to accelerate drug development with a CRO, collaborate with a technology
partner to develop innovative drugs, or license technologies for bioavailability enhancement or
sustained release, Integral BioSystems is here to help you advance your goals. Harness our expertise
for your next breakthrough. Contact us today!

## Contact us

To contact us about a project, please include a brief summary of your specific needs with your
email. Our company representative will call you back within the next business day.

## ABOUT LATITUDE

**LATITUDE** employs a wide armamentarium of techniques and technologies, many of which are unique
and proprietary, to address insolubility, instability, poor absorption, vein irritation, large/bulky
doses, lack of IP protection and other formulation challenges over a wide range of pharmaceutical
dosage forms.

**LATITUDE** also develops state-of-the-art drug delivery systems as proprietary platform
[formulation technologies][46], including our PG Depot™ injectable depots and our Nano-E™
nano-emulsions. Latitude makes these technologies available to our clients to improve the efficacy,
safety, and overall therapeutic value, as well as establish new intellectual property, for their
drug compounds.

[**LATITUDE Pharmaceuticals Inc.**][47]** is a leading-edge formulation development CRO/CMO that
provides innovative drug formulation development services.**

These services include NCE, 505(b)(2) and generic drug formulation development, proprietary drug
delivery systems, and GLP/GMP manufacture and analytical testing to the human and veterinary
pharmaceutical industries. Since our founding in 2003, we have performed over 1,100 formulation
development projects for over 250 client companies and have developed a global reputation for
creative approaches, reliability, rapid turnaround, [successful formulations][48] and client
satisfaction.

**LATITUDE’s** focus is on the special challenges of formulation development for compounds that are
highly insoluble, highly unstable, and/or have poor bioavailability. This focus has made
**LATITUDE** a specialist with the experience and track record to tackle the toughest formulation
challenges for problematic drug candidates. **LATITUDE** is fully capable of handling controlled
substances (Schedule I-V).

In addition, **LATITUDE** applies its own technologies to develop improved formulations of existing
drugs that can be developed as accelerated-approval 505(b)(2) NDA candidates. [Contact LATITUDE
][49]for more information on these 505(b)(2) [Licensing Opportunities.][50]

In servicing the formulation challenges of biotech and pharmaceutical companies, **LATITUDE** has
grown by **building a strong repeat business while providing excellent services to our clients.**

## ABOUT LATITUDE

**LATITUDE** employs a wide armamentarium of techniques and technologies, many of which are unique
and proprietary, to address insolubility, instability, poor absorption, vein irritation, large/bulky
doses, lack of IP protection and other formulation challenges over a wide range of pharmaceutical
dosage forms.

**LATITUDE** also develops state-of-the-art drug delivery systems as proprietary platform
[formulation technologies][46], including our PG Depot™ injectable depots and our Nano-E™
nano-emulsions. Latitude makes these technologies available to our clients to improve the efficacy,
safety, and overall therapeutic value, as well as establish new intellectual property, for their
drug compounds.

[**LATITUDE Pharmaceuticals Inc.**][47]** is a leading-edge formulation development CRO/CMO that
provides innovative drug formulation development services.**

These services include NCE, 505(b)(2) and generic drug formulation development, proprietary drug
delivery systems, and GLP/GMP manufacture and analytical testing to the human and veterinary
pharmaceutical industries. Since our founding in 2003, we have performed over 1,100 formulation
development projects for over 250 client companies and have developed a global reputation for
creative approaches, reliability, rapid turnaround, [successful formulations][48] and client
satisfaction.

**LATITUDE’s** focus is on the special challenges of formulation development for compounds that are
highly insoluble, highly unstable, and/or have poor bioavailability. This focus has made
**LATITUDE** a specialist with the experience and track record to tackle the toughest formulation
challenges for problematic drug candidates. **LATITUDE** is fully capable of handling controlled
substances (Schedule I-V).

In addition, **LATITUDE** applies its own technologies to develop improved formulations of existing
drugs that can be developed as accelerated-approval 505(b)(2) NDA candidates. [Contact LATITUDE
][49]for more information on these 505(b)(2) [Licensing Opportunities.][50]

In servicing the formulation challenges of biotech and pharmaceutical companies, **LATITUDE** has
grown by **building a strong repeat business while providing excellent services to our clients.**

applied drug. **Within two weeks, LATITUDE developed a new formulation with the needed release and
bioavailability parameters.** **LATITUDE’s** novel formulation development resulted in a
first-in-class therapeutic for which marketing approval was rapidly granted by the FDA.

### Rapid development strategy for insoluble cytotoxic cancer compounds

**LATITUDE’s IV nanoemulsion platform technology (Nano-E)** is ideal for formulating a wide variety
of insoluble and difficult-to-formulate compounds. **A key benefit of this formulation is the
reduction of injection-site toxicity for a wide variety of irritating compounds.** When **LATITUDE**

**In human studies, a client recently showed the new formulation was bioequivalent to the existing

now seeking marketing approval for the formulated compound under a 505(b)(2) NDA.

### Improving the safety of an animal tox formulation

A client needed new formulation development for a toxicity evaluation because the intrinsic toxicity
of a co-solvent in the original formulation potentially could confound the study. Much time had been
lost with the old formulation and time was of the essence. **Within 2 weeks, LATITUDE devised a new
cremophor-free/polysorbate-80-free formulation that allowed the toxicological assessment of client’s
API to** **proceed without the use of these toxic co-solvents.**

### Sustained release
### depot gel

A major marketing advantage for subcutaneously/intramuscularly injected peptides, proteins and small
molecule would be to change from multiple injections to a once-a-day or once-a-week format. To
address this opportunity, LATITUDE has developed a proprietary gel depot system, made from GRAS
excipients, that has near first-order release kinetics and no burst release. In several animal
models, the depot has demonstrated proof of concept as a sustained release delivery system for
various large and small molecules, and has been shown to be safe in Phase 1 clinical trials.

Several clients have licensed or are now planning feasibility studies for applications of the gel
technology encompassing cardiovascular, pain management, and hospital therapeutics.

### Topical steroid

A specialty pharma client needed topical formulation development to substitute a currently marketed
solvent-based topical product known to cause dry skin and eczema. To address the dry skin side
effect of the commercial product, **LATITUDE developed an equivalent and stable solvent-free aqueous
formulation using LATITUDE’s proprietary Nano-E technology platform.** The aqueous formulation was
evaluated for efficacy with in-vivo animal models and subsequently in humans.

### Development of a topical formulation vehicle for combination drugs

A specialty pharma client needed topical combination drug formulations for two drugs that were
incompatible in aqueous and alcoholic solvents. **LATITUDE** developed a non-aqueous technology for
the topical delivery of water-sensitive active ingredients that does not use alcohols, surfactants
or strong solvents, which are known to cause contact dermatitis when used in topical formulations.
**A leading anti-psoriasis drug molecule was put into this formulation and multiple stability
studies showed LATITUDE’s topical formulation was much more stable than the Reference List Drug.**
Additionally, the **LATITUDE formulation achieved the same skin permeation as the RLD in drug
delivery studies.**

### Change the dosing paradigm and reduce needlesticks with the PG Depot™ formulation

A pharma company requested **LATITUDE** to develop an improved formulation for its peptide drug that
was being injected once or twice daily to control blood glucose in adults with type 2 diabetes. To
address this challenge, **LATITUDE** incorporated the peptide into its **PG Depot™** to create a new
sustained release formulation that reduced the injection frequency from once or twice daily to only
once per week. **Reducing the injection frequency created a paradigm shift in the dosing frequency
and a potential key competitive advantage over drugs in this category.** PK studies in a diabetic
rat model confirmed the no-burst, peakless, near zero-order, and sustained release kinetics for this
peptide from the PG Depot™.

## Three platforms.
## One mission.

Our proprietary delivery architectures are designed to be modular — adaptable to diverse payload
classes, administration routes, and therapeutic contexts without reengineering from scratch.

LNP-X4

### LNP-X4 Lipid Nanoparticle Platform

Precision intracellular delivery

mRNA TherapeuticsGene SilencingOncology

Our proprietary ionizable lipid formulation achieves >87% encapsulation efficiency across mRNA,
siRNA, and small molecule payloads. The PEGylation surface chemistry extends circulation half-life
to 18–24 hours while reducing immunogenic clearance by 63%.

Particle Size
78–94 nm
Encapsulation
>87%
Half-life
18–24 h
PMR-7

### PMR-7 Polymeric Matrix Release

Sustained zero-order kinetics

Chronic PainCNS DisordersOcular Delivery

PLGA-based microsphere architecture engineered for programmable release profiles spanning 14–180
days. The hydrolytic degradation pathway eliminates retrieval procedures, and pH-responsive shell
layers enable targeted gastrointestinal delivery.

Release Duration
14–180 days
Loading Efficiency
>91%
Size Range
10–500 μm
ADC-Link

### ADC-Link Antibody Conjugation

Tumor-selective payload deposition

Solid TumorsHematological CancersRare Disease

Site-specific cysteine conjugation technology with a drug-to-antibody ratio of 3.8 ± 0.4. The
cleavable valine-citrulline linker releases cytotoxic payload exclusively in lysosomal pH
environments, limiting off-target exposure to <0.3% of administered dose.

The Science

## Delivery is the
## *therapeutic*.

The pharmacological activity of a drug is only as good as its ability to reach the target tissue at
therapeutic concentration. We believe drug delivery engineering is not a formulation afterthought —
it is the central design variable that determines clinical success.

Our platforms are built around three first principles: **selectivity** (getting the payload to the
right cell type), **kinetics** (releasing it at the right rate), and **scalability** (manufacturing
at GMP standards from early IND through commercial supply).

Payload-agnostic architecture
Small molecules, biologics, nucleic acids, peptides
Proprietary safety engineering
Reduced off-target exposure by design, not by chance
Translational pharmacokinetics
In vitro–in vivo correlation validated across 6 species
Leadership

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Aveva Drug Delivery Systems specializes in developing precision delivery platforms that enhance the efficacy of therapeutics by ensuring targeted delivery with optimal release kinetics and safety profiles. The company offers three proprietary technology platforms—LNP-X4, PMR-7, and ADC-Link—designed for various applications, including oncology, chronic pain, and CNS disorders, with a robust pipeline of clinical programs aimed at addressing significant medical needs. With over 340 active patents and a commitment to innovation, Aveva is dedicated to advancing drug delivery solutions that improve patient outcomes.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Dds Drug, a division of NOF CORPORATION, specializes in providing innovative drug delivery systems and high-purity materials tailored for the pharmaceutical and biomedical industries. Their product offerings include activated PEGs, phospholipids, ultrapure excipients, and novel excipients designed to enhance drug formulation stability, catering primarily to pharmaceutical manufacturers and developers. With a commitment to advancing healthcare, Dds Drug focuses on delivering high-quality solutions that support the development of effective therapeutic products.

Activated PEG for
PEGylation

We manufacture high-purity methoxy-polyethylene glycols (mPEGs) with molecular weights from 2kDa to 80kDa, producing high-purity activated PEG derivatives of methoxy PEG amines, maleimides and carboxylic acids. Various alterations of the terminal PEG chemistry permit drug modification as per customers’ expectations and needs. Recently, we have developed high purity monodisperse PEGs especially for Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs) to increase hydrophilicity and payload of drugs.

Phospholipids and Lipids for

LNP and Liposome

In early 1990’s, we commenced supply of GMP-grade phospholipids to every corner of the world. Our products have been used in commercialized liposomal drugs for anti-fungal and oncology use, which led to our outstanding reputation in this field. Furthermore, use of PEGylated phospholipids composed of our high-purity phospholipids and PEGs prolongs the plasma circulating half-life of liposome drugs. For the benefit of our customers, we have also developed high-purity cationic lipids, diacylglycerol-PEGs and novel SS-cleavable/pH-responsive lipids for effective Lipid Nanoparticle (LNP) delivery of gene, nucleic acids and small molecule.

Ultrapure Polysorbate 80

Our polysorbate, Polysorbate 80 (HX2)™, is used as ultrapure surfactants, and we are proud that it is well-known around the world to have super high quality. Polysorbate 80 (HX2)™ has fewer impurities compared to conventional grade products.

Polysorbate 80 (HX2)™ features low impurities and low susceptibility to oxidation thereby contain negligible amounts of peroxides and aldehydes, which are well-known to induce degradation of drug formulations.

Polysorbate 80 (HX2)™ also shows superior safety features, including a lower incidence of allergic, hemolytic, cytotoxic and acute toxicity reactions compared to conventional grade products.

MORE

Novel Excipients for

Pharmaceutical Development

Using high-purity oleic acid, we produce the nonionic surfactant (NOFABLE™ Series) and its derivatives. Since impurities derived from oxidation are eliminated in our process for the product, formulations employing NOFABLE™ surfactant show lower degradation rates of drug substances and improved drug product stability.

We also provide a cell-modifying agent that acts without exerting any injurious effects on the cells. Employment of the BAM concept contributes to both modification of the cells or tissue surfaces with physiologicaly active substances, such as proteins or drugs, and live cell immobilization of cells or tissues on the surfaces of various kinds of materials without any damage to the target cells and tissues.

# About us

Nacamed AS is an innovative pharmaceutical company focused on developing new drugs to address unmet
medical needs. At the core of our technology lies a proprietary process for producing
commercial-scale, tailor-made porous silicon-based nanoparticles designed for drug delivery and
controlled hydrogen delivery.

Nacamed is a spin-off company of Dynatec AS. During the last decade the two companies have
investigated in the production of Silicon particles, and have acquired unique competency.

Nacamed integrates this technical knowledge with pharmaceutical industry expertise to pioneer a new
generation of clinical treatment methods.

### Nacamed - Research and Development

Nacamed has own laboratories with relevant laboratory equipment including several HPLC systems. The
Company also have extensive collaborations with both academic institutions and pharmaceutical
companies in Norway and abroad.

### IP Strategy

Nacamed has an active IP strategy and has filed several patent applications. Some of these patent
families have been published.

[WO2022223822][23] (Nacamed) Silicon particles for drug delivery. International patent application.
Published 27102022.

[WO2022223821][24] (Nacamed) Silicon particles for hydrogen release. International patent
application. Published 27102022.

[ Contact US ][25]

### Publications

Nacamed has also an active publication strategy. One of Nacameds key employees (Hennie Marie
Johnsen) performed her dissertation for Ph.D in 2025 in collaboration with Institute of Pharmacy,
University of Oslo. Several of Nacameds publications are available in this site and in the open
scientific publication databases.

# About us

Nacamed AS is an innovative pharmaceutical company focused on developing new drugs to address unmet
medical needs. At the core of our technology lies a proprietary process for producing
commercial-scale, tailor-made porous silicon-based nanoparticles designed for drug delivery and
controlled hydrogen delivery.

Nacamed is a spin-off company of Dynatec AS. During the last decade the two companies have
investigated in the production of Silicon particles, and have acquired unique competency.

Nacamed integrates this technical knowledge with pharmaceutical industry expertise to pioneer a new
generation of clinical treatment methods.

### Nacamed - Research and Development

Nacamed has own laboratories with relevant laboratory equipment including several HPLC systems. The
Company also have extensive collaborations with both academic institutions and pharmaceutical
companies in Norway and abroad.

### IP Strategy

Nacamed has an active IP strategy and has filed several patent applications. Some of these patent
families have been published.

[WO2022223822][23] (Nacamed) Silicon particles for drug delivery. International patent application.
Published 27102022.

[WO2022223821][24] (Nacamed) Silicon particles for hydrogen release. International patent
application. Published 27102022.

[ Contact US ][25]

### Publications

Nacamed has also an active publication strategy. One of Nacameds key employees (Hennie Marie
Johnsen) performed her dissertation for Ph.D in 2025 in collaboration with Institute of Pharmacy,
University of Oslo. Several of Nacameds publications are available in this site and in the open
scientific publication databases.

# Leadership

## The Chairman of the Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology

Mr. Thilan Wijesinghe is a prominent figure in Sri Lanka’s business and technology landscape,
currently serving as the Chairman of the Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology (SLINTEC). A seasoned
professional with a diverse background in finance, investment, and strategic leadership, Mr.
Wijesinghe brings a wealth of experience to his role at the helm of the nation’s foremost
nanotechnology research institute.

His academic credentials include degrees in Industrial Engineering and Economics from Cornell
University, USA, and a degree in Business Administration from the State University of New York at
Fredonia. This strong educational foundation has been a cornerstone of his multifaceted career.

Mr. Wijesinghe has a distinguished track record of leadership in both the public and private
sectors. He is the Founder and Executive Chairman of TWC (Pvt) Ltd, a corporate finance and
investment advisory firm. His career has been marked by several pioneering achievements, including
co-founding Asia Capital PLC, which rose to become a leading investment bank in Sri Lanka.

Notably, Mr. Wijesinghe holds the distinction of being the youngest-ever Chairman and
Director-General of the Board of Investment (BOI) of Sri Lanka. During his tenure, he played a
pivotal role in attracting significant foreign direct investment to the country and driving key
infrastructure development projects.

His entrepreneurial spirit is further evidenced by his involvement in co-founding and leading
several successful ventures across various sectors, including technology, leisure, and real estate.
His leadership at SLINTEC is characterized by a strong focus on driving the commercialization of
research and fostering innovation to contribute to Sri Lanka’s economic growth. Mr. Wijesinghe is
committed to positioning SLINTEC as a global leader in nanotechnology research and development,
fostering strategic collaborations, and translating cutting-edge scientific advancements into viable
commercial applications.

#### **Professor Ilmi Hewajulige**

**Chief Executive Officer (Covering)**

Professor Ilmi Hewajulige is a distinguished research scientist and executive leader with over 30
years of extensive experience in postharvest biology, food technology, and supply-chain management.
Currently serving as the Director General and CEO of the Industrial Technology Institute (ITI), she
brings a wealth of strategic expertise to SLINTEC to drive forward Sri Lanka’s scientific and
industrial landscape.

**Executive Summary**

Throughout her career, Professor Hewajulige has been at the forefront of Research and Development
(R&D) in Sri Lanka. She has successfully led multidisciplinary teams of over 350 scientists,
engineers, and technologists across diverse sectors, including Biotechnology, Food, Herbal, and
Environmental Technologies. Her career is defined by a commitment to bridging the gap between
laboratory innovation and commercial application, providing critical advisory services to the
industry on product development, technology transfer, and quality management.

##### **Professional Experience**

Professor Hewajulige’s leadership journey is rooted in a deep technical foundation at the
**Industrial Technology Institute (ITI)**:
* **Director General / CEO** – ITI (Current)
* **Additional Director General (R&D) & Research Professor** – 6 years
* **Director / Senior Director (Food Technology Section)** – 6 years
* **Senior Research Officer** – 17 years
* **Assistant Lecturer** – Faculty of Agriculture, University of Peradeniya

##### **Academic & Research Excellence**

A scholar of international standing, Professor Hewajulige has contributed significantly to the
global scientific community through over 100 scientific communications and 25+ peer-reviewed papers.
* **PhD in Postharvest Biology** – University of Colombo, Sri Lanka
* **MPhil in Postharvest Biology & Technology** – University of Colombo, Sri Lanka
* **BSc (Hons) in Agriculture** – University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka
* **International Research Fellowships:** * University of California, Davis, USA (Mann Lab)
* National Food Research Institute (NFRI), Tsukuba, Japan

# Leadership

## The Chairman of the Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology

Mr. Thilan Wijesinghe is a prominent figure in Sri Lanka’s business and technology landscape,
currently serving as the Chairman of the Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology (SLINTEC). A seasoned
professional with a diverse background in finance, investment, and strategic leadership, Mr.
Wijesinghe brings a wealth of experience to his role at the helm of the nation’s foremost
nanotechnology research institute.

His academic credentials include degrees in Industrial Engineering and Economics from Cornell
University, USA, and a degree in Business Administration from the State University of New York at
Fredonia. This strong educational foundation has been a cornerstone of his multifaceted career.

Mr. Wijesinghe has a distinguished track record of leadership in both the public and private
sectors. He is the Founder and Executive Chairman of TWC (Pvt) Ltd, a corporate finance and
investment advisory firm. His career has been marked by several pioneering achievements, including
co-founding Asia Capital PLC, which rose to become a leading investment bank in Sri Lanka.

Notably, Mr. Wijesinghe holds the distinction of being the youngest-ever Chairman and
Director-General of the Board of Investment (BOI) of Sri Lanka. During his tenure, he played a
pivotal role in attracting significant foreign direct investment to the country and driving key
infrastructure development projects.

His entrepreneurial spirit is further evidenced by his involvement in co-founding and leading
several successful ventures across various sectors, including technology, leisure, and real estate.
His leadership at SLINTEC is characterized by a strong focus on driving the commercialization of
research and fostering innovation to contribute to Sri Lanka’s economic growth. Mr. Wijesinghe is
committed to positioning SLINTEC as a global leader in nanotechnology research and development,
fostering strategic collaborations, and translating cutting-edge scientific advancements into viable
commercial applications.

#### **Professor Ilmi Hewajulige**

**Chief Executive Officer (Covering)**

Professor Ilmi Hewajulige is a distinguished research scientist and executive leader with over 30
years of extensive experience in postharvest biology, food technology, and supply-chain management.
Currently serving as the Director General and CEO of the Industrial Technology Institute (ITI), she
brings a wealth of strategic expertise to SLINTEC to drive forward Sri Lanka’s scientific and
industrial landscape.

**Executive Summary**

Throughout her career, Professor Hewajulige has been at the forefront of Research and Development
(R&D) in Sri Lanka. She has successfully led multidisciplinary teams of over 350 scientists,
engineers, and technologists across diverse sectors, including Biotechnology, Food, Herbal, and
Environmental Technologies. Her career is defined by a commitment to bridging the gap between
laboratory innovation and commercial application, providing critical advisory services to the
industry on product development, technology transfer, and quality management.

##### **Professional Experience**

Professor Hewajulige’s leadership journey is rooted in a deep technical foundation at the
**Industrial Technology Institute (ITI)**:
* **Director General / CEO** – ITI (Current)
* **Additional Director General (R&D) & Research Professor** – 6 years
* **Director / Senior Director (Food Technology Section)** – 6 years
* **Senior Research Officer** – 17 years
* **Assistant Lecturer** – Faculty of Agriculture, University of Peradeniya

##### **Academic & Research Excellence**

A scholar of international standing, Professor Hewajulige has contributed significantly to the
global scientific community through over 100 scientific communications and 25+ peer-reviewed papers.
* **PhD in Postharvest Biology** – University of Colombo, Sri Lanka
* **MPhil in Postharvest Biology & Technology** – University of Colombo, Sri Lanka
* **BSc (Hons) in Agriculture** – University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka
* **International Research Fellowships:** * University of California, Davis, USA (Mann Lab)
* National Food Research Institute (NFRI), Tsukuba, Japan

##### **Awards & National Contributions**

In recognition of her impact on science and innovation, she has been honored with over 15
prestigious scientific awards, including:
* **4 Presidential Awards** for Scientific Publications and Patents.
* **National Science and Technology Award (NASTA)** – 2018.
* **Two National Inventors Awards** – 2018 & 2019.
* **SLCARP Awards for Excellence in Agricultural Research** – 2019 & 2021.

Beyond her research, Professor Hewajulige serves on several national advisory committees, playing a
pivotal role in shaping national policies and standards for food systems and postharvest technology
in Sri Lanka.

# About Us

Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology (SLINTEC) is a pioneer in nano and advanced technology
research in Sri Lanka. Our research is primarily focused on; Energy Storage, Nano/Advanced Materials
and Minerals, Printable Electronic and Sensors, Natural Products and Nutraceuticals, Sustainable and
Functional Textiles, Advanced Agricultural Technology, Graphite/Graphene Initiatives. SLINTEC is the
first public-private research institute in Sri Lanka, and we’re proud to have made significant
progress in being a change catalyst in the field of science for over a decade.

We’ve focused all our resources to create technologies that will solve many pressing problems in
emerging nations such as Sri Lanka. These problems may include, but aren’t limited to, affordable
food security, affordable and clean energy, safe drinking water, sustainable economic development,
and, more recently, detection and prevention of COVID-19 infections. In aligning with our founding
mission, we’ve dedicated all our resources to find innovative and internationally competing
solutions to these issues.

It is our aim to build a futuristic nanotechnology and science park with advanced facilities to
support all interested stakeholders to pursue their research & development. We will provide all our
clients with experienced and competent research personnel along with the right tools to help design
and develop something of great value.

With expertise, we wish to embark on new areas of research that are relevant to the development of
the industrial base in Sri Lanka within an internationally competitive landscape.

## Vision

> Inventions Beyond the Horizon

We want to play our part in the advancement of nanotechnology research and development. We hope to
bring great minds and great technologies together in our pursuit to discover and develop products
that change the way we live.

## Mandate

Build a world-class research and development center specialising in nanotechnology and advanced
technology.
* Make products more competitive using nano and advanced technologies.
* Add value to Sri Lanka’s mineral resources by showcasing the benefits of coupling minerals with
nanotechnology.

Build a nanotechnology and science park for research, development, and commercialization.

## The Water-Energy-Food Nexus

As the world population is nearing 8 billion, increasing demand for basic services rise and the need
for a higher standard of living is ever more prevalent.

The water, energy and food security nexus is linked to the vital resources that are needed for the
upgrade of standard of living. Water-food-energy connections lie at the heart of sustainable,
economic and environmental development and protection.

We at SLINTEC understand the inter linkage and the effect on each resource and improved water,
energy, and food security on a global level can be achieved through an approach that integrates
management and governance. SLINTEC has positioned itself as an organization for taking on the
challenges in this aspect both at in the local context and global.

# Leadership

## The Chairman of the Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology

Mr. Thilan Wijesinghe is a prominent figure in Sri Lanka’s business and technology landscape,
currently serving as the Chairman of the Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology (SLINTEC). A seasoned
professional with a diverse background in finance, investment, and strategic leadership, Mr.
Wijesinghe brings a wealth of experience to his role at the helm of the nation’s foremost
nanotechnology research institute.

His academic credentials include degrees in Industrial Engineering and Economics from Cornell
University, USA, and a degree in Business Administration from the State University of New York at
Fredonia. This strong educational foundation has been a cornerstone of his multifaceted career.

Mr. Wijesinghe has a distinguished track record of leadership in both the public and private
sectors. He is the Founder and Executive Chairman of TWC (Pvt) Ltd, a corporate finance and
investment advisory firm. His career has been marked by several pioneering achievements, including
co-founding Asia Capital PLC, which rose to become a leading investment bank in Sri Lanka.

Notably, Mr. Wijesinghe holds the distinction of being the youngest-ever Chairman and
Director-General of the Board of Investment (BOI) of Sri Lanka. During his tenure, he played a
pivotal role in attracting significant foreign direct investment to the country and driving key
infrastructure development projects.

His entrepreneurial spirit is further evidenced by his involvement in co-founding and leading
several successful ventures across various sectors, including technology, leisure, and real estate.
His leadership at SLINTEC is characterized by a strong focus on driving the commercialization of
research and fostering innovation to contribute to Sri Lanka’s economic growth. Mr. Wijesinghe is
committed to positioning SLINTEC as a global leader in nanotechnology research and development,
fostering strategic collaborations, and translating cutting-edge scientific advancements into viable
commercial applications.

#### **Professor Ilmi Hewajulige**

**Chief Executive Officer (Covering)**

Professor Ilmi Hewajulige is a distinguished research scientist and executive leader with over 30
years of extensive experience in postharvest biology, food technology, and supply-chain management.
Currently serving as the Director General and CEO of the Industrial Technology Institute (ITI), she
brings a wealth of strategic expertise to SLINTEC to drive forward Sri Lanka’s scientific and
industrial landscape.

**Executive Summary**

Throughout her career, Professor Hewajulige has been at the forefront of Research and Development
(R&D) in Sri Lanka. She has successfully led multidisciplinary teams of over 350 scientists,
engineers, and technologists across diverse sectors, including Biotechnology, Food, Herbal, and
Environmental Technologies. Her career is defined by a commitment to bridging the gap between
laboratory innovation and commercial application, providing critical advisory services to the
industry on product development, technology transfer, and quality management.

##### **Professional Experience**

Professor Hewajulige’s leadership journey is rooted in a deep technical foundation at the
**Industrial Technology Institute (ITI)**:
* **Director General / CEO** – ITI (Current)
* **Additional Director General (R&D) & Research Professor** – 6 years
* **Director / Senior Director (Food Technology Section)** – 6 years
* **Senior Research Officer** – 17 years
* **Assistant Lecturer** – Faculty of Agriculture, University of Peradeniya

##### **Academic & Research Excellence**

A scholar of international standing, Professor Hewajulige has contributed significantly to the
global scientific community through over 100 scientific communications and 25+ peer-reviewed papers.
* **PhD in Postharvest Biology** – University of Colombo, Sri Lanka
* **MPhil in Postharvest Biology & Technology** – University of Colombo, Sri Lanka
* **BSc (Hons) in Agriculture** – University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka
* **International Research Fellowships:** * University of California, Davis, USA (Mann Lab)
* National Food Research Institute (NFRI), Tsukuba, Japan

##### **Awards & National Contributions**

In recognition of her impact on science and innovation, she has been honored with over 15
prestigious scientific awards, including:
* **4 Presidential Awards** for Scientific Publications and Patents.
* **National Science and Technology Award (NASTA)** – 2018.
* **Two National Inventors Awards** – 2018 & 2019.
* **SLCARP Awards for Excellence in Agricultural Research** – 2019 & 2021.

Beyond her research, Professor Hewajulige serves on several national advisory committees, playing a
pivotal role in shaping national policies and standards for food systems and postharvest technology
in Sri Lanka.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Zhonglian Chem is a leading manufacturer of silica and silicon dioxide based in Shandong, China, specializing in high-end applications across the food, pharmaceutical, and coatings industries. The company offers a diverse range of products, including food-grade additives, pharmaceutical glidants, and industrial materials, all designed to enhance performance and quality for its target markets, which include food manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, and coatings manufacturers. With strong R&D capabilities and multiple patents, Zhonglian Chem is committed to delivering innovative solutions tailored to the specific needs of its clients.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Punagri Organics and Lifesciences specializes in the manufacture of pharmaceutical intermediates and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), with a strong emphasis on GMP accreditations. The company offers a diverse range of high-purity products tailored for pharmaceutical manufacturers and research organizations, alongside contract development and research services aimed at meeting the specific needs of its global clientele. With a commitment to quality and competitive pricing, Punagri is dedicated to fostering a comprehensive pharmaceutical ecosystem.

## Description

## 3-Aminopyrazole (CAS 1820-80-0)

**CAS 1820-80-0** refers to **3-Aminopyrazole**, an important heterocyclic pharmaceutical
intermediate widely used in advanced chemical synthesis. **Punagri** is a trusted supplier and
manufacturer of **CAS 1820-80-0 in India**, delivering high-quality material for pharmaceutical and
specialty chemical applications.

This compound plays a significant role in API development and multi-step pharmaceutical
manufacturing. Moreover, Punagri follows controlled production processes and strict quality
standards to maintain consistent product quality. Therefore, customers rely on us for dependable
supply and reliable performance.

**CAS 1820-80-0** supports pharmaceutical intermediate manufacturing, specialty chemical production,
and research-based synthesis applications.

## Key Features

• High purity **CAS 1820-80-0** suitable for pharmaceutical synthesis
• Consistent product quality through controlled manufacturing processes
• Moreover, reliable performance for industrial and research applications
• Suitable for pharmaceutical and specialty chemical industries
• Secure packaging for safe storage and export
• Trusted supplier of **CAS 1820-80-0 in India**

## Applications

### Dorzagliatin Intermediate

**CAS 1820-80-0** is widely used in the synthesis of **Dorzagliatin**, an important pharmaceutical
compound used in advanced [drug][25] development.

### Larotrectinib Intermediate

In addition, **3-Aminopyrazole** supports the manufacturing process of **Larotrectinib** and related
pharmaceutical formulations.

### Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

Furthermore, **CAS 1820-80-0** contributes to API synthesis, specialty chemical production, and
research-based pharmaceutical development.

• Trusted manufacturer and supplier of **CAS 1820-80-0**
• Reliable manufacturing with strict quality monitoring
• Moreover, efficient logistics ensure timely delivery

• Long-term supply support for pharmaceutical industries

As a result, customers benefit from reliable quality and professional support.

## Global Supply

[Punagri][26] supplies **CAS 1820-80-0** to pharmaceutical and chemical industries across
international markets.

We serve customers in **Asia, Europe, and other global regions**. Furthermore, our structured supply
chain ensures timely delivery and consistent product quality for every batch.

**We supply CAS 1820-80-0 to global markets with reliable logistics and consistent product
performance.**

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What is CAS 1820-80-0?

CAS **1820-80-0** refers to **3-Aminopyrazole**, a pharmaceutical intermediate used in chemical
synthesis.

### What are the applications of CAS 1820-80-0?

**CAS 1820-80-0** is mainly used in the synthesis of **Dorzagliatin**, **Larotrectinib**,
pharmaceutical intermediates, and specialty chemicals.

### Who supplies CAS 1820-80-0 in India?

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Punagri Organics and Lifesciences specializes in the manufacture of pharmaceutical intermediates and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), with a strong emphasis on GMP accreditations. The company offers a diverse range of high-purity products tailored for pharmaceutical manufacturers and research organizations, alongside contract development and research services aimed at meeting the specific needs of its global clientele. With a commitment to quality and competitive pricing, Punagri is dedicated to fostering a comprehensive pharmaceutical ecosystem.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Resolvemass specializes in comprehensive drug discovery and development services, offering a wide range of solutions including custom synthesis, medicinal chemistry, and analytical method development. The company caters to the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors, providing expertise in areas such as antibody drug conjugates, generic drug development, and bioanalytical services to support clients in bringing innovative therapies to market.

Track 2:  Pharmaceutical Chemistry

Pharmaceutical Chemistry is the study of drug design to optimize pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, and synthesis of new drug molecules.  Pharmaceutical Chemistry  is a branch of chemistry that deals with the chemical, biochemical and pharmacological aspects of drugs. It includes synthesis/isolation, identification, structural elucidation, structural modification,  structural activity relationship  (SAR) studies, and study of the chemical characteristics, biochemical changes after drug administration and their pharmacological effects as well as analysis of drugs. In more simple words it is more broader than  medicinal chemistry  in its application also in the fields of analysis, identification, as well as, structural elucidation of drugs.

Related Associations and Societies :   Pharmaceutical Group of the European Union  | International Pharmaceutical Federation | The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Australia |Pharmacy in China |  Danish Association of Pharmaconomists

Track 3:  Drug Targeting and Design

Drug design , often referred to as  rational drug design  or simply rational design, is the inventive process of finding new medications based on the knowledge of a biological target. The drug is most commonly an organic small molecule that activates or inhibits the function of a biomolecule such as a protein, which in turn results in a therapeutic benefit to the patient. In the most basic sense, drug design involves the design of molecules that are complementary in shape and charge to the biomolecular target with which they interact and therefore will bind to it. Drug design frequently but not necessarily relies on computer modeling techniques. This type of modeling is sometimes referred to as  computer-aided drug design . Finally, drug design that relies on the knowledge of the three-dimensional structure of the biomolecular target is known as structure-based drug design. In addition to small molecules,  biopharmaceuticals  and especially therapeutic antibodies are an increasingly important class of drugs and computational methods for improving the affinity, selectivity, and stability of this protein-based therapeutics have also been developed.

Related Associations and Societies :  International Pharmaceutical Federation |  Pharmaceutical Group of the European Union  |   The Society of Hospital Pharmacists of Australia  | Canadian Pharmacists Association | Pharmacy in China | Danish Association of Pharmaconomists | Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland | The Pharmaceutical Association of Israel 

Track 4:  Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs

Pharmacokinetics is currently defined as the study of the time course of drug absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion. Clinical  pharmacokinetics  is the application of pharmacokinetic principles to the safe and effective therapeutic management of drugs in an individual patient. Primary goals of clinical pharmacokinetics include enhancing efficacy and decreasing  toxicity  of a patient’s drug therapy. The development of strong correlations between drug concentrations and their pharmacologic responses has enabled clinicians to apply pharmacokinetic principles to actual patient situations.

Pharmacodynamics  refers to the relationship between drug concentration at the site of action and the resulting effect, including the time course and intensity of therapeutic and adverse effects. The effect of a drug present at the site of action is determined by that drug’s binding with a receptor.

all_classified.company_summary: Amgen is a leading biotechnology company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering innovative human therapeutics. With a focus on areas such as oncology, inflammation, cardiovascular health, and rare diseases, Amgen leverages advanced research and development strategies, including AI and data science, to enhance patient care and improve health outcomes globally. The company is committed to sustainability and ethical practices, ensuring quality and safety in its products while fostering community investment and health equity initiatives.

all_classified.polished_summary: Amgen is a leading biotechnology company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering innovative human therapeutics. With a focus on areas such as oncology, inflammation, cardiovascular health, and rare diseases, Amgen leverages advanced research and development strategies, including AI and data science, to enhance patient care and improve health outcomes globally. The company is committed to sustainability and ethical practices, ensuring quality and safety in its products while fostering community investment and health equity initiatives.

# Our company

Bristol Myers Squibb is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing and
delivering innovative medicines that help patients overcome serious diseases.
* [

### Leadership

][68]
* [

### Governance

][69]
* [

### Locations

][70]

### Partnerships & business development

][71]

## Working at BMS

Our employees are empowered to tackle meaningful challenges across research, innovation and
healthcare in a culture built on integrity, inclusion and continuous learning. Bristol Myers Squibb
combines the agility of a biotech with the global reach of a leading pharmaceutical company,
creating opportunities for employees to grow their careers while making an impact on patients around
the world.
[ Learn More ][72]

## Who are you working for?

For many of our 30,000 team members, the answer is personal: a loved one who needs, or has needed,
life-changing medicines.

That connection drives our mission to bring hope to patients and transform lives through the power
of science.

With leadership in oncology, hematology and neuroscience and a legacy of bold science, we’re
accelerating new medicines through advanced research and technology to be faster, more agile and
more efficient.

Evolution is in our DNA, and we measure success by our impact. By combining scientific and business
expertise, we’re driving progress for patients and advancing health equity worldwide, powered by
people committed to pushing what’s possible

## Leadership

Our culture of inclusion and strong commitment to patients starts at the top.**

[Leadership team][73]

[Board of directors][74]

## Doing business with us

We work with companies led by experienced partners across industries. Let's work together to create
a positive impact on our patients and your business.

[Learn more][75]

[Information for suppliers][76]

## Principles

We believe that the priceless ingredient of every product we make is the integrity of its maker.

[Read about our principles][77]

## Mission, vision, values and commitment

Bristol Myers Squibb is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and
deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.

[Read about our mission, vision, values and commitments][78]

## Our history

Our company’s legacy of innovation began in the early 1800s, when our founders made it their mission
to bring better health solutions to patients who needed them most.

[Review history timeline][79]

## Achievements

Our focus is always on helping patients, but it's nice to be recognized for the work we do.

[View awards and achievements][80]
