2. Our company

# Our company

Bristol Myers Squibb is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing and
delivering innovative medicines that help patients overcome serious diseases.
* [

### Leadership

][68]
* [

### Governance

][69]
* [

### Locations

][70]
* [

### Partnerships & business development

][71]

## Working at BMS

Our employees are empowered to tackle meaningful challenges across research, innovation and
healthcare in a culture built on integrity, inclusion and continuous learning. Bristol Myers Squibb
combines the agility of a biotech with the global reach of a leading pharmaceutical company,
creating opportunities for employees to grow their careers while making an impact on patients around
the world.
[ Learn More ][72]

## Who are you working for?

For many of our 30,000 team members, the answer is personal: a loved one who needs, or has needed,
life-changing medicines.

That connection drives our mission to bring hope to patients and transform lives through the power
of science.

With leadership in oncology, hematology and neuroscience and a legacy of bold science, we’re
accelerating new medicines through advanced research and technology to be faster, more agile and
more efficient.

Evolution is in our DNA, and we measure success by our impact. By combining scientific and business
expertise, we’re driving progress for patients and advancing health equity worldwide, powered by
people committed to pushing what’s possible

## Leadership

Our culture of inclusion and strong commitment to patients starts at the top.**

[Leadership team][73]

[Board of directors][74]

## Doing business with us

We work with companies led by experienced partners across industries. Let's work together to create
a positive impact on our patients and your business.

[Learn more][75]

[Information for suppliers][76]

## Principles

We believe that the priceless ingredient of every product we make is the integrity of its maker.

[Read about our principles][77]

## Mission, vision, values and commitment

Bristol Myers Squibb is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and
deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.

[Read about our mission, vision, values and commitments][78]

## Our history

Our company’s legacy of innovation began in the early 1800s, when our founders made it their mission
to bring better health solutions to patients who needed them most.

[Review history timeline][79]

## Achievements

Our focus is always on helping patients, but it's nice to be recognized for the work we do.

[View awards and achievements][80]

With a focus on transforming patients' lives through scientific advancements, the company targets a wide range of therapeutic areas to improve health outcomes for patients worldwide.

all_classified.company_function: provider of advanced delivery technologies and services
all_classified.company_summary: Catalent is a leading global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that partners with pharmaceutical, biotech, and self-care companies to accelerate the development, manufacturing, and delivery of innovative products. With a focus on enhancing health outcomes, Catalent offers a comprehensive range of services, including biologics, oral dose manufacturing, and clinical supply solutions, leveraging advanced technologies and a worldwide network to meet the needs of its clients.
all_classified.operational_presence: Markets mentioned on website: Europe, China, Japan

_crawl.offices: Birmingham, UK; Singapore; Tokyo, Japan; Toronto, Canada

all_classified.polished_summary: Catalent is a leading global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that partners with pharmaceutical, biotech, and self-care companies to accelerate the development, manufacturing, and delivery of innovative products. With a focus on enhancing health outcomes, Catalent offers a comprehensive range of services, including biologics, oral dose manufacturing, and clinical supply solutions, leveraging advanced technologies and a worldwide network to meet the needs of its clients.

all_classified.company_summary: Charles River Laboratories is a leading provider of comprehensive drug discovery and development services, supporting clients across the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors. The company specializes in a wide range of offerings, including laboratory animal models, integrated drug discovery, preclinical testing, and regulatory guidance, aimed at accelerating the safe and efficient delivery of vital drugs to market. With a commitment to innovation and sustainability, Charles River actively engages in initiatives that promote scientific advancement and corporate responsibility.

your facility, one of our satellite labs, or even within the walls of the many Charles River
facilities itself.

][31]
[Get the Details][32]
[

Cell and Gene CDMO Solutions

Fastrack your cell and gene development and manufacturing with our end-to-end scalable solutions
from early stage-research and testing through commercial release.

][33][

Biologics Testing and Manufacturing Solutions

Navigate seamlessly throughout the biologic development cycle, from early concept to market-ready
with our tailored, CGMP global testing and manufacturing solutions.

][34][

Microbiology Quality Control Solutions

Elevate your contamination control strategy and accelerate production with confidence. Our rapid,
accurate, and compliant microbial testing solutions optimize your QC workflow.

][35]
[Meet the Experts][36]
[

One Step Manufacturing

One Step by Charles River is a comprehensive, tailored suite of CRO drug discovery and development
services in target discovery, lead optimization, development chemistry, GMP, drug product
development and CMC strategy.

][37][

Fast Lane

Expedite your investigational new drug (IND) application with Fast Lane Paradigm. Learn how to
reduce white space between studies and accelerate time to clinic for you INDs.

][38][

IND-Enabling Studies Toolbox

Charles River can conduct an investigational new drug (IND) study from start to finish, and offers
stand-alone studies needed for IND-enabling submissions. Our IND experts have expertise in all major
therapeutic areas, including medical devices and gene and cell therapies.

00:00-00:02

00:03-00:12
[Mary and Peggy are sitting on a tan couch in their living room. They are both wearing sweatshirts
and are seated comfortably with their hands on top of their laps. Mary is seated with her legs

is of Mary’s mother and father at a dining table.]

**Caption**: Mary

**Mary: My** **mother** **had** **Alzheimer's** **disease.** **At** **that** **point** **in**
**time,** **I** **didn't** **know** **that** **that** **was** **going** **to** **be** **me**
**someday.** **But** **I** **kind** **of** **thought** **maybe** **someday it might.** **And**
**I'm** **glad** **that** **I** **went** **through** **it** **with** **her,** **because** **I**
**know** **what** **to** **expect.**

00:13-00:24
[The scene then returns to Mary and Peggy on their couch. A montage with photos of them together
begins to play; the first photo is of Mary and Peggy sitting in doors together; the second photo is
of them standing outside together in summer clothing; the third photo is of them sitting in a
restaurant booth, with Mary leaning her head on Peggy’s shoulder; the fourth photo is of them at a
high-top table in a bar.]

**Caption**: Peggy

**Peggy: We** **have** **been** **married** **since** **2014.** **We** **have** **been**
**together** **for 30 years.** **I** **chased** **her** **for** **six** **months.** **Then** **she**
**finally** **realized** **that** **it's** **all** **good.**

**Mary: “She’s serious.”**

00:24-00:38
[The scene then returns to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**Mary: I** **worked** **for** the **Department of** **Natural** **Resources**, **and** **so** **I**
**traveled** **the** **state** **a** **lot. Well, I** **got** **to** **the** **point** **where**
**I** **couldn't** **remember** **which** **road** **to** **take.** **Finding** **errors** **that**
**I** **normally** **wouldn't** **have** **made** **that** **were** **so** **simple** **and** **so**
**easy.**

00:38-00:57
[A photo of Mary at a doctor’s office, completing a cognitive assessment appears. The scene then
cuts back to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**Mary: When** **I** **was** **diagnosed** **with** **Alzheimer's,** **it** **was** **kind** **of**
**a** **shock but** **we** **knew** **something** **was** **wrong.** **I** **didn't** **know**
**what** **was** **going** **on** **in** **my** **brain.** **Why** **I** **was** **forgetting**
**everything,** **losing** **everything.** **Uh,** **wallets,** **money.**

**Peggy:** **Her** **wedding** **ring,** **she** **would** **just** **take** **off** **and**
**forget.** **Lost** **four** **of** **those,** **now** **she** **wears** **it** **around** **her**
**neck.**

00:57-01:16
[Footage plays of Mary and Peggy sitting in a bench on their porch with their dog in the background
before cutting back to them on their couch.]

**
Mary: I** **was** **relieved** **to** **know** **that** **there** **was** **something—that** **I**
**was** **diagnosed,** **because** **we** **knew** **that** **I** **was** **having** **issues.**

**Peggy: There** **was** **some** **depression** **there** **too, I think.**

**Mary: Oh** **yeah,** **there** **was** **some** **depression.**

**Peggy:** ‘**Cause**, **I** **mean,** **that** **that's** **not** **the** **best** **scenario**
**that** **you** **really** **want. But** **she** **was,** **I** **guess**, **almost** **relieved**
**that** **now** **she** **knows,** “**this** **is** **why** **I'm** **doing** **this.**”

01:17-01:34
[Footage of Mary and Peggy having a conversation in their kitchen plays, followed by clips of Mary
walking their dog on the sidewalk in her neighborhood, completing a puzzle at her kitchen table with
Peggy watching, and a gathering with their friends in the outdoor seating section at a restaurant.
After all of the footage plays, two photos of Mary and Peggy appear: the first is of them in summer
clothing with the ocean in the background; the second is of them outside on a promenade.]

**Mary: So** **far,** **it's** **been** **okay.** **I** **seem** **to** **be** **maintaining**
**fairly** **well,** **which** **is** **makes** **me** **happy.** **I** **don't** **know** **if**
**it's** **because** **I'm** **active,** **I** **walk.** **I** **do** **a** **lot** **of**
**reading.** **I** **do** **a** **lot** **of** **puzzles.**

**Peggy: Twice** **a** **month** **we'll** **meet** **friends** **for** **lunch.** **In**
**February,** **we** **went** **to** **Florida** **and** **just** **to** **get** **away.**

01:35-01:47
[The scene cuts back to Mary on her couch, then footage of her lying down on the couch playing games
on her phone.]

**Mary: If** **I** **could** **slow** **down** **the** **progression,** **I** **would.** **I**
**think** **I've** **tried** **to** **do** **as** **much** **as** **I** **can** **do** **to**
**make** **it** **slow** **down.** **Advice** **I** **can** **give** **other** **people** **who**
**have** **it? Find** **it** **while** **it's** **still** **early,** **while** **they** **can**
**do** **something** **more** **with** **it.**

01:47-02:06
[A photo of Mary sitting with her dog on the couch appears, followed by photos of Mary standing next
to an ocean and Mary sitting on a boat. The scene then cuts back to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**Mary: It's** **a** **depressing** **thing,** **and** **it's** **something** **that** **you**
**don't** **want** **to** **accept** **in** **your** **life,** **but** **you** **need** **to**
**tackle** **it** **and** **get** **a** **grip** **on** **it** **early.** **I** **know** **I'm**
**declining** **because** **my** **wife** **tells** **me** **I** **am declining** **all** **the**
**time! But** **I** **know** **that's** **going** **to** **happen.** **I'm** **going** **to** **be**
**grateful** **for** **what** **I** **get.**

**Peggy: For** **as** **much** **time** **as...**

**Mary:** **Time** **as** **I** **get,** **yeah.**

02:06-02:08
[Scene cuts to Peggy and Mary standing together in their home laughing.]

**Mary: As** **much** **as** **I** **can** **remember, for** **as** **long** **as** **I** **can**
**get.**

all_classified.polished_summary: Genentech is a leading biotechnology company focused on developing innovative medicines for patients with serious medical conditions, particularly in the fields of oncology, neuroscience, obesity, and ophthalmology. The company is dedicated to providing patient support services, conducting clinical trials, and advancing scientific research to improve health outcomes. With a commitment to sustainability and inclusion, Genentech aims to transform society through its groundbreaking therapies and community initiatives.

all_classified.company_function: developer of nano drug delivery systems
all_classified.company_summary: NanoCarrier Co. specializes in the development of innovative nanotechnology solutions aimed at enhancing drug delivery systems. The company focuses on creating advanced formulations that improve the efficacy and safety of pharmaceuticals, targeting markets in healthcare and biotechnology. Through its cutting-edge research and development, NanoCarrier Co. aims to revolutionize treatment options and improve patient outcomes.

## Smart Therapies for Difficult Diseases^{®}

### Our investigational immunotherapy products are tailored to each patient’s needs. We employ a
### “triangle offense” designed to deliver durable, complete responses in cancer and infectious
### diseases.

[Our Science][51]

At ImmunityBio, we envision a day when we no longer fear cancer, but are able to conquer it, thanks
to the biological wonder that is the human immune system. Our scientists are working to develop
remarkable new therapies that harness that inherent power by amplifying both the innate and adaptive
branches of the immune system, to facilitate the attack and elimination of cancerous or infected
cells today while building immunological memory for tomorrow. The goal: to reprogram the patient’s
immune system and treat the host rather than just the disease.

Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong
Global Chief Scientific and Medical Officer,
ImmunityBio

## Investigational Immunotherapies

ImmunityBio is developing immunotherapies that activate both innate and adaptive immune responses to
treat cancer and infectious diseases. Our approach stimulates NK cells, T cells, macrophages, and
dendritic cells to create a durable immune response, aiming to outperform treatments like CAR-T or
checkpoint inhibitors.

#### Learn more about our therapeutic areas

[Bladder Cancer][52] [Glioblastoma][53] [Lynch Syndrome][54] [Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma][55] [Non-Small
Cell Lung Cancer][56] [Ovarian Cancer][57] [HIV][58] 

## ImmunityBio is continuously pursuing new immunotherapies designed to attack disease by
## *enhancing* the patient’s immune system, not weakening it.

[About Us][59]

## A Robust Clinical Pipeline

We are applying our science and platforms, including the development of potential cancer vaccines,
to treat cancers, as well as developing immuno- and cell therapies that we believe could sharply
reduce or eliminate the need for standard high-dose chemotherapy.

all_classified.polished_summary: NantKwest is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative immunotherapies to treat cancer and infectious diseases by harnessing the power of the human immune system. Their core product, ANKTIVA®, is designed to enhance the immune response, targeting various therapeutic areas including bladder cancer, glioblastoma, and HIV. Through a robust clinical pipeline and strategic partnerships, NantKwest aims to deliver personalized treatments that improve patient outcomes while minimizing the need for traditional high-dose chemotherapy.

all_classified.company_summary: Pfizer is a global biopharmaceutical company founded in 1849, dedicated to advancing health through innovative medicines and vaccines. With a diverse portfolio that includes treatments for oncology, inflammation, immunology, and various infectious diseases, Pfizer aims to improve patient outcomes and enhance quality of life across multiple therapeutic areas. The company is committed to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices while actively engaging with healthcare professionals and patients to address their needs.

The company is committed to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices while actively engaging with healthcare professionals and patients to address their needs.

# Innovation

## Innovation means more moments like this

We're driven by our deep understanding of the root causes of disease, focusing our R&D in areas like
cancer, HIV, and respiratory diseases where we can make the most meaningful difference for people.

[Discover more about our R&D approach][205]
[Close video][206]

## Who we are

As a focused biopharma company, we discover, develop and deliver medicines and vaccines to create
value for patients and shareholders. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by
the end of the decade.

Our R&D focus is on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV;
and infectious diseases.

# Innovation

## Innovation means more moments like this

We're driven by our deep understanding of the root causes of disease, focusing our R&D in areas like
cancer, HIV, and respiratory diseases where we can make the most meaningful difference for people.

[Discover more about our R&D approach][205]
[Close video][206]

## Who we are

As a focused biopharma company, we discover, develop and deliver medicines and vaccines to create
value for patients and shareholders. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by
the end of the decade.

Our R&D focus is on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV;
and infectious diseases.

all_classified.company_summary: Silicon Biosystems, a part of the Menarini Group, specializes in advanced technologies for the analysis of rare cells with single-cell precision. The company offers a range of innovative products and services, including the CELLSEARCH® Circulating Tumor Cell Test and various kits for single-cell DNA analysis, targeting markets such as oncology, hematology, and prenatal testing. Their solutions empower healthcare providers and researchers to make informed decisions in cancer treatment and diagnostics.

all_classified.polished_summary: Silicon Biosystems, a part of the Menarini Group, specializes in advanced technologies for the analysis of rare cells with single-cell precision. The company offers a range of innovative products and services, including the CELLSEARCH® Circulating Tumor Cell Test and various kits for single-cell DNA analysis, targeting markets such as oncology, hematology, and prenatal testing. Their solutions empower healthcare providers and researchers to make informed decisions in cancer treatment and diagnostics.

all_classified.company_function: provider of scientific instrumentation and drug development services
all_classified.company_summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific is a leading provider of scientific instrumentation, reagents, and consumables, serving a diverse range of markets including biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, clinical diagnostics, and industrial applications. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, including antibodies, cell culture solutions, mass spectrometers, and laboratory services, aimed at accelerating scientific research and innovation. With a commitment to quality and customer support, Thermo Fisher empowers researchers and organizations to make significant advancements in their fields.

The Group

A leading provider of CMO and R&D services to the top Indian & MNC pharmaceutical companies.

The Acme Group began its journey in 2005 with a bold mission of becoming a leader in the contract
manufacturing space and a preferred business partner for pharmaceutical companies seeking
world-class capabilities and scalable operations.

Guided by the founder's vision and purpose, the Acme Group has scaled new heights in the
pharmaceutical value chain over the years. Today, it provides fully integrated contract
manufacturing and development solutions to some of the top Indian and global pharmaceutical
companies. Acme is driven by a belief in fast growth combined with a focus on innovation and
service. The group currently consists of four state-of-the-art, fast-growing companies: Acme
Formulation, Immacule Lifesciences, Acme Generics, and Veritas Research.

Powering the group are 2,500+ highly skilled staff working across over 1 million sq. ft. of
manufacturing space in Northern India. We produce 17 billion tablets, 3 billion capsules, 30 million
liquid vials/ampoules, and 12 million lyophilized vials annually. Our expertise lies in the niche
segments of oral hormones, including female sex hormones and levothyroxine, along with liquid and
lyophilized injectables. We have expanded our sterile manufacturing capacity to produce an
additional 60 million general liquid and lyophilized vials, 60 million liquid and lyophilized vials
for oncology, 30 million three-piece ophthalmic containers, and 24 million pre-filled syringes and
cartridges annually.

Over the past decade, we have been audited and approved by various international regulatory
agencies, including USFDA, UK-MHRA, EU-GMP, Health Canada, TGA Australia, ANVISA, INVIMA, and WHO
Geneva. In addition, we have received approvals across major emerging markets in Asia, Africa, CIS,
and Latin America. With 38 ANDAs approved, 18 ANDAs filed and under review, and a target of 50+ ANDA
approvals by 2025, we continue our journey towards building a sustainable future as a leading CDMO.

## Our Vision & Mission

**VISION**
- To become a globally reputed company in supply of high quality innovative oral solid and
sterile drug products.

**MISSION**
- To develop, register & commercialize maximum generic oral solid and sterile drug products
across all regulated and emerging markets.

Acme looks to the future with ever higher goals and ambitions and with its unwavering focus on
service and quality is strategically poised to grow even further in the years ahead.

The Group

A leading provider of CMO and R&D services to the top Indian & MNC pharmaceutical companies.

The Acme Group began its journey in 2005 with a bold mission of becoming a leader in the contract
manufacturing space and a preferred business partner for pharmaceutical companies seeking
world-class capabilities and scalable operations.

Guided by the founder's vision and purpose, the Acme Group has scaled new heights in the
pharmaceutical value chain over the years. Today, it provides fully integrated contract
manufacturing and development solutions to some of the top Indian and global pharmaceutical
companies. Acme is driven by a belief in fast growth combined with a focus on innovation and
service. The group currently consists of four state-of-the-art, fast-growing companies: Acme
Formulation, Immacule Lifesciences, Acme Generics, and Veritas Research.

Powering the group are 2,500+ highly skilled staff working across over 1 million sq. ft. of
manufacturing space in Northern India. We produce 17 billion tablets, 3 billion capsules, 30 million
liquid vials/ampoules, and 12 million lyophilized vials annually. Our expertise lies in the niche
segments of oral hormones, including female sex hormones and levothyroxine, along with liquid and
lyophilized injectables. We have expanded our sterile manufacturing capacity to produce an
additional 60 million general liquid and lyophilized vials, 60 million liquid and lyophilized vials
for oncology, 30 million three-piece ophthalmic containers, and 24 million pre-filled syringes and
cartridges annually.

Over the past decade, we have been audited and approved by various international regulatory
agencies, including USFDA, UK-MHRA, EU-GMP, Health Canada, TGA Australia, ANVISA, INVIMA, and WHO
Geneva. In addition, we have received approvals across major emerging markets in Asia, Africa, CIS,
and Latin America. With 38 ANDAs approved, 18 ANDAs filed and under review, and a target of 50+ ANDA
approvals by 2025, we continue our journey towards building a sustainable future as a leading CDMO.

## Our Vision & Mission

**VISION**
- To become a globally reputed company in supply of high quality innovative oral solid and
sterile drug products.

**MISSION**
- To develop, register & commercialize maximum generic oral solid and sterile drug products
across all regulated and emerging markets.

Acme looks to the future with ever higher goals and ambitions and with its unwavering focus on
service and quality is strategically poised to grow even further in the years ahead.

# Our products

Our portfolio spans autoinjectors, pen injectors, and advanced specialty systems for large‑volume
and high‑viscosity drug delivery.

## We develop advanced self-injection solutions

We design and manufacture advanced self-injection solutions, including autoinjectors, pen injectors,
and systems for large-volume and high-viscosity formulations. Since 1989, we have transformed drug
delivery through groundbreaking innovations.

As demand for self-treatment and personalized healthcare grows, we create reliable, cost-efficient,
and patient-focused devices. Partnering with leading pharma and biotech companies, we deliver
solutions that enhance patients’ independence and quality of life.

With decades of global experience, we provide agile support at every stage – from concept to
market-ready products – pioneering the future of self-treatment therapies

solutions that enhance patients’ independence and quality of life.

With decades of global experience, we provide agile support at every stage – from concept to

## Our device platforms

SHL Medical’s self-injection device platforms combine standardized, proven designs with the
flexibility to customize for specific therapy needs. Supported by our fully integrated in-house
manufacturing, this approach accelerates development, reduces risk, and scales efficiently from low
to high volumes. With more than 35 years of expertise, our future‑ready technologies address
evolving demands, while a strong patent portfolio ensures safe, reliable injection experiences that
build patient confidence.

This platform philosophy comes to life in the Molly modular platform, designed to elevate
flexibility in design, development, and production. Today, Molly is widely used in cardiometabolic
therapies, including obesity, and serves as the delivery device for leading weight‑loss drugs,
highlighting its vital role in modern treatment solutions.

Partnering with SHL Medical means comprehensive support for your drug delivery development project

Investing in SHL Medical's self-injection device platform represents a strategic decision for

## Solutions for every therapy area

Our innovative solutions are designed to improve the treatment experience across multiple
therapeutic areas. Currently, our products support 12 out of 12 key therapeutic areas according to
the IQVIA categorization as of December 2025.

Endocrine and metabolic

Endocrine and metabolic diseases encompass a wide range of disorders that arise from hormonal
imbalances or disruptions in the body’s metabolic processes, impacting everything from blood sugar
regulation to bone health. SHL Medical has been at the forefront of delivering self-injection
solutions for combination products used to treat conditions such as type 2 diabetes and
hypercholesterolemia, as well as emerging treatments for weight management.

Musculoskeletal

Musculoskeletal diseases affect the bones, muscles, joints, and connective tissues, often leading to
pain, disability, and a reduced quality of life. Treating and managing these diseases requires a
comprehensive approach. Today, around 20 of all the autoinjector combination products that SHL
Medical helped develop are indicated for various musculoskeletal conditions, including one of the
oldest blockbuster biologics indicated for rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis.

Dermatology

Dermatological diseases refer to a broad range of conditions affecting the skin, hair, and nails.
These conditions vary widely in cause, severity, and symptoms, and can include infections,
inflammatory disorders, autoimmune diseases, and skin cancers. Symptoms often involve changes in
skin appearance, such as redness, rashes, scaling, itching, or abnormal pigmentation. In 2020, an
autoinjector based on SHL Medical’s Molly® modular platform technology was approved for the
treatment of atopic disorders, setting a record as the world’s first 2.0 mL autoinjector combination
product.

## 1.5 billion autoinjectors shipped worldwide

This milestone reflects decades of trusted partnership with leading pharmaceutical and biotech
companies, and SHL Medical’s proven ability to deliver reliable self‑injection solutions at a global
scale. Built on more than 35 years of experience in drug‑delivery innovation, SHL Medical has
supported the launch of over 60 combination products across more than 75 markets, spanning a broad
range of therapeutic areas. With deep engineering expertise, end‑to‑end manufacturing capabilities,
and a global footprint across multiple continents, SHL Medical continues to translate scale into
consistency, helping millions of patients worldwide access safe, high‑quality self‑injection systems
they can rely on, every day.

## What is an autoinjector

Autoinjectors are devices designed to deliver a single, pre‑set dose of medicine subcutaneously with
minimal steps. Each autoinjector contains a pre‑filled container and is ready to use, removing the
need for dose preparation, cartridge handling, or repeated setup. With intuitive operation, clear
feedback, and ergonomic design, autoinjectors are intended to be easy to use even for patients new
to medical devices. This makes self‑injection more accessible, reliable, and suitable for treatment
at scale, particularly as therapies shift toward home‑based care.

This is in contrast to pen injectors, which typically hold multiple doses and require needle
attachment with each use, and support repeated dosing routines over time.

# Track record

With more than 60 combination products launched worldwide, SHL Medical has a proven track record of
supporting pharmaceutical and biotech companies across all 12 IQVIA-recognized therapeutic areas.

## A proven track record

SHL Medical is a trusted partner for pharmaceutical companies commercializing therapies across all
therapeutic areas as defined by IQVIA. We work across both mature and emerging indications—from
established autoimmune treatments to fast-growing areas like weight management—enabling successful
market entry through robust, patient-centric device solutions designed for global scale. Since
co-developing our first combination product in 1996, we have continuously advanced self-injection
technologies, helping redefine the gold standard for the 21st century through bespoke and platform
device offerings.

### Erectile Dysfunction

The launch of the PenInject 2.25 laid the foundation for SHL Medical’s journey, inspiring founder
Roger Samuelsson’s vision of building a world‑leading self‑injection solutions company. The device
was used to support the treatment of erectile dysfunction.

### Erectile Dysfunction

In 2000, SHL Medical and its customer launched an updated version of the original 1996 product,
building on early success and advancing its market reach.

### Fertility Treatment

SHL Medical supported the manufacture of a pen injector for a customer marketing a fertility
treatment indicated for both women and men, further solidifying its early expertise in pen‑based
drug delivery.

### Glaucoma

SHL Medical supported a customer in commercializing a specialized, patient‑focused mechanical aid
designed to facilitate the administration of an eye‑drop therapy for glaucoma.

### Anemia

SHL Medical’s DAI autoinjector was first brought to market alongside a therapy developed for the
treatment of anemia associated with chronic kidney disease. As SHL Medical’s first widely
commercialized autoinjector platform, DAI set the standard for self‑injection solutions until the
introduction of the Molly platform.

### Autoimmune and Inflammatory Diseases

SHL Medical delivered a breakthrough customer launch with the DAI autoinjector for a leading
biologic therapy used to treat chronic inflammatory diseases. This pivotal collaboration accelerated
the adoption of self‑injection for conditions including rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis,
ankylosing spondylitis, and plaque psoriasis, setting a new benchmark for the industry.

### Autoimmune and Inflammatory Diseases

Following the landmark launch of DAI in 2006, the autoinjector was once again chosen to support a
biologic therapy for chronic inflammatory diseases, this time enabling entry into a new geographic
market and extending its international reach.

### Aesthetics

SHL Medical supported a customer in launching a skin rejuvenation treatment using the Precision Pen
Injector (PPI), a device designed for the precise delivery of hyaluronic acid, which also received
the 2009 Red Dot Design Award.

### Migraine

SHL Medical supported a customer in bringing a DAI autoinjector to market for the treatment of
migraine and cluster headaches.

### Hepatitis C

Working with a customer, SHL Medical helped bring a chronic hepatitis C treatment for both adult and
pediatric patients into a self-injection format using the DAI autoinjector.

### Multiple Sclerosis

SHL Medical supported a customer with a bespoke device for the treatment of relapsing forms of
multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis,
and active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis with relapses.

### Multiple Sclerosis

In addition to developing a bespoke device for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, SHL Medical
continued supporting the same customer with another device solution, further advancing drug delivery
devices for multiple sclerosis patients.

### Autoimmune and Inflammatory Diseases

SHL Medical supported a customer in commercializing a monoclonal antibody using the DAI
autoinjector, expanding self‑injection treatment options for complex conditions such as rheumatoid
arthritis and cytokine release syndrome.

### Autoimmune and Inflammatory Diseases

The proven success of the DAI autoinjector enabled a previous biologic therapy for chronic
inflammatory diseases to be commercialized again with a new partner, this time supporting expansion
into an additional geographic market.

### Anaphylaxis (Allergy)

SHL Medical supported a customer in the commercialization of an autoinjector designed for emergency
anaphylaxis treatment.

### Hepatitis C

SHL Medical supported a customer with a bespoke device which enabled the commercialization of a
biologic for the treatment of hepatitis C.

### Growth Hormone Deficiency

SHL Medical developed a bespoke device for a customer commercializing a biologic for daily injection
therapy containing human growth hormone. Designed to support long‑term treatment, the device helps
patients living with growth hormone-related disorders by enabling consistent dosing to support
healthy bone and muscle development.

### Multiple Sclerosis

SHL Medical supported a customer in launching an additional treatment for multiple sclerosis (MS) in
an autoinjector format, further expanding self‑injection options within the MS therapy landscape.

### Multiple Sclerosis

SHL Medical supported another customer in the commercialization of a therapy for multiple sclerosis,
delivering a dedicated device solution to enable effective self‑administration.

### Autoimmune and Inflammatory Diseases

SHL Medical supported a customer in commercializing an important therapy using an autoinjector
across multiple markets, including China, marking the first SHL Medical autoinjector launched in the
Chinese market. The device enables treatment for patients with moderate‑to‑severe plaque psoriasis,
psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, non‑radiographic axial spondyloarthritis, and
hidradenitis suppurativa.

### Hypercholesterolemia (Lipid Lowering)

SHL Medical enabled the commercialization of a DAI-based combination product used to lower high
blood cholesterol levels. The combination product is designed to reduce the risk of major
cardiovascular events, including myocardial infarction, stroke, and unstable angina.

### Hypercholesterolemia (Lipid Lowering)

SHL Medical supported a customer with the DAI autoinjector for a biologic therapy designed to
address high blood cholesterol and support cardiovascular health, expanding treatment options for
patients by targeting key risk factors associated with cardiovascular disease.

### Growth Hormone Deficiency

SHL Medical supported a customer in commercializing a bespoke self‑injection solution for a
synthetic human growth hormone therapy, enabling treatment of growth hormone deficiency in both
pediatric and adult patients.

# Innovation in drug delivery

We shape the future as the innovation leader.

SHL Medical is not only a medical device company; we are an innovation company. Not only did we
pioneer the autoinjector market, but we are also pushing the envelope in future drug delivery.

## Facts and figures

### 227

#### active patent families for single-use autoinjectors

With 227 patent families, which is 2.5 times more than our closest competitor, we lead the way in
innovation.

### 12

#### therapy areas covered

Our devices are used in all therapy areas (IQVIA) covering 40+ indications, serving a wide range of
different patient types.

### 35+

#### years experience in self-injection solutions

As innovation leader, we have launched over 60 combination products and are driving customer
success.

## Innovation comes in many forms at SHL

As the innovation leader and pioneer, we shape the future and reinvent drug delivery solutions
together with our customers.

### Product innovation

We are the most trusted brand in pharma and biotech, and we have launched over 50 autoinjector
combination products. However, we are not stopping now; we are constantly pushing for new innovative
products that will allow even more patients to lead better lives through self-administration and
improved treatment experiences.
[Industrial Design_8888e]

### Manufacturing innovation

A key component of SHL Medical's success lies in its fully vertically integrated approach. This
structure enables us to innovate our production processes, as we design and build our own
manufacturing and testing equipment to provide optimal support throughout the device development
value chain. By handling the majority of processes in-house, we proudly position ourselves as a
comprehensive, end-to-end solution provider.
[Tooling-molding-carving]

### Genuine sustainability

SHL Medical is committed to a truly sustainable approach, addressing environmental responsibility
holistically. Rather than engaging in superficial measures, we focus on genuine improvements in our
manufacturing processes, implementing innovative changes and continuously pursuing efficiency gains
to reduce electricity consumption, minimize manufacturing waste, and more.
[SHL-Medical MollySE AOU installation 20241008-4]

## Elexy

SHL Medical's first electromechanical autoinjector is a one-of-kind. It is truly versatile as it
features one interface for both pre-filled syringes and cartridges. IIts versatility also
accelerates time to market for new drug therapies, helping companies quickly respond to emerging
therapeutic needs. Elexy offers top-tier flexibility across diverse injection profiles,
accommodating varying volumes, viscosities, injection durations, and primary container types, all
with reliable performance. Its power unit supports drug cassettes containing either pre-filled
syringes (1.0 mL and 2.25 mL) or cartridges (3.0 mL and 5.0 mL).

[ Learn more about Elexy ][163]
[[.png] Elexy Multiple 3 Angles PFS - Molly]

## Large-volume/high-viscosity drug delivery systems

SHL Medical is currently developing the future landscape of versatile drug delivery systems that
support the growing trend toward personalized medicine and less frequent injections. Often developed
as large-volume and/or high-viscosity subcutaneous formulations, these novel therapeutic molecules
require innovative technologies that consider the delivery mechanism and patients’ ease of use. We
are hopeful that our new and innovative product platforms will support self-administration for
therapeutic areas like oncology.

# Elexy: Redefine possibilities

Designed to redefine what is possible for injectable drug delivery, Elexy combines versatility,
reusability, connectivity, and ease of use, to address the unmet needs of both pharma and patients.

## An electromechanical autoinjector for your needs

A versatile, electromechanical autoinjector, Elexy aims to provide a best-in-class user experience
and the broadest available range of delivery volumes. This device accommodates diverse drug profiles
and integrates seamlessly into digital ecosystems, paving the way for smarter, more efficient
patient care.

[Elexy Multiple PFS + CART - Molly and Maggie]
[Elexy on Table PFS+CART - Molly and Maggie]
Open video modal
Play ❙❙ Pause ↻ Replay

## The added value of Elexy

### Versatility

A flexible solution providing a wide range of injection parameters.

### Reusability

A reusable autoinjector module designed to align with pharma's sustainability goals.

### Connectivity

Integrated connectivity features supporting the secure collection of richer injection data.

## Versatile solution

Elexy supports a wide range of injection profiles, offering flexibility across drug cassettes,
volumes, viscosities, and injection speeds. From preclinical and clinical studies to commercial
launch, Elexy optimizes time-to-market and ensures readiness for emerging therapeutic needs.

## Reusable unit

Elexy’s reusable power unit allows for easy adjustments in delivery parameters during dose-ranging
studies, offering consistent use across sessions. Like other reusable delivery systems, Elexy is
designed to reduce the consumption of natural resources, waste, and carbon footprint for chronic
conditions or therapies requiring multiple doses.

[elexy-reusable-space]

## Integrated connectivity

Elexy's integrated cellular connectivity facilitates the collection of richer clinical data,
supporting a smooth transition to commercial supply. Its RFID-enabled drug cassettes ensure that the
proper delivery parameters are used without the need for user inputs.

## Ease of use

With its simple push-to-activate operation, Elexy simplifies therapies involving multiple or
variable doses and multi-med treatments, delivering a consistent, reliable experience akin to
mechanical autoinjectors. Its multiple feedback features enhance user confidence, ensuring ease of
use for every patient.

# Reunite™ reconstitution made simple

An easy-to-use, dual-chamber cartridge autoinjector featuring SHL Medical’s Needle Isolation
Technology (NIT®), designed to support the automated reconstitution and delivery of lyophilized
formulations.

**Let's connect**

Looking for an autoinjector for your lyophilized formulations?

[ Get in touch ][164] [ Download specs ][165]

## What makes Reunite™ autoinjector unique

[[.psd] reunite-automated-reconstitution]

### Automated reconstitution

Reunite supports automated reconstitution and delivery of lyophilized drugs, replacing numerous and
complicated user steps for manual reconstitution vial kits.

[[.png] NIT Public 1 100dpi 20250122]

### NIT®

Reunite is built with Needle Isolation Technology (NIT®), which provides complete control of cannula
gauge and length to support target injection time and injection depth.

[[.png] Reunite NIT-Mix HAND1757-4164x4164-0e0d1de]

### Ease-of-use

Reunite features a simple three-step process, ensuring accurate dosing with a user-friendly design
for safe and effortless use.

##### Watch to learn about Reunite's three-step process: unlock, twist, push

[[.jpg] meet-reunite-dual-chamber-cartridge-autoinjector-lyophilized-drugs]
Open video modal
Play ❙❙ Pause ↻ Replay

## From 10+ Steps to 3

Traditional vial kits for lyophilized drugs involve multiple components and more than ten steps,
including disinfecting vials, attaching needles, transferring diluent, mixing, and preparing for
injection. Each step adds time, complexity, and risk of dosing errors or contamination.

Reunite™ simplifies this to just three steps: unlock, twist, push. This streamlined approach
improves safety, consistency, and ease of use for patients.

Register for the webinar below to learn more on how Reunite's innovative design simplifies
reconstitution of lyophilized solutions

[ Learn more ][166]

[ Register for the webinar ][167]

### Unlock to Reconstitute

Unlock the knob to initiate automated reconstitution.

[unlock-to- reconstitute]

### Twist off Cap

Twist off the needle cap.
The pre-attached needle (NIT®) moves backward to pierce the cartridge septum, open the fluid path
and initiate priming.

[twist-off-cap]

### Push to Inject

Push the device against the injection site to begin the injection. You will hear a start click. The
injection is complete when the plunger rod stops moving.

[[.jpg] reunite-push-to-inject]

## Market-proven technology

NIT® is an integrated, pre-attached needle technology for cartridge-based injections. NIT® allows
users to simply unlock the cap to open the fluid path. The needle cover automatically extends and
the autoinjector automatically primes.

The first NIT®-enabled autoinjector was launched in 2018 for a metabolic treatment. In 2024 and
2025, the latest NIT-enabled autoinjector was launched in the US and Europe, respectively, for the
treatment of two dermatological conditions.

[[.gif] Reunite-NIT cannula ending-4k-20250915]

## More than 25 years of engineering excellence

Reunite™ is the culmination of 25 years of engineering excellence. The best-in-class user experience
is achieved by integrating and hiding the needle and automating all critical user steps, reducing
the burden and risk of manual mixing and dosing and making lyophilized drug delivery as simple as a
standard autoinjector.

[[.jpg] reunite-timeline-upscalled-padding]

# Quanta

An automatic, multi-fixed-dose pen built for once-weekly cardiometabolic therapies. Its no-priming
design and spring-driven injection support smooth operation at each activation.

[ Get in touch ][164]
[[.png] hero-top-banner-quanta-pen-injector]

* [ Specifications ][166]
* [ Related products ][167]

##### A simpler way to manage weekly doses

Specifically developed for once-weekly cardiometabolic needs, Quanta introduces intentional design
features in a pen injector format to streamline weekly administration.

[[.jpg] quanta-automatic-pen-injector]

### Automatic injection

Spring-assisted mechanism for controlled delivery

[[.jpg] quanta-pen-injector-no-priming]

### No-priming design

Helps reduce handling steps

[[.jpg] quanta-fixed-dose-pen-injector]

### Fixed dose

Same dose per injection

[[.jpg]
quanta-multiple-dose-pen-injector ]

### Multiple dose

Supports 4-6 doses per device

[[.jpg]

Play ❙❙ Pause ↻ Replay

## Performance that repeats

Quanta pen injector focuses on four key areas central to long-duration therapy programs: handling
experience, dosing performance, cost considerations, and sustainability alignment.

### Enhanced user experience

Quanta integrates automatic, spring-driven mechanism and a no-priming design to minimize preparatory
steps. Built-in indicators guide the injection sequence, supporting a straightforward operation.

[[.jpg] enhanced-user-experience]

### Fixed-dose confidence

Quanta’s fixed-dose format removes dose-selection choices and provides a consistent cadence for each
injection. This setup reduces variability in user operation and helps users navigate repeated
administration with ease.

[[.jpg] reliable-dosing-performance]

### Operational cost efficiency

Quanta’s multi-dose configuration reduces the number of devices required per dosing cycle. This
enables more efficient inventory management, streamlined distribution, and cost-effective operations
for growing patient populations.

[[.jpg]
operational-cost-efficiency ]

### Sustainability considerations

Compared with a single use autoinjector, Quanta helps reduce total materials used and carbon
footprint over the course of treatment. Its design supports circularity through the use of certified
bio-circular plastics and efficient packaging and logistics.

[[.jpg] sustainability-considerations]

## Global manufacturing built for scale

SHL Medical operates a vertically integrated manufacturing network, designed to support scalable
production of innovative self-injection devices, such as autoinjectors and pen injectors. Through
in-house molding, integrated testing, and automated assembly, we maintain oversight of key steps
that influence device quality and continuity of supply.

Our modular manufacturing infrastructure supports transition from clinical to commercial production
while reducing transfer needs. With multi-site capacity and established supply frameworks, we
support device availability as patient volumes grow.

# Breadth of expertise

Innovation and device expertise at SHL Medical go beyond our current portfolio. We have extensive
knowledge in developing devices, spanning bespoke solutions and visionary concepts that shape the
future of drug delivery.

## Every innovation is built on what came before

SHL Medical’s capabilities extend far beyond the products currently active in our portfolio. Since
the launch of our first injector in 1996, we have worked closely with leading pharmaceutical
partners in the development, regulatory approval, and commercialization of combination products that
have helped transform patient care worldwide. Over the years, this journey has resulted in a broad
range of tailored solutions and numerous bespoke devices brought successfully to market, alongside
the exploration of bold, forward‑looking concepts. Each initiative reflects our strong engineering
heritage, creative problem‑solving, and the collaborative partnerships at the heart of how we work.
Together, these achievements demonstrate the depth, adaptability, and ambition that define our
approach to improving quality of life for millions of patients globally. Explore a selection of
inspiring examples that showcase the full breadth of what we can deliver.

## Device expertise built on launches, concepts, and innovation

Over the years, we have developed and successfully commercialized numerous bespoke solutions, as
well as visionary concepts that demonstrate what the next generation of devices could look like.
These projects highlight our creativity, engineering capabilities, and commitment to advancing
patient-centric drug delivery.

Here are a few inspiring examples that showcase this spirit of innovation.

### Disposable Autoinjector (DAI)

Launched in 2006, the Disposable Autoinjector (DAI) was one of the first modern autoinjectors.
Designed for easier self-injection, it established SHL Medical as a market leader and earned the
2006 Taiwan Excellence Award.

[[.png] DAI 2]

### Precision Pen Injector (PPI)

Building on our legacy of innovation in drug delivery, the Precision Pen Injector (PPI) exemplifies
our ability to tackle complex industry challenges. Featuring our patented Rotaject technology,
designed to ensure the successful administration of even highly viscous formulations, it combines
innovation with design excellence, an achievement recognized with the 2009 Red Dot Design Award.

[[.jpg] PPI 1]

### Madie

Over the past 25 years, we have helped our pharma partners bring a variety of pen-based solutions to
market, addressing the diverse needs of patients across multiple therapeutic indications. In 2015,
our variable-dose pen solution was successfully launched for the treatment of growth hormone
deficiency. Seven years later, a high-concentration format featuring an improved version with a
built-in dial was introduced, further enhancing usability and patient convenience.

[[.png] Madie_instruction_10]

### InsulCheck Connect and DOSE

SHL Medical has also explored connected solutions that enhance therapy management. This includes
smart injector add-ons, co-developed with [Innovation Zed][165], designed to seamlessly integrate
with existing insulin pens, enabling patients to track injection timing and activity through a
connected interface. Recognized for its thoughtful, user-centric design, one of these technologies
received the 2021 Good Design Award, highlighting our commitment to advancing digital health in
self-injection therapies.

[[.png] insulCheck Solution page 850x850 20230601]

### Micro Dosing Device (MDD)

Beyond our core expertise in developing autoinjector solutions, SHL Medical has been at the
forefront of advancing a range of injection device technologies, with a particular focus on
microliter-scale dosing. In line with our vision for precision drug delivery, SHL Medical has
pioneered a microdosing device technology that has proven effective in administering intravitreal
therapies.

[[.png] MIA (Micro dosing Device)]

### Bertha

Developed ahead of the surge in large-volume subcutaneous injections, the Bertha autoinjector was a
concept designed to deliver large-volume, higher-viscosity formulations, up to 60 centipoise, safely
and reliably. This autoinjector features a familiar two-step operation and combines ergonomic design
with intuitive feedback, giving patients confidence and control during self-administration.

[[.png] Bertha 2-091 拷貝]

### Safelock

Designed to enhance the safe and ergonomic use of prefilled syringes, SHL Medical developed
SafeLock, an automatic needle guard that prioritizes both patient and healthcare professional
safety. This solution enables intuitive, one-handed operation and features a needle guard that
automatically locks in place once the full dose has been delivered, reducing the risk of accidental
needle sticks while providing a seamless user experience.

[[.png] SafeLock1.0_instruction_1]

### Commercialized cartridge-based autoinjector

Our innovative Needle Isolation Technology (NIT) was integrated into a cartridge-based autoinjector
supporting the treatment of type 2 diabetes. The NIT autoinjector was selected as the Gold Winner of
the 2019 Medical Design Excellence Awards (MDEA).

[[.jpg] Medical-Design-Excellence-Awards 2]

### Molly Connected Cap

Designed to bring connected care to self‑injection, the Molly Connected Cap transforms the trusted
Molly autoinjector into a smart, data‑enabled solution. This compact, retrofittable add‑on activates
upon cap removal and records timestamped usage data, seamlessly transmitting insights to digital
platforms without altering the familiar injection experience.

[[.psd] Molly Connected-Cap - Open (All Angles Attached)]

### Elexy

Elexy exemplifies SHL Medical’s commitment to redefining what’s possible in drug delivery. A
versatile, electromechanical autoinjector, Elexy aims to provide a best-in-class user experience
while enabling the broadest range of delivery volumes. This device accommodates diverse drug
profiles and integrates seamlessly into digital ecosystems, paving the way for smarter, more
efficient patient care. Read more under [Innovation][166].

[[.png] Elexy on Table PFS+CART - Molly and Maggie]

### **What lies ahead?**

From pioneering the autoinjector market to shaping what’s next, SHL Medical leads innovation in the
future of drug delivery.

## Pioneering the next generation of drug delivery systems

SHL Medical is advancing the next generation of drug delivery systems to support personalized
medicine and less frequent dosing. Designed for large‑volume and high‑viscosity subcutaneous
formulations, our innovative platforms address both delivery complexity and patient usability,
opening new possibilities for self‑administration in therapeutic areas like oncology.

# Our services

Our deep expertise across the full drug delivery value chain makes us a trusted, end-to-end partner
throughout every stage of combination product development.

## We deliver end-to-end

We deliver end-to-end solutions across the full drug delivery value chain, from early feasibility
and device selection through final assembly, labeling, and packaging. Supported by deep expertise in
quality, regulatory affairs, and supply chain management, our integrated services ensure predictable
timelines, optimized costs, and regulatory readiness from concept through commercialization.

By continuously expanding our capabilities and forming strategic partnerships across the
pharmaceutical and drug delivery ecosystem, we deliver sustainable, innovative solutions that
enhance reliability, accelerate time to market, and support success throughout the entire product
lifecycle, giving partners confidence from development through launch and beyond.

[[.jpg] shl-medical advantec SMART-line IMG 5166]
[[.jpg] Device end-to-end solutions overview 20260122]
Vertical integration underpins our performance. SHL Medical is distinguished as a fully vertically
integrated player, with ownership of the supply chain providing a clear competitive advantage
through complete control over tool precision and molding processes.

## Device development services

Every core competency and value-added service in our device development strategy has been
continually refined over the years to ensure the lasting value of the self-injection systems we
design and develop with our customers.
* [ Feasibility and device selection ][162]
* [ Design ][163]
* [ Development ][164]
* [ Scale up ][165]
* [ Production ][166]
* [ Final assembly ][167]

[Container Free FATM (Fully Automatic Testing Machine)-Molly-20240730-26]

## Ready for industrial production

We design robust, market-proven drug-delivery solutions that accommodate a wide range of drug
formulations, viscosities, and fill volumes. Backed by a global, industrial-scale manufacturing
infrastructure, our solutions are built for high-volume production, with capacity reaching up to 700
million devices annually. This proven foundation allows customers to scale with confidence.

[ Why choose us ][168] [ Our products ][169]

## Support services

Our quality, regulatory, and supply chain expertise is fully integrated into every device project.
We provide end-to-end support across development, including integrated project management,
regulatory affairs, and supply chain management, to ensure efficient, predictable outcomes from
concept to commercialization.

[ Device support services ][170]
[[.jpg] SHL-Medical AppleTai Quality IMG 6704]

## Partnerships

We believe that maximizing value for our customers requires connections within the drug delivery
ecosystem, so that we can provide expert advice, recommendations, and options for our customers
along the value chain.

That’s why we have initiated an Alliance Management program to build strong partnerships along the
pharma and drug delivery value chain. Our partners include primary container providers, CMOs/CDMOs,
and other service providers and suppliers.

The program supports the platform business model, ensuring that our offerings provide our customers
with a comprehensive solution: better service, faster timeline, and simplified supply chain
management.

# Device development services

Drawing on experience from more than 60 launched combination products across 75+ markets, we provide
expert support at every stage of device development.

## The makings of an autoinjector

In autoinjector combination product development, pharma and biotech companies have varying device
needs based on the drug. Given the breadth of devices we have launched together with our partners,
we know how to meet demanding and varied requirements. To do so, we leverage our platform offerings
and end-to-end services: from research, and studies to regulatory filings and final assembly. Our
integrated approach ensures a smooth experience for all partners.

## From design to delivery

We support customers across the entire device lifecycle. Our services span early concept, design,
development, and manufacturing through scale-up. As an end-to-end solutions provider, we also offer
final assembly, labeling, and packaging services. We provide long-term lifecycle support to ensure
sustained performance beyond launch.

### Feasibility

We offer expert feasibility and device selection services to ensure optimal drug delivery solutions.
Benefit from our approach to select the right device.
[SHL-Medical-Office People Zug Konstantin KK5D7269]

### Design

From research and innovation to human factors engineering and IP protection: our constant pursuit of
innovative designs in drug delivery technologies is a cornerstone of our success.
[Industrial Design Molly]

### Development

Our successes are all made possible by the insistence on science-based product development
principles covering design input, testing, processes, and manufacturing engineering.
[Manufacturing Engineering_20181220-SHL 機台5900-編輯-編輯]

### Scale up

Our integrated processes, from design to commissioning of project-specific injection molding and
automated testing and assembly, enable us to effectively respond to varying volume forecasts with
the necessary production speed.
[FAAM]

### Production

We have achieved significant MedTech milestones, from mass-produced blockbuster legacy devices to
novel treatment modalities for various disease areas. Together with our partners, we continue to
push production boundaries and discover new markets.
[Molding_DSC_1293]

### Assembly, labeling, and packaging

We offer final assembly, labeling, and packaging services for drug delivery devices in the US
(Florida), and in Europe through an alliance partner.

### Support services and capabilities

Our quality, regulatory, and supply chain expertise is fully integrated into each device project to
fulfill clinical, commercial, and aftermarket needs.

# Feasibility and device selection

Combined with primary package characterization, feasibility studies provide insights into device
performance for informed decision-making.

## How we do it

Feasibility studies and design assessment activities are initiated in the early development phases
of device projects. This means that an informed characterization of the device design happens early,
mitigating further risks and failures downstream of the device development process.

## Primary package characterization

SHL Medical assists customers in quickly generating data to assess whether their drug and primary
package align with their expectations. This involves characterization of the primary package,
including functional testing and characterization of critical dimensions. Ultimately, the primary
package characterization aims to support our customers in choosing the right primary package and
de-risk costly implications during the lifecycle.

* Rapid provision of test results for improved decision-making
* Risk mitigation in terms of timeline and cost through early understanding of key specifications
and device performance
* Convenience due to integration of testing service as part
of core offering, eliminating need for managing external supplier

[[.jpg] SHL-Medical DeerfieldBeach Final Assembly-Labelling 20250324 SitePhotos-8]

## Feasibility studies

SHL Medical is committed to a holistic understanding of device performance, in order to support
customers’ decision-making in choosing the right device. We offer functional testing, using your
primary package with an existing SHL platform device to generate insight on how the combination
product performs regarding specifications such as cap removal and activation force, injection depth,
injection time, dose accuracy, and more.

In conjunction with Primary Package Characterization, feasibility studies results in a holistic
understanding of the device and primary package performance, enabling customers to make the right
decision for their combination product.

* Rapid provision of test results for improved decision-making
* Risk mitigation in terms of timeline and cost through early understanding of key specifications
and device performance
* Convenience due to integration of testing service as part of core offering, eliminating the need
for managing external supplier

# Drug delivery device design

Our commitment to the innovative design of our product offerings solidifies our leadership in the
drug delivery industry.

## User-centric design

The constant pursuit of innovative designs in self-injection solutions is a cornerstone of success.
From concept development to human factors engineering, these capabilities ensure user-centric
designs that empower patients to manage their treatment with confidence and independence.

By putting importance on usability, comfort, and intuitive operation, our device designs help reduce
the risk of user error and support adherence to therapy. Ultimately, our strong focus on the patient
experience leads to solutions that are both effective and easy to integrate into daily life.

[[.jpg] Industrial Design Capabilities - Molly Gen 1 drawing]

## Research and innovation

Device technologies originate from innovative concepts developed throughout the product journey. A
dedicated team of engineers collaborates with various departments to design and produce prototypes
that meet the evolving needs of the industry, customers, and patients.

* Developing technologies for timely, novel use cases
* Cross-functional research and concept development teams
* Rapid prototyping capabilities

[SHL-Medical-Office People Zug Konstantin KK5D7720]

## Industrial design

Our success lies in our collaboration with pharma and biotech partners to co-create valuable,
patient-centric solutions. Our in-house industrial designers and engineers focus on user needs,
leading to a growing number of launched products and a strong pipeline of innovative injection
devices.

* Strategic and creative device co-creation
* In-house design and usability expertise
* Award-winning innovative designs

[Industrial Design Molly]

## Human factors engineering

The patient is central to our work, so we prioritize understanding their needs. Our researchers and
engineers analyze patient-device interactions. By collaborating with customers to collect data, we
create safe and user-friendly device-user interfaces.

* User-centric design thinking
* Expertise in usability engineering
* Experience in formative study implementation

[Human Factors Industrial Design]

# Development

Having co-developed devices with the world’s top 25 leading pharma and biotech companies, we bring
deep expertise in product development and engineering.

[[.jpg] Container Free FATM (Fully Automatic Testing Machine)-Molly-20240730-11]
Open video modal

## Product development and engineering

Having worked with the world’s top 25 pharma and biotech companies to co-develop devices that have
made a mark in the market, SHL Medical wields clear knowledge and experience in product development
and engineering. Over the years, we have collaborated on new device concepts and platform-based
offerings, as well as customer-owned technologies for bespoke projects. These successes have all
been made possible by our insistence on science-based product development principles covering design
input, testing, processes, and manufacturing engineering.

Our commitment to scientific and engineering best practices has enabled us to develop a systematic
manufacturing process that consistently delivers products of the highest possible quality. With more
than three decades in the drug delivery industry, we have full mastery of device development
processes, encompassing early feasibility studies through to final assembly.

[Manufacturing Engineering_20181220-SHL 機台5900-編輯-編輯]

## An overview of our development services

Our design engineering team has 35+ years of drug delivery experience, focusing on user needs
through comprehensive testing. We support quality control with container free release testing while
assessing the product’s functional limitations.

### Design engineering

Our design engineering team manages pre-approval, device development, and post-approval lifecycle,
ensuring seamless continuity from feasibility to production.
* Concurrent engineering
* Decades of iterative experience
* End-to-end from feasibility to manufacturing

[Design Engineering Prototyping]

### Process development

With over three decades in drug delivery, we excel from feasibility studies to device assembly. Our
commitment to scientific best practices ensures a manufacturing process that delivers high-quality
products.
* Vertical integration of processes
* Design for manufacturing and assembly
* Rigorous reviews by in-house experts

[process development low res]

### Testing and simulation

We prioritize users' needs in design and device performance. Our global team conducts comprehensive
tests in dedicated labs, using in-house machines with interchangeable fixtures.
* Primary package characterization
* Custom testing machines
* Multiple in-house testing labs

[Container Free FATM (Fully Automatic Testing Machine)-Molly-20240730-16]

### Manufacturing

Our manufacturing science sets an industry standard. To support rapid growth, our manufacturing
engineering department transforms production into advanced, cost-effective solutions.
* Excellence through continuous improvement
* Digital infrastructure for lean manufacturing
* Expertise in intralogistics and infrastructure

[FAAM0302e_re-touch]

### Support for container free testing

We support Container Free Release (CoFR) testing, enabling quality control without pre-filled
syringes. This approach offers significant time and cost savings by eliminating syringe provision
and shipping, while reducing supply chain risks.
* Optimized timelines
* Cost savings
* Supply chain risk mitigation

[Container Free FATM (Fully Automatic Testing Machine)-Molly-20240730-14]

### Robustness studies

We help customers understand the functional limitations of their combination products. We perform
stacked pre-conditioning and functional testing to simulate conditions, such as warm/cool
atmosphere, dry-heat/cold storage, and vibration.
[Robustness study]

### Container Closure Integrity Testing (CCIT)

At our Deerfield Beach site, we offer Container Closure Integrity Testing (CCIT) using the dye
ingress test method. This service is available for a variety of devices, including syringes,
cartridges, autoinjectors, and safety syringes. CCIT is a cost-effective alternative to sterility
testing and helps ensure compliance with ISO 11608-3. By supporting multiple device configurations,
we help our customers save both time and money.

[Dye ingress test at Deerfield Beach]

### Transportation studies

We offer transportation studies to support worldwide regulatory filings for combination products or
fully assembled, labeled, and packaged products. Adhering to the FDA-recognized ASTM D4169 standard,
we provide studies for autoinjectors and multiple configurations, saving time and money. Both
simulated and real-world studies are available through an SHL-qualified external lab.

[Transportation Study at Deerfield Beach]

# Scale up

Our commitment to in-house manufacturing enables us to build flexible, scalable solutions that meet
customer needs throughout the product lifecycle.

## Scaling up manufacturing

Our fully in-house manufacturing model gives us the speed, flexibility, and scale to support
customers across the entire product lifecycle and global supply landscape. As a trusted, global
partner to pharma and biotech, we accelerate time to market with tailored support from pre-clinical
through commercial stages. End‑to‑end integration, from design and project-specific injection
molding to automated testing, assembly, and final assembly, enables us to rapidly adjust production
velocity and deliver with confidence, even as demand shifts.

### How scale up works

Our fully in‑house manufacturing strategy enables flexible, scalable solutions that support
customers across the full product lifecycle and global supply strategies. From low‑volume
pre‑clinical builds to clinical supply and high‑volume commercial production, SHL Medical seamlessly
manages changing volume demands, ensuring a smooth, reliable scale‑up at every stage.
[SHL-Medical-FAAM installation-20240924-1]

## Pre-clinical, clinical, and commercial supply

From low‑volume pre‑clinical builds to clinical supply and high‑volume commercial production, SHL
Medical seamlessly manages changing volume demands to ensure a smooth, reliable scale‑up at every
stage. Leveraging our proven platform device portfolio and modular device development strategy, we
support a wide range of production needs with speed and flexibility.

High process and technology integration, decades of prototyping expertise, and a fully streamlined
production strategy enable efficient transitions, predictable performance, and scalable
manufacturing from early development through commercialization.
[tablet img10]

## Tooling

SHL Medical's comprehensive mold manufacturing program is powered by our subsidiary, [SHL
Advantec][164], which guarantees the timely delivery of precise, reliable, and high-performance
plastic injection molds. Investing in the most advanced equipment and technologies, paired with our
proven expertise in design and innovative engineering, we ensure high-quality mold manufacturing and
exceptional mold longevity. We work closely with our customers at the very early stages to fully
understand their requirements and ensure that our molds are designed to the highest possible
standards.

* State-of-the-art mold production equipment and processes
* High-precision, multi-cavity mold development
* Extensive mold design and manufacturing experience

[ Read more about SHL Advantec's tooling solutions ][165]
[Tooling-molding-carving]

## Mold commissioning and production scaling

SHL Medical understands that our customers’ production needs may vary across a product’s lifecycle.
That’s why we offer flexible mold design solutions, individual stack units are identical in varying
cavity configurations, to support our customers’ need for volume-driven demands. Our in-house mold
manufacturing allows us to engineer a wide range of high-performance, multi-cavity molds of up to 96
cavities. Robotic automation supports round-the-clock production, while every manufacturing step is
persistently monitored for dimensional accuracy.

* Integrated tooling program
* High-performance, multi-cavity tools enabling run-to-run consistency
* Vast experience in production scale-up programs

[[.jpg] history-2024-high-cavity-autoinjector-mold-tooling-02-bg-shl-advantec.jpg]

## Automation

SHL Medical is in a unique position among medical device companies, having established our
automation systems at [SHL Advantec][166]. We take pride in being a truly end-to-end solutions
provider with a full range of automated systems to support any scale of product industrialization.

Our automation engineers lend their expertise to develop a full range of manual, semi-, and fully
automatic testing, assembly, and final assembly machines to address every stage of the product
lifecycle.

* Modular platforms for cross-project compatibility
* Equipment commercialized for 40+ self-injection products
* Scalable solutions for production between 1-160PPM
* Container-free testing machines

[ Explore SHL Advantec's automation solutions ][167]
[shl-medical-AMSD-rsa-20240206-6]

## Fully automated assembly and testing equipment

SHL Medical is an industry leader not only in device design and development but also in product
industrialization. Our automation systems sub-group at SHL Advantec develops advanced testing and
sophisticated assembly and final assembly machines, allowing us to offer fully automated solutions
for rigorous testing and production needs. Designed from the ground up to facilitate modularization,
these modular assembly and testing machines feature customizable stations and interchangeable
fixtures supporting complex and high-volume production with shortened lead times.

* Modularized, fully automatic testing and assembly machines
* Self-developed software and integrated robotic systems
* Comprehensive servicing and maintenance support

[[.jpg] engineer-testing-autoinjector-automation-fatm-01-machine-expert-shl-advantec]

## Test method transfer to customer site

If customers choose to conduct testing at their own site, SHL Medical provides technical support to
ensure accurate test method transfer. We develop and validate test methods at SHL Medical
facilities, then partner closely with customers to transfer them on site. Test Method Transfer (TMT)
is completed through comparative testing and co‑validation to ensure aligned, reliable results.

* Risk mitigation due to the equivalent test method used as SHL Medical (avoiding differences in
test results for same batches)
* Access to strong expertise in TMD and TMV
* Time savings due to exclusive focus on TMT for the customer

# Production

We work closely with customers to deliver tailored assembly solutions that meet diverse production
requirements. Our robust quality management system ensures safety and effectiveness.

## How we produce autoinjectors

Get an inside look at **SHL Medical’s production facilities and in‑house manufacturing
capabilities**, with a spotlight on **injection molding, sub‑assembly, component assembly, and
rigorous quality control and testing**.

[[.jpg] FAAM-AOU MollySE FSA IMG 3690]

## Molding

SHL Medical has significantly invested in a diverse range of injection molding machines featuring
advanced robotic technologies and clamping forces from 40 to 420 tons. With over 320 fully electric
molding machines equipped with in-mold sensors and connected to fully computerized and automated
material handling systems, we ensure consistent, high-quality molded parts to support our integrated
assembly lines.

Our cutting-edge equipment is further enhanced with advanced robotics and automated systems,
delivering precision and efficiency. Additionally, our in-house toolmaking expertise provides
flexible cavitation development to accommodate both new and existing customer projects, ensuring
seamless production and optimized solutions.

* Fully electric machines with multi-cavity systems.
* Multi-component molding
* Automated material handling and collection systems

[Molding_DSC_1293]

## Assembly

SHL Medical works closely with our customers to develop assembly solutions that best suit their
needs. To complement each customer’s clinical or commercial strategy, we provide flexible assembly
services through manual, semi-automatic, and fully-automatic assembly machines designed and
custom-built by our in-house automation experts.

This allows us to effectively meet our customers’ production demands and scalability requirements,
while providing process reliability and control.

* Customized assembly solutions
* Modular manufacturing processes
* Flexible and scalable production
