## Quality control

SHL Medical is dedicated to delivering functionally safe and effective devices that patients can
trust. We uphold a robust quality management system supported by rigorous quality control (QC)
procedures tailored for needle-based injection systems.

Our standardized QC measures ensure the production and release of high-quality device components and
sub-assemblies, adhering to strict compliance standards. These measures operate around the clock,
enabling timely responses and maintaining excellence in device safety and functionality. Our
commitment to quality has earned praise during customer audits, reflecting our unwavering focus on
delivering reliable solutions to our partners and patients.

* Well-established QMS with ISO-standards-based QC testing
* Efficient and rigorous in-process QC and equipment-aided release testing
* 24/7 QC inspections from device components production through to release

# Final assembly, labeling, and packaging

We provide complete assembly, labeling, and packaging services for drug delivery devices. With
facilities in the US (Florida) and an alliance partner in Europe, we offer seamless solutions that
ensure the highest quality standards.

## Leading in final assembly services

Our state-of-the-art facility in Deerfield Beach, Florida, is a leader in final assembly services,
offering equipment qualification, process development, design transfer, and turnkey assembly.
Equipped with advanced labeling, packaging, and serialization capabilities, we deliver end-to-end
solutions tailored to your combination product needs, ensuring precision and efficiency at every
stage.

Customers benefit from SHL Medical's expert technical team and extensive experience, leveraging a
wealth of knowledge in developing, troubleshooting, qualifying, and validating final assembly
processes. With expertise across various equipment types—Manual Assembly Machines (MAM),
Semi-Automated Assembly Machines (SAAM), and Fully Automated Assembly Machines (FAAM)—we support a
wide range of autoinjectors, from platform to bespoke devices, utilizing syringes or cartridges.
This comprehensive approach ensures optimized processes and exceptional outcomes.

## How we can help

With extensive expertise in final assembly, labeling, packaging, and regulatory compliance, we offer
comprehensive solutions to streamline production processes, enhance efficiency, and optimize
timelines. Our services are tailored to support clients in achieving their clinical and commercial
goals, ensuring high-quality outcomes and seamless delivery throughout every stage of development
and distribution.

* Quick to Market® services
* Full range of final assembly, labeling, and packaging solutions
* Compliant with regulatory requirements

[SHL Medical Autoinjector labelling]

## Final assembly at customer site

SHL Medical offers technical support to ensure correct design transfer for customers who perform
final assembly of an SHL Medical-designed device at their own site*. Specifically, customers are
supported during the planning phase, including control strategy definition, equipment URS
development, and qualification and validation strategy planning. SHL Medical further provides
support during the execution phase, including risk assessment, qualification, and validation of
pre-requisites, and continued monitoring.

[SHL Medical Devices Final assembly]

## The benefits of on-site assembly

On-site assembly offers a range of significant advantages, allowing you to maintain control over the
production process while benefiting from SHL Medical’s expertise.

### Deep expertise

Benefit from our deep expertise in device and equipment development. Our in-house engineers bring
years of experience, guiding every stage from design to manufacturing to ensure seamless execution
and high-quality outcomes.
[Final Assembly Personel]

### Risk mitigation

Minimize risks with our integrated approach to development and commercialization. By combining
knowledge, design, and tech transfer, we support a smooth transition from concept to market, all
under one roof.

### Faster project kick-off and reduced logistics costs

Accelerate your projects and reduce logistics costs with our partnerships. Collaborating with
leaders like Vetter, SteriPack, and Fuji Diosynth, we offer assembly options across all regions,
ensuring close proximity to syringe filling and distribution sites.
[Primary container PFS Alliance Partnerships]

## Additional technical services

[SHL Pharma_DSC_9531]

### Label and pack design support

We offer expert design support for device label and carton packaging specifications, optimizing
design, size, placement, and equipment compatibility to reduce change parts or new equipment needs,
saving time and cost. Our service includes reviews of additional features like NFC and light
protection, and covers labeling, packaging, or both. Prototyping and trial runs help minimize risks
during qualification and validation.

[Regulatory Support]

### Regulatory support for additional market launches

As an SHL Medical customer, you can count on our regulatory support for additional market launches.
We help develop effective regulatory strategies for delivery devices, preventing costly delays and
mistakes. Our support extends through all stages of product development and throughout the entire
product life cycle.

[Stability Studies at Deerfield Beach]

### Stability studies

We provide stability studies for combination products to support global regulatory filings. Our
studies are conducted in facilities that comply with FDA regulations and ISO standards and support
the manufacture of CE-marked products. All studies follow ICH Q1A(R2) and ICH Q1E guidelines.

We also perform subassembly aging studies per ASTM F1980 and ASTM 3045. Available for autoinjectors,
our services save time by accommodating various configurations and direct storage at our facility in
Deerfield Beach.

# Device support services

We offer a wide range of support services to ensure your device’s success at every stage.

From development to commercialization, our solutions streamline your journey, bringing products to
market faster.

## About our support services

Our device support services and capabilities are integral to the success of every device project. We
integrate quality, regulatory, and supply chain expertise at each stage of the product lifecycle to
meet clinical, commercial, and aftermarket needs.

Our approach to device development fully integrates these essential elements, optimizing timelines
and reducing costs.

By staying ahead of market trends, we deliver sustainable benefits that enhance value across the
entire development process.

[SHL-Medical-Office People Zug Konstantin KK5D8275]

## Project management

Our global team of project and program managers leads every project using agile methodologies to
meet the growing demands of the healthcare industry. We focus on seamless execution and risk
reduction, ensuring that each project runs smoothly from start to finish.

With a proven track record of commercially launched combination products, we streamline
communication and collaboration to keep your project on track.

[SHL-Medical-Office People Zug Konstantin KK5D8200]

## Regulatory affairs and complicance

A medtech company’s regulatory affairs (RA) competency is paramount to its products’ pre- and
post-approval success. SHL Medical’s Regulatory Centers of Excellence (CoE) service model, adopted
at each of our offices worldwide, ensures applicable regulatory intelligence across our global
operations. As the only medical device company that has supported over 50 combination product
launches across various markets, therapy areas, and end user portfolios, our decades of groundwork
on regulatory support for customers is unparalleled.

* Compliance with medical device CGMP
* Global RA support through Regional Regulatory Centers of Excellence service model
* Unparalleled support for over 60 combination products

[Regulatory Support]

## Quality systems

Quality is at the core of our operations. We adhere to the strictest industry standards, including
ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR 820, ensuring that our processes and products meet global compliance
requirements.

From in-process testing to post-market surveillance, our dedicated QA/QC specialists work closely on
each project to deliver the highest level of safety and reliability.

[8 Drug E Quality-System]

## Alliances

To further strengthen capabilities in vertically integrated solutions, we are building a partnership
ecosystem.

We believe that maximizing value for our customers requires connections within the drug delivery
ecosystem, so that we can provide expert advice, recommendations, and options for our customers
along the value chain.

That’s why we have initiated the Alliance Management program to build strong partnerships along the
pharma and drug delivery value chain. Our partners include primary container providers, CMOs/CDMOs,
and other service providers and suppliers.

[ Learn more about our alliance partnerships ][163]
[[.jpg] SHL-Medical-Office People Zug Konstantin KK5D7432]

## IP support

Intellectual property (IP) is an intrinsic concern when developing any product with a customer. We
offer customers a range of product options, designs, and configurations backed by SHL’s extensive
intellectual property experience, portfolios, and know how. The composite of these provides our
customers the opportunity to best maximize their combination product portfolios while relying on
SHL’s broad intellectual property capital to ensure that they are protected in the market.

* IP FTO built into customer product development
* Flexible approach to IP management and protection
* Customized IP solutions for every project

[IP Support-low res]

## Data support

We are advancing data support services to drive smarter decision-making for our partners. Our team
of data engineers and scientists is building a robust infrastructure for data-sharing and analytics.

We aim to offer solutions that range from one-way data insights to real-time and predictive
analysis, customized to meet your specific needs and business goals.

[Data Support]

# Alliance partnerships

Fostering collaboration across the pharmaceutical and drug delivery value chain

## Creating value through collaboration

To strengthen our capabilities for fully vertically integrated solutions, we actively build a strong
partnership ecosystem across the drug-delivery value chain. We believe that maximizing value for our
customers requires close connections within the broader drug delivery ecosystem, enabling us to
provide informed advice, clear recommendations, and flexible options at every stage. That’s why we
established our Alliance Management program, bringing together trusted partners such as primary
container providers, CMOs/CDMOs, and specialized service providers to deliver integrated, end‑to‑end
solutions for our customers.
[20241029 PDA Aseptic Korea 2024 shl-medical conversation-markus-bauss-2]

## Customer benefits and partnership categories

Through our partnership network, you gain access to enhanced services and support along the entire
device value chain, ensuring smoother processes and better results for your projects.

Primary packaging
* Providing joint expertise and guidance on device-container compatibility
* De-risking selection of primary container by conducting pre-verification assessment of various
containers variants
* Driving innovation and setting standards for new container formats
CDMO and CMO
* Supporting partner C(D)MOs across the globe in establishing final assembly service and
pre-validating their final assembly equipment for SHL platform devices
* Introducing fill-finish services for new container formats to ensure speed-to-market for novel SHL
devices

## SHL Medical and SHL Advantec: The strategic connection

SHL Advantec is an outgrowth of SHL Medical’s global manufacturing leadership, extending its legacy
beyond medical device production into advanced industrial solutions.

SHL Advantec brings best-in-class tooling, automation, and advanced manufacturing system integration
to sectors requiring precision manufacturing at scale.

[ About SHL Advantec ][164]

## What SHL Advantec does

From precision tooling to advanced automation systems, SHL Advantec supports manufacturing programs
from build to industrialization.

[ Explore solutions ][165]
[[.tif] Tooling-molding-carving]

### Tooling

High-precision tooling and mold-making capabilities built for process stability and
manufacturability. From development and optimization to commissioning, we enable smooth ramp-up and
consistent output in both low- and high-volume manufacturing.

[[.jpg] FAAM-AOU MollySE RSA IMG 9462]

### Automation

Automated assembly and testing systems engineered to improve throughput, reduce manual variability,
and strengthen quality control. From standalone stations to fully integrated systems, we support
long-term scalability to meet evolving demands.

## Global capabilities and service network

SHL Advantec leverages a worldwide footprint with engineering and service centers across key
regions. This global network ensures responsive support and localized manufacturing excellence
wherever customers operate.

# About us

We are the pioneering leader in self-injection solutions, dedicated to enabling patients’
independence in their healthcare journey.

## Who we are

SHL Medical is the pioneering leader in designing, developing, and manufacturing self-injection
solutions such as autoinjectors, pen injectors, and innovative specialty delivery systems for
large-volume and high-viscosity formulations.

By partnering with leading pharma and biotech companies, we will continue to develop and supply
products and services in order to support, engage, and oversee patients whose quality of life relies
on innovative self-treatment therapies. This we do with one purpose in mind: Enabling patients'
independence.

# Our history

Explore our unparalleled journey, from our genesis in 1989 to rising to our world leading position
in self-injection devices.

## Pushing medical boundaries since 1989

In 1989, Swedish entrepreneur Roger Samuelsson founded SHL Group, now SHL Medical, with a vision to
elevate medical equipment production. By combining Taiwan's manufacturing expertise with Western
management practices, we set the stage for becoming a leading force in the autoinjector market. The
launch of our first autoinjector in 1996 marked the beginning of a lasting legacy of innovation.

Today, with over 60 combination products launched across more than 75 global markets, we continue to
lead the way in drug delivery innovation. Curious to learn how we have transformed healthcare with
our innovative products? Explore our success stories!

## DAI - the gold standard platform that started it all

In 2006, SHL Medical launched one of the world’s first modern autoinjectors, the Disposable
Autoinjector (DAI), developed with a multinational biopharmaceutical company. This button‑activated,
three‑step disposable device for 1.0 mL pre‑filled syringes combined an ergonomic interface, audible
feedback, and automatic needle handling to simplify self‑injection and support consistent, reliable
therapy delivery.

DAI became SHL Medical’s first widely commercialized autoinjector platform and set a new benchmark
for biological self‑injection treatments. Its successful launch demonstrated SHL Medical’s ability
to support partners from development through large‑scale commercialization and laid the foundation
for a growing portfolio of autoinjector solutions.

The launch of DAI marked the beginning of SHL Medical’s proven track record in autoinjectors and
helped establish the company as a trusted, long‑term partner to pharmaceutical and biotechnology
companies worldwide.

# Governance

We are committed to creating an effective governance model that is fully tailored to meet the needs
of our customers. By prioritizing transparency and collaboration, we ensure that every project is
set up for success from start to finish.

## Our entities

SHL Medical, formally known as SHL Medical AG, is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with branches
in Taiwan, Sweden, and the United States.

The company fully owns two subsidiaries:

* SHL Technologies is a contract manufacturer and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) that
supports customers in the medtech and industrial sectors

* SHL Advantec specializes in providing tooling and automation solutions for the healthcare sector
and other industries. Besides the locations in Switzerland and the United States, SHL Advantec
also has offices in China and Mexico.

# About us

We are the pioneering leader in self-injection solutions, dedicated to enabling patients’
independence in their healthcare journey.

## Who we are

SHL Medical is the pioneering leader in designing, developing, and manufacturing self-injection
solutions such as autoinjectors, pen injectors, and innovative specialty delivery systems for
large-volume and high-viscosity formulations.

By partnering with leading pharma and biotech companies, we will continue to develop and supply
products and services in order to support, engage, and oversee patients whose quality of life relies
on innovative self-treatment therapies. This we do with one purpose in mind: Enabling patients'
independence.

### The journey begins

Roger Samuelsson and Martin Jelf establishes Scandinavian Health Limited (SHL Group).

**1996

Launch of first autoinjector

The PenInject 2.25’s success inspires Roger’s vision of SHL as a
world-leading autoinjector solutions provider

### In-house automation and assembly capabilities are established

**2004

Design centers are founded in the US and Sweden

**2007

On-site tooling capabilities are established - now with 48-cavity molds

### Commercial launch of SHL’s first DAI® project

Commercial launch of SHL’s first DAI® project

The DAI becomes one of the most popular autoinjector formats on the market and lays the foundation
for SHL’s success, supporting the modernization of self-injection treatment

### Launch of Molly® autoinjector

The pre-configured Molly supports SHL's pharma partners in minimizing initial investments while
maximizing development speed, later evolving into a modular platform with increased flexibility in
design, development, and production.

### Launch of final assembly, labeling, and packaging services in the US

New facility highlights SHL’s vertically integrated approach to drug delivery services, offering
streamlined operations from product design to final delivery.

### 2,000-employee milestone

SHL sees several years of rapid employee growth, surpassing 2,000 people and signifying its arrival
as a large-scale enterprise.

**2016**

Modularized fully automatic assembly and test equipment is introduced

### Commercial launch of NIT®

Featuring a pre-installed needle, the groundbreaking Needle Isolation Technology radically
simplifies how patients handle cartridge-based
injectors.

**2018-19**

Inauguration of Liufu site in Taiwan
SHL opens new combined building with modern office space with advanced manufacturing capacities

### Inauguration of Liufu site in Taiwan - HQ in Switzerland opens

SHL opens new combined building with modern office space with advanced manufacturing capacities.

Switzerland headquarters is opened.

### First Innovation Zed commercial partnership
* SHL acquires Weibel CDS as part of its expanding portfolio in innovative packaging technology and
delivery systems.

* **First Innovation Zed commercial partnership**

Insulin pen add-on device InsulCheck Connect marks the first commercialization of an SHL add-on
device for any injector, highlighting our ability to expand our portfolio. The device will later
go on to win the 2021 Good Design Award

* **2021/2022**

As part of our global footprint strategy, SHL launched plans for new manufacturing sites in Zug
and USA, respectively. Through closer proximity with customers, the new sites signify our efforts
to lessen global carbon footprint.

### Grand Opening of SHL Medical North Charleston

SHL opens its new fully automatized manufacturing facility in South Carolina, enhancing the
company's US presence and solidifying its leadership in large-scale autoinjector production.

  Publisher deposits a subset of articles from a collection of journals.

# Akums : A Trusted Partner

Akums is India's largest Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), driving
pharmaceutical innovation and excellence in the Indian Pharmaceutical Market (IPM). Since our
inception, we have developed over 4,100 commercialized formulations across 60+ dosage forms,
catering to key therapeutic areas such as cardio-diabetes, neurology, gynecology, nephrology,
anti-infectives, respiratory, analgesics, and multi-vitamins. Our robust R&D capabilities have led
to 220+ innovative formulations, supported by 22+ versatile platform technologies that enhance
product development and differentiation.

With 12 state-of-the-art manufacturing units and four dedicated R&D facilities—two approved by the
Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Government of India—we operate at the forefront of
pharmaceutical manufacturing. Our workforce of 16,000+ personnel ensures seamless operations,
enabling an annual production capacity of 49.21 billion formulation units and 737.38 MT of APIs.

Akums has evolved into a comprehensive solution provider, offering formulation development,
bioequivalence studies, clinical trials, and regulatory support, including securing Drug Controller
General of India (DCGI) approvals for new Fixed Dose Combinations (FDCs) and molecules. Known for
our innovative, technology-driven approach, we develop proprietary formulations tailored to our
clients' brands.

At Akums, we are committed to delivering excellence through innovation, quality, and trust. As a
preferred CDMO partner, we continue to shape the future of healthcare, ensuring safe, effective, and
cutting-edge pharmaceutical solutions for a healthier world.

## Our Mission

To dedicate ourselves for humanity’s quest for longer, healthier and happier lives, through
innovative healthcare products

## Our Vision

To become a globally admired Pharmaceutical Organisation by providing research based, affordable
quality products for larger global population.

[Integrity]

### Integrity

We uphold the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency, honesty, and accountability in all
our business operations. Integrity drives our decision-making, fostering trust with stakeholders,
employees, and partners while reinforcing our commitment to quality, compliance, and excellence in
every aspect of pharmaceutical and healthcare manufacturing.

### Respect

Respect is at the core of our workplace culture, fostering inclusivity, collaboration, and
appreciation. We value diverse perspectives, uphold dignity in interactions, and encourage a
supportive environment where employees, clients, and partners feel valued. This commitment
strengthens relationships and drives success across our operations.

### Safety

Ensuring the safety of our employees, partners, and consumers is our priority. We implement
stringent safety protocols, adhere to global standards, and continuously enhance workplace
conditions. Our proactive approach to risk management guarantees a secure environment, fostering
trust in our excellence.

[values]

### Sustainability

We are committed to sustainable practices that reduce environmental impact and promote well-being.
Through responsible sourcing, eco-friendly manufacturing, and energy-efficient operations, we drive
innovation while preserving resources. Our dedication aligns with global standards, ensuring a
greener future for the pharmaceutical industries.

## What Defines Us

With our commitment to ensure healthier happier lives, there are few integral qualities that add
shape and meaning to our offerings

#### 1

### Driven by Innovation

Making innovation its building block, the company has brought technological revolution in the
production strategies of medicines. The unflinching endeavors of the highly technical and dedicated
staff have brought innovation not only in the existing products, but also in Research and
Development.

#### 2

### Quality First

Prioritizing Quality above all factors, we have ensured to well-developed system and processes to
manufacture quality products that match world-class standards. We strive to provide the best quality
products to meet the standards for our customers, partners, employees and communities.

#### 3

### Diversified Portfolio

We are equipped with 10 state-of-art manufacturing facilities along with ultramodern equipment for
manufacturing formulations, that delivers wide range of dosage forms & quality products. We offer
vast portfolio to serve our partners with advanced solutions and diverse product portfolio.

#### 4

### Research & Development

We are always pushing the boundaries of what is possible and we believe in thinking outside the box.
We are constantly working on new solutions and technologies to improve our products.

### Director's Message

[Mr. Sanjeev Jain and Mr. Sandeep Jain]

###### Respected Partners,

At Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals, our journey has always been guided by commitment to innovation,
quality, and excellence in pharmaceutical manufacturing. From our humble beginnings to becoming
India’s leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), we have remained
dedicated to transforming healthcare with innovative formulations and robust manufacturing
capabilities.

Our vision has always been to empower healthcare brands worldwide with superior, high-quality
products backed by scientific expertise and stringent quality standards. With state-of-the-art
facilities, a passionate workforce, and a relentless focus on research & development, we continue to
set new benchmarks in the pharmaceutical industry.

# Akums : A Trusted Partner

Akums is India's largest Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), driving
pharmaceutical innovation and excellence in the Indian Pharmaceutical Market (IPM). Since our
inception, we have developed over 4,100 commercialized formulations across 60+ dosage forms,
catering to key therapeutic areas such as cardio-diabetes, neurology, gynecology, nephrology,
anti-infectives, respiratory, analgesics, and multi-vitamins. Our robust R&D capabilities have led
to 220+ innovative formulations, supported by 22+ versatile platform technologies that enhance
product development and differentiation.

With 12 state-of-the-art manufacturing units and four dedicated R&D facilities—two approved by the
Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Government of India—we operate at the forefront of
pharmaceutical manufacturing. Our workforce of 16,000+ personnel ensures seamless operations,
enabling an annual production capacity of 49.21 billion formulation units and 737.38 MT of APIs.

Akums has evolved into a comprehensive solution provider, offering formulation development,
bioequivalence studies, clinical trials, and regulatory support, including securing Drug Controller
General of India (DCGI) approvals for new Fixed Dose Combinations (FDCs) and molecules. Known for
our innovative, technology-driven approach, we develop proprietary formulations tailored to our
clients' brands.

At Akums, we are committed to delivering excellence through innovation, quality, and trust. As a
preferred CDMO partner, we continue to shape the future of healthcare, ensuring safe, effective, and
cutting-edge pharmaceutical solutions for a healthier world.

To dedicate ourselves for humanity’s quest for longer, healthier and happier lives, through
innovative healthcare products

quality products for larger global population.

# Akums : A Trusted Partner

Akums is India's largest Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), driving
pharmaceutical innovation and excellence in the Indian Pharmaceutical Market (IPM). Since our
inception, we have developed over 4,100 commercialized formulations across 60+ dosage forms,
catering to key therapeutic areas such as cardio-diabetes, neurology, gynecology, nephrology,
anti-infectives, respiratory, analgesics, and multi-vitamins. Our robust R&D capabilities have led
to 220+ innovative formulations, supported by 22+ versatile platform technologies that enhance
product development and differentiation.

With 12 state-of-the-art manufacturing units and four dedicated R&D facilities—two approved by the
Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Government of India—we operate at the forefront of
pharmaceutical manufacturing. Our workforce of 16,000+ personnel ensures seamless operations,
enabling an annual production capacity of 49.21 billion formulation units and 737.38 MT of APIs.

Akums has evolved into a comprehensive solution provider, offering formulation development,
bioequivalence studies, clinical trials, and regulatory support, including securing Drug Controller
General of India (DCGI) approvals for new Fixed Dose Combinations (FDCs) and molecules. Known for
our innovative, technology-driven approach, we develop proprietary formulations tailored to our
clients' brands.

At Akums, we are committed to delivering excellence through innovation, quality, and trust. As a
preferred CDMO partner, we continue to shape the future of healthcare, ensuring safe, effective, and
cutting-edge pharmaceutical solutions for a healthier world.

About Us
Founded in 1998, Albatross Pharmaceuticals has been committed to delivering high quality, cost
effective healthcare solutions to doctors and patients alike. Headquartered in Navsari, Gujarat,
India, we began our journey with just three products, focusing on dermatology. Over the years, we
have expanded our portfolio significantly and now offer 34 core brands and 26 brand extensions,
totaling 59 products.

Our diverse portfolio includes products like Aclin Face Wash, Clotrimazole Cream I, Biotin With
Vitamin And Mineral Tablet, Biopecia Forte, and much more. We combine innovation, quality, and
affordability to provide solutions that make a meaningful difference in healthcare.

Our mission is to make effective treatments accessible and affordable. By providing larger pack
sizes at economical prices, we enable doctors to prescribe full course therapies, helping patients
complete treatment durations and reducing the risk of drug resistance. This approach reflects our
dedication not only to healthcare professionals but also to the well being of patients.

Albatross Pharmaceuticals operates through third party manufacturing agreements at 11 locations
across India, ensuring consistent quality and timely delivery. While we started with a focus on
dermatology, we have steadily expanded into the multi specialty segment. Today, our products cater
to almost all medical specialties in Gujarat, earning the trust of healthcare providers across the
state.

**Why Choose Us?**

We prioritize quality, affordability, and reliability. With over two decades of experience, we offer
a wide range of trusted healthcare products across dermatology and multiple specialties. Our larger
pack sizes and economical pricing ensure patients can complete their treatment courses, reducing
drug resistance. Manufactured through 11 trusted third party facilities across India, our products
meet stringent quality standards. Backed by consistent supply, innovation, and a patient focused
approach, we empower doctors and patients alike, making us a preferred partner in healthcare
solutions.

**Safe & Convenient Packaging**

We ensure that every product, from Clotrimazole Cream I, Aclin Face Wash, Biopecia Forte, Biotin
With Vitamin And Mineral Tablet, etc., is delivered in secure, hygienic, and user friendly
packaging. Our packaging is designed to preserve product efficacy, maintain hygiene, and provide
ease of use for both doctors and patients. Larger pack sizes and carefully labeled containers make
it easier for patients to complete their full treatment course, while professional grade materials
ensure durability and safety during storage and transportation, reflecting our commitment to quality
at every step.

### WHY ALKEM ACTIVA?

[Info header]
Innovative. Reliable.
Sustainable
Innovative
* Focus on advanced manufacturing technologies with dedicated teams for continuous manufacturing and
biocatalysis
* Green Chemistry has been emphasized at the development stage of API itself
Reliable
* Endeavoring high OTIF levels
* API portfolio selection independent of captive formulation portfolio requirements
* Resilient supply chain with majority of KSM sourced locally or back warded integrated
Sustainable
* Zero liquid discharge in operation across our facilities
* Greater emphasize on ESG initiatives
* Extensive use of renewable energy sources

* Co-founder of Alkem Laboratories

Indian Drug Manufacturers' Association (2007-08)

[leader-2.png]

##### Mr. Sandeep Singh

##### Managing Director
* Managing Director of Alkem Laboratories
* Over 2 decades of experience in the Indian pharmaceutical industry
* Overall responsibility for managing the domestic & international operations of Alkem Laboratories

[leader-4.png]

##### Dr. Vikas Gupta

##### Chief Executive Officer
* CEO of Alkem Laboratories
* Over two decades of experience in the pharmaceutical sector
* Demonstrated capability of leading business transformation across various geographies

[leader-3.png]

##### Mrs. Madhurima Singh

##### Executive Director
* Extensive experience in the fields of legal & compliance, financial management, human resources,
Supply chain management & marketing
* Responsible for managing the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients business of Alkem, among other
responsibilities.

Alroko - About Us

Alroko GmbH & Co KG, Germany, with its subsidiary Alroko Inc. in the US, serves as the sole sales
representative for many major producers of industrial raw materials and machine manufacturers across
the globe. We take pride in being a reliable partner for all our customers. Our sales philosophy is
to supply technically advanced products, always sourced from well-established manufacturing
partners. We focus on offering high-quality industrial raw materials, particularly minerals and
specialty chemicals, for a wide range of industrial applications.

Further, we supply various machines and equipment for producing and testing friction materials - but
also highly specialized, non-standard machines for several other applications.

More than three decades of expertise in the industries we serve and the manufacture of nearly all
products according to ISO standards provide our customers with the supply security they need to
produce exceptional products. Additionally, we are readily available to provide comprehensive
technical support - whenever it is needed.

You may also have a look at the website of our affiliated company Kynol Europa GmbH:
[**www.kynol.de**][20]

# History

1990

Establishment of Kynol Europa Import-Export GmbH by Hasso Schwänke, President, as the exclusive
sales organization for Kynol fibers, textiles made from them as well as Kynol activated carbon
products (all made in Japan) for Europe, Middle East and Africa.

2000

High-tech production and test equipment (for friction materials) added to sales portfolio.

2004

Establishment of Alroko GmbH & Co KG by Hasso Schwänke, President.

2006

Transfer of all non-Kynol business into Alroko GmbH & Co KG.

2008

Establishment of Alroko Inc. as a 100% subsidiary of Alroko GmbH & Co KG in order to underline the
commitment to the North American customer base, improve the service level and increase sales in the
USMCA region; Ralf Raulinat named President of Alroko Inc.

2010

Ralf Raulinat named Vice President of Alroko GmbH & Co KG; Julia Willer named Managing Director of
Kynol Europa GmbH.

2012

Dr. Vijay Subramanian joined Alroko GmbH & Co KG as Representative India, working out
of Kochi, Kerala State.

2014

Kynol Europa Import-Export GmbH renamed to Kynol Europa GmbH, all shares formerly owned by Hasso
Schwänke transferred into Alroko GmbH & Co KG making Kynol Europa GmbH an Alroko GmbH & Co KG
subsidiary.

2018

Alroko successfully launched the new product segment “Nano Powders” as part of its continued growth
strategy and following numerous customers’ requests.

2020

Ralf Raulinat named President of Alroko GmbH & Co KG.

## Abrasive Paints

][21]

Our **Abrasive Paints** are single-layer paints, which can be applied onto the friction material of
brake pads and linings in order to improve the braking performance (out-of-the-box performance)
during the first brake applications.

For environmental reasons, these paints are all water-based.

Typical colors are black, grey, red-brown and green. Application can be done by painting, rolling or
silk-screen printing.

The viscosity can be easily changed to suit any application method. Tailor-made solutions are also
available.

## Activated Carbon Textiles

][22]

Our **Activated Carbon Textiles** are based on **Kynol^{®}** Novoloid precursors. All 100% Kynol^{®}
textiles (e.g. fibers, fabrics, nonwovens) can be activated and different specific surface areas of
up to more than 2,000 m²/g can be achieved depending on the needs of the customer.

For more details, please see the website of our subsidiary in charge of all **Kynol^{®}** products:
[**www.kynol.de**][23].

## Additives for Oils & Greases

][24]

Please take a look at our solid lubricants **Tungsten Disulfide**, **Molybdenum Disulfide** and
**Hexagonal Boron Nitride**.

][25]

Our **Adhesives **are designed for the bonding of friction material to metal backplates. For
environmental reasons, our customers highly appreciate our range of water-based products.

These come in various types, depending on e.g. which curing temperature and time are desired for the
specific product and production cycle. Possible application methods are: Spraying, roller coating or
silk-screen printing. Viscosity can be easily changed to suit the application method.

## Aluminium Hydroxide

][28]

**Aluminium Hydroxide **[Al(OH)3] is mostly used as a flame retardant filler in the wire and cable,
construction and friction industry.

Our grades offer not only technical properties like ultra fine particles, very narrow particle size
distributions and platelet-like morphologies, but also high specific surface areas. Often this
product is also used in clutch facings, due to its very hygroscopic nature.

**Aluminium Hydroxide** does not generate toxic or corrosive gases during thermal decomposition. In
addition, there is a distinct reduction in smoke density and it is free of halogens.

There are also silanized grades available for longer durability of this raw material.

## Aluminium Nitride

][29]

**Aluminium Nitride** (AlN) has a Wurtzite structure. It has a high thermal conductivity and is used
in multiple microelectronics, semiconductors, nano-photonic circuits, piezo-electrical and
thermo-physical applications as well as many others.

Available in micron- and nano- particle size distributions.

## Aluminium Oxide, calcined & fused

][30]

We offer both calcined as well as fused **Aluminium Oxides** (Al2O3).

**Calcined Aluminium Oxides** are among the most commonly used abrasives in the friction materials
industry and come in two varieties, alpha and gamma oxides.

While alpha oxides have a high hardness of 8-9 Mohs they are still not overly aggressive towards the
brake disc unless a high-calcined grade is chosen. In general, the higher the grade of calcination,
the harder and more crystal-like the material.

Gamma oxides on the other hand have a lower hardness of 6-7 Mohs and tend to be less used, mostly
for special applications in NAO type friction-formulations only.

We also carry a variety of special grades with very fine particle sizes that have shown to lower
disc wear while maintaining friction level, such as NO265. This grade is also recommended to solve
metal pick up issues.

**Fused Aluminium Oxides**, sometimes also referred to as corundum, are widely used raw materials in
the abrasives and refractories industry.

Depending on the mix ratio of the base materials, the resulting material is referred to as brown or
white fused alumina because of the respective colour.

Its main properties are a high hardness of typically 9 Mohs as well as abrasiveness and temperature
stability. It is more often used in heavy duty friction applications where a high load friction
coefficient is the major concern.

## Aluminium Titanate

][31]

**Aluminium Titanate** (Al2TiO5) is a technical oxide-ceramics known for its excellent thermal shock
resistance behavior, low thermal conductivity and very low thermal expansion coefficient.

Therefore it is often used for components subject to high thermal stress levels. In addition, the
material possesses good corrosion resistance and very low wettability by non-ferrous melts.

Potential applications can be found in various industries, such as special ceramics, foundry,
automotive (cylinder liners, port liner, friction), low-pressure-casting and the production of light
metals/alloys.

Our standard grades are available in different particle size distributions, e.g. 0-10 μm, 0-20 μm
and 0-60 μm.

## Anti-Corrosion Paints

][32]

Our **Anti-Corrosion Paints** shall be applied for protection against corrosion on the metal
backplate of disc brake pads after the full production process of the pads is finished.

These paints consist of lacquer and hardener, which need to be mixed together just before
application.

A single-layer of paint is sufficient and can be applied by air-mix or pneumatic spraying. The
standard color is black.

## Antimony Trisulfide

][33]

**Antimony Trisulfide** (Sb2S3) is refined from the natural crystalline minerals stibnite and
meta-stibnite. Our **Antimony Trisulfide** standard grades are available with antimony contents
between 65% and 70%.

It is widely used as a lubricant for brake linings, brake pads and clutch facings and improves their
friction stability.

It is also used as a fuel source to increase the sensitivity of pyrotechnic flash powder, in the
production of ruby-colored glass, in plastics as a flame retardant and for the production of
semiconductors.

## Baryte, also precipitated

][34]

**Baryte** is a mineral consisting mainly of barium sulfate (BaSO4).

We offer natural **Barytes** as well as precipitated grades.

The **Baryte** group consists of natural barium sulfate, celestine, anglesite and anhydrite.
**Baryte **itself is generally white or colorless, and is the main source of barium.

We are able to supply high quality **Barytes**. Beside standard qualities we can offer also snow
white precipitated grades with different sieve analyses.

All of our **Barytes **show the following advantages compared to many other **Barytes**:
* a low SiO2 content and
* an extremely low content of heavy metals.

For friction materials "close-cuts" are available, i.e. grades with a reduced content of fines or
specified particle size distributions.

The main application is for drilling purposes and also as heavy filler with a density of approx. 4.5
g/cm³ for paints, lacquers, other coatings and many more products.

Due to its low Mohs hardness (3-3.5) it is giving good lubrication at room temperature.

## Bentonite

][35]

**Bentonite** is a volcanic ash/clay consisting mainly of montmorillonite. Though there are
different types, depending on the dominant element (either Al, Ca, K, or Na) we offer the most
requested sodium (Na) type only.

The main application is drilling mud, but it has multiple uses in different industries and also as
water adsorbent in agriculture. Dry soil, such as deserts or pure sand, can be used for agricultural
crop-growing due to the high water adsorption of the **Bentonite**, which hinders a fast drying-out
of the soil.

Further uses are e.g. in binders, cosmetics, foundry sand, paints, and coatings.

## Bone Ash

][36]

We offer both **DiCalcium Phosphate** as well as **TriCalcium Phosphate**.
* **DiCalcium Phosphate**

**DiCalcium Phosphate** is applied as a food supplement for non-ruminant animals.
* **TriCalcium Phosphate**

This is a natural, white product. For the production of **TriCalcium Phosphate** only fresh bones
approved by the National Inspection Service for Livestock and Meat are used. **TriCalcium
Phosphate** is obtained from crushed, degreased and degelatinized bone chips and calcined at a
temperature of 1,100°C. **TriCalcium Phosphate** is free from organic material, chemically inert and
has been obtained from **Bone Ash** by a special milling and sifting procedure.

**TriCalcium Phosphate** is used in the non-ferrous casting industry to protect the equipment, e.g.
launders for mould coating and as a release agent. In the friction materials industry, it acts as
mild abrasive and functional filler, as well as mild anti-corrosive.

## Boron Nitride, hexagonal

][37]

**Hexagonal Boron Nitride** (hBN) has a very good thermal conductivity, good electric insulation,
and also a good thermal shock resistance. These properties make it suitable for use in ceramic
materials, coming from - for example - a hot pressing process. The material withstands temperatures
of up to 2,000°C in non-oxidizing atmospheres and up to approximately 750°C in oxidizing
atmospheres. **Hexagonal Boron Nitride** is not wetted by most molten metals; this is of advantage
for some refractory materials in casting processes.

Moreover, **Hexagonal Boron Nitride** has a low coefficient of friction, so that it is part of some
lubricant compositions; it is also called “white graphite” because of a similar crystalline
structure.

## Brass Powders & Swarfs

][38]

**Brass** is an alloy made of copper and zinc in various compositions to create different types of
**Brass**. Common compositions offered by Alroko are 57-61% Cu plus 36-40% Zn.

**Brass **has an anisotropic microstructure and consequently exhibits anisotropic mechanical
behavior and increased thermal diffusivity when used in friction materials during the braking.
Surface analyses show that the contact area is very effective at trapping third bodies and
developing secondary plateaus, which provide good conditions for stabilizing friction to a high
degree, even at high temperatures.

**Brass **may include small proportions of a range of other elements. It is used as a high
temperature lubricant and has higher malleability than bronze or zinc. The relatively low melting
point of brass (900°C-940°C), depending on composition and its flow characteristics make it a
relatively easy material to form. By varying the proportions of copper and zinc, the properties of
the **Brass **can be changed, allowing hard and soft brasses. Aluminium makes **Brass **stronger and
more oxidation-resistant. Aluminium also causes a highly beneficial hard layer of aluminium oxide to
be formed on the surface that is thin and self-healing. Alloying e.g. with iron, aluminium, silicon
and manganese make **Brass **more wear resistant.

## Calcium Hydroxide

][29]

**Calcium Hydroxide** is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula Ca(OH)2. It is a colorless
crystal or white powder; when calcium oxide (called lime or quicklime) is slaked with water it
reacts to **Calcium Hydroxide** in an exothermic reaction. It can also be created by mixing an
aqueous solution of calcium chloride and an aqueous solution of sodium hydroxide.

An alternative name for **Calcium Hydroxide** is caustic lime, or **Hydrated Lime**. If heated,
**Calcium Hydroxide** decomposes into calcium oxide and water.

Applications:

Because of its low toxicity and mild basic properties, **Calcium Hydroxide** has various uses, such
as:

As reagent
* in the tanning industry for neutralization of extra acid,
* in the petroleum refining industry for the manufacture of additives to oils,
* in water/sewage treatment as flocculant,
* in the chemical industry for manufacture of calcium stearate,
* in the food industry for processing water (for alcoholic and soft drinks) and
* for clearing a brine of carbonates of calcium and magnesium in the manufacture of salt for food
and pharmacopoeia.

As filler
* in the petrochemical industry for manufacturing solid oil of various types,
* in the production of brake pads,
* in the manufacture of ebonite,
* for preparation of dry mixes for painting and decorating,
* in manufacturing mixes for pesticides, and as
* a dressing in paste form used for anti-microbial effect during a dental root canal procedure.

## Colemanite (Calcium Borate)

][30]

Our **Colemanite **is a hydrous calcium borate with the chemical formula 2CaO 3B2O3 5H2O, belonging
to the group of Boron Minerals. Boron Minerals have many applications.
* Agriculture

In agriculture boron minerals are essential micronutrients for plants, vital to their growth and
development. The role of boron minerals is associated with the cell division and development of the
growth parts of the plants. They are also needed for a good fertilization, seeding and fruit growth.
The use of boron micronutrients in soils with high deficiency can increase productivity around 30%.
* Ceramics

Due to their strong fluxing action boron minerals are essential ingredients in many ceramic glazes
and enamels.
* Glass

Boron minerals are important ingredients in many glass types like glass wool, fiberglass, optical
fiberglass and borosilicate glasses.
* Detergents

Different forms of borates are used for laundry detergents and cleaners as bleaching agent, enzymes
stabilizer, alkaline buffering etc.
* Metallurgical

In the metallurgical industry, borates are used in the production of steel and non-ferrous metals,
alloys, magnets and welding compounds; this is due to their fluxing activity during the smelting
process (dissolving impurities and protecting the metal).
* Rubber and Plastics

In rubber and plastics boron minerals are used as flame retardants and polymer additives.
* Construction Materials

**Colemanite **is applied as a flame retardant e.g. in bituminous cardboard roofings.
In neutron shielding concrete **Colemanite **is an economic aggregate to enhance the shielding
properties.

Beside these main applications there are numerous other uses of boron and boron compounds like wood
preservation, polymerization agent, pharmaceutical and cosmetics.

**Aluminium Hydroxide **[Al(OH)3] is mostly used as a flame retardant filler in the wire and cable,
construction and friction industry.

Our grades offer not only technical properties like ultra fine particles, very narrow particle size
distributions and platelet-like morphologies, but also high specific surface areas. Often this
product is also used in clutch facings, due to its very hygroscopic nature.

**Aluminium Hydroxide** does not generate toxic or corrosive gases during thermal decomposition. In
addition, there is a distinct reduction in smoke density and it is free of halogens.

There are also silanized grades available for longer durability of this raw material.

## Aluminium Oxide, calcined & fused

][25]

We offer both calcined as well as fused **Aluminium Oxides** (Al2O3).

**Calcined Aluminium Oxides** are among the most commonly used abrasives in the friction materials
industry and come in two varieties, alpha and gamma oxides.

While alpha oxides have a high hardness of 8-9 Mohs they are still not overly aggressive towards the
brake disc unless a high-calcined grade is chosen. In general, the higher the grade of calcination,
the harder and more crystal-like the material.

Gamma oxides on the other hand have a lower hardness of 6-7 Mohs and tend to be less used, mostly
for special applications in NAO type friction-formulations only.

We also carry a variety of special grades with very fine particle sizes that have shown to lower
disc wear while maintaining friction level, such as NO265. This grade is also recommended to solve
metal pick up issues.

**Fused Aluminium Oxides**, sometimes also referred to as corundum, are widely used raw materials in
the abrasives and refractories industry.

Depending on the mix ratio of the base materials, the resulting material is referred to as brown or
white fused alumina because of the respective colour.

Its main properties are a high hardness of typically 9 Mohs as well as abrasiveness and temperature
stability. It is more often used in heavy duty friction applications where a high load friction
coefficient is the major concern.

## Aluminium Titanate

][26]

**Aluminium Titanate** (Al2TiO5) is a technical oxide-ceramics known for its excellent thermal shock
resistance behavior, low thermal conductivity and very low thermal expansion coefficient.

Therefore it is often used for components subject to high thermal stress levels. In addition, the
material possesses good corrosion resistance and very low wettability by non-ferrous melts.

Potential applications can be found in various industries, such as special ceramics, foundry,
automotive (cylinder liners, port liner, friction), low-pressure-casting and the production of light
metals/alloys.

Our standard grades are available in different particle size distributions, e.g. 0-10 μm, 0-20 μm
and 0-60 μm.

## Anti-Corrosion Paints

][27]

Our **Anti-Corrosion Paints** shall be applied for protection against corrosion on the metal
backplate of disc brake pads after the full production process of the pads is finished.

These paints consist of lacquer and hardener, which need to be mixed together just before
application.

A single-layer of paint is sufficient and can be applied by air-mix or pneumatic spraying. The
standard color is black.

## Antimony Trisulfide

][28]

**Antimony Trisulfide** (Sb2S3) is refined from the natural crystalline minerals stibnite and
meta-stibnite. Our **Antimony Trisulfide** standard grades are available with antimony contents
between 65% and 70%.

It is widely used as a lubricant for brake linings, brake pads and clutch facings and improves their
friction stability.

It is also used as a fuel source to increase the sensitivity of pyrotechnic flash powder, in the
production of ruby-colored glass, in plastics as a flame retardant and for the production of
semiconductors.

## Baryte, also precipitated

][29]

**Baryte** is a mineral consisting mainly of barium sulfate (BaSO4).

We offer natural **Barytes** as well as precipitated grades.

The **Baryte** group consists of natural barium sulfate, celestine, anglesite and anhydrite.
**Baryte **itself is generally white or colorless, and is the main source of barium.

We are able to supply high quality **Barytes**. Beside standard qualities we can offer also snow
white precipitated grades with different sieve analyses.

All of our **Barytes **show the following advantages compared to many other **Barytes**:
* a low SiO2 content and
* an extremely low content of heavy metals.

For friction materials "close-cuts" are available, i.e. grades with a reduced content of fines or
specified particle size distributions.

The main application is for drilling purposes and also as heavy filler with a density of approx. 4.5
g/cm³ for paints, lacquers, other coatings and many more products.

Due to its low Mohs hardness (3-3.5) it is giving good lubrication at room temperature.

## Bentonite

][30]

**Bentonite** is a volcanic ash/clay consisting mainly of montmorillonite. Though there are
different types, depending on the dominant element (either Al, Ca, K, or Na) we offer the most
requested sodium (Na) type only.

The main application is drilling mud, but it has multiple uses in different industries and also as
water adsorbent in agriculture. Dry soil, such as deserts or pure sand, can be used for agricultural
crop-growing due to the high water adsorption of the **Bentonite**, which hinders a fast drying-out
of the soil.

Further uses are e.g. in binders, cosmetics, foundry sand, paints, and coatings.

## Bone Ash

][31]

We offer both **DiCalcium Phosphate** as well as **TriCalcium Phosphate**.
* **DiCalcium Phosphate**

**DiCalcium Phosphate** is applied as a food supplement for non-ruminant animals.
* **TriCalcium Phosphate**

This is a natural, white product. For the production of **TriCalcium Phosphate** only fresh bones
approved by the National Inspection Service for Livestock and Meat are used. **TriCalcium
Phosphate** is obtained from crushed, degreased and degelatinized bone chips and calcined at a
temperature of 1,100°C. **TriCalcium Phosphate** is free from organic material, chemically inert and
has been obtained from **Bone Ash** by a special milling and sifting procedure.

**TriCalcium Phosphate** is used in the non-ferrous casting industry to protect the equipment, e.g.
launders for mould coating and as a release agent. In the friction materials industry, it acts as
mild abrasive and functional filler, as well as mild anti-corrosive.

## Boron Nitride, hexagonal

][32]

**Hexagonal Boron Nitride** (hBN) has a very good thermal conductivity, good electric insulation,
and also a good thermal shock resistance. These properties make it suitable for use in ceramic
materials, coming from - for example - a hot pressing process. The material withstands temperatures
of up to 2,000°C in non-oxidizing atmospheres and up to approximately 750°C in oxidizing
atmospheres. **Hexagonal Boron Nitride** is not wetted by most molten metals; this is of advantage
for some refractory materials in casting processes.

Moreover, **Hexagonal Boron Nitride** has a low coefficient of friction, so that it is part of some
lubricant compositions; it is also called “white graphite” because of a similar crystalline
structure.

## Brass Powders & Swarfs

][33]

**Brass** is an alloy made of copper and zinc in various compositions to create different types of
**Brass**. Common compositions offered by Alroko are 57-61% Cu plus 36-40% Zn.

**Brass **has an anisotropic microstructure and consequently exhibits anisotropic mechanical
behavior and increased thermal diffusivity when used in friction materials during the braking.
Surface analyses show that the contact area is very effective at trapping third bodies and
developing secondary plateaus, which provide good conditions for stabilizing friction to a high
degree, even at high temperatures.

**Brass **may include small proportions of a range of other elements. It is used as a high
temperature lubricant and has higher malleability than bronze or zinc. The relatively low melting
point of brass (900°C-940°C), depending on composition and its flow characteristics make it a
relatively easy material to form. By varying the proportions of copper and zinc, the properties of
the **Brass **can be changed, allowing hard and soft brasses. Aluminium makes **Brass **stronger and
more oxidation-resistant. Aluminium also causes a highly beneficial hard layer of aluminium oxide to
be formed on the surface that is thin and self-healing. Alloying e.g. with iron, aluminium, silicon
and manganese make **Brass **more wear resistant.

**Brass Powders** offered by Alroko are produced with good control of particle size distribution and
with good batch to batch reproducibility. Irregular **Brass Powders** are produced by water
atomization and available in a range of particle sizes. The main applications for atomized **Brass
Powders** are friction materials, sintered metal parts, fillers, cold casting and cold metal
sprays.

## Bronze Powders & Swarfs

][34]

**Bronze** is an alloy of copper and tin. **Bronze **may include small proportions of a range of
other elements.

A standard alloy contains approx. 89% copper and 9% tin. Special alloys and the respective particle
size distributions are part of the individual specification and are ensured through effective
process and quality control.

Alloying and atomization of copper and tin in air produces irregularly shaped **Bronze Powder**.
Deoxidizing components (e.g. phosphorus) can be added to produce powders with light gloss, e.g.
those needed in filter materials.

**Bronze Powders** are manufactured by pulverizing the alloy into flakes as it is flattened by
impact from falling stamps into a stamp mill. The pulverized powder fragments are then sorted based
on particle size and polished to prepare the final product.

## Cellulose Fibers

][23]

We supply coarse milled, high-quality fibrillated **Cellulose Fibers**, gained from replenishable

They show a high level of thixotropy and improved physical properties in many applications, such as

* absorbents and diluents or
* as a carrier and filler in manifold application fields, e.g. additives for paper/board/tissue

## Cellulose Nano Fibrils, never-dried

][24]

**Cellulose Nano Fibrils, never-dried** **(CNF)** are natural cellulose fibrils with a diameter
below 100 nm. The length of the fibrils can reach several microns which leads to an outstanding
aspect ratio and, in turn, allows for the extraordinary tensile strength of our** CNF**.

We provide **CNF **as an additive for thermoplastics and thermosets to enhance the mechanical
properties and add a barrier effect against various gases.

## Colemanite (Calcium Borate)

][25]

Our **Colemanite **is a hydrous calcium borate with the chemical formula 2CaO 3B2O3 5H2O, belonging
to the group of Boron Minerals. Boron Minerals have many applications.
* Agriculture

In agriculture boron minerals are essential micronutrients for plants, vital to their growth and
development. The role of boron minerals is associated with the cell division and development of the
growth parts of the plants. They are also needed for a good fertilization, seeding and fruit growth.
The use of boron micronutrients in soils with high deficiency can increase productivity around 30%.
* Ceramics

Due to their strong fluxing action boron minerals are essential ingredients in many ceramic glazes
and enamels.
* Glass

Boron minerals are important ingredients in many glass types like glass wool, fiberglass, optical
fiberglass and borosilicate glasses.
* Detergents

Different forms of borates are used for laundry detergents and cleaners as bleaching agent, enzymes
stabilizer, alkaline buffering etc.
* Metallurgical

In the metallurgical industry, borates are used in the production of steel and non-ferrous metals,
alloys, magnets and welding compounds; this is due to their fluxing activity during the smelting
process (dissolving impurities and protecting the metal).
* Rubber and Plastics

In rubber and plastics boron minerals are used as flame retardants and polymer additives.
* Construction Materials

**Colemanite **is applied as a flame retardant e.g. in bituminous cardboard roofings.
In neutron shielding concrete **Colemanite **is an economic aggregate to enhance the shielding
properties.

Beside these main applications there are numerous other uses of boron and boron compounds like wood
preservation, polymerization agent, pharmaceutical and cosmetics.

## Graphite, natural & synthetic

][26]

We offer both **Natural** as well as **Synthetic Graphites**.

**Natural Graphites** are available in flake and needle form. The minimum carbon content can be
fixed anywhere between 75% and 99.5%.

Thermal conductivity: 8-17 W/mK (at 20°C)
Density: 2.1-2.3 g/cm³

Many different particle size distributions are available.

**Synthetic Graphites** are made from new pure electrodes with an extremely low SiO2 level and a
sulfur content of less than 0.05%.
The carbon content can be fixed either at min. 98% or min. 99%.

Thermal conductivity: 40-130 W/mK (at 20°C)
Density: 2.1-2.3 g/cm³

Many different particle size distributions are available, but the most common grades of **Synthetic
Graphite** are:
* Grade A: 100% < 0.5 mm
* Grade B: 100% < 2.0 mm

Both **Natural **as well as **Synthetic Graphites** are mainly used for their lubricity, e.g. in:
friction materials, solid lubricants, carbon brushes, pencils, crucibles, chemical insulation,
electrodes.

## Interlayer Kiln Furniture Papers

][27]

Our **Interlayer** **Kiln Furniture Papers** consist of alumina fibers (97% Al2O3 and 3% SiO2) and
small amounts of natural pulp as binder (less than 5%). We can also offer **Interlayer Kiln
Furniture Papers** with an increased carbon content; in this case 40% of alumina fibers are
substituted by carbon fibers.

**Interlayer** **Kiln Furniture Papers** are used as mould release sheets during the sintering
process of crystalline glasses or metal powders. The mould or the surface is being lined with the
paper. These papers are an alternative to mould release powders and should be considered as an
“ease-of-use” product.

Their higher price is often at least partially compensated by reducing work-intense cleaning times
before and after each sintering process. Furthermore, in case of metal powders, less swirling of
metal dust is observed thus avoiding any damage to vacuum pumps used in the production. In summary,
the key point of this product is a positive effect on production parameters in labor-cost-intensive
countries over time.

## Kaolin

][28]

**Kaolin **is a naturally occurring clay mineral, a sheet silicate, which mainly consists of
kaolinite (Al2Si2O5(OH4)). It is also called china clay. It derives from aluminium silicate
minerals, mainly weathered feldspar, and therefore contains other minerals such as quartz and mica
as well. Depending on the level of these impurities, the character of **Kaolin **changes.

Its appearance is in most deposits white and glossy. The hardness is about 2.5 Mohs and it has a
soft and flexible touch, i.e. it is not abrasive.

More than 50% of the world production is used for the production of paper after muddling (washing
out) a major part of the SiO2.

We offer the mined raw **Kaolin **type with approx. 70-75% SiO2. Its main applications are in many
different industries, e.g. ceramics and as filler in rubber, plastics, paints etc.

In the friction materials industry, **Kaolin **is used as low cost filler in both dry and wet mixes.
Different particle sizes are available.

## Melamine Formaldehyde Resins

][29]

**Melamine Formaldehyde Resin** (MF resin) is usually used as a binder for various applications,
like plywood, thermoset plastic masterbatches, friction materials and others. Depending on the
application, it can increase scratch and chemical resistance, wet strength and melting point.

We supply MF resins in powder form, which increases the shelf-life of the product.

Depending on the grade, a hardener may already be included. Otherwise we offer additional hardeners
for the resins to give customers the possibility to adjust curing times according to their process
speed.

The resin can be dissolved in water, usually in ratios from 1:2 to 2:1.

## Mould Release Agents

][30]

We can offer liquid and dry powder **Mould Release Agents** in highly concentrated qualities.

The liquids are water-soluble, without silicones and can be easily diluted to the desired
concentration before application by brush or spray-gun. The agent forms a thin, very resistant film
after hardening, which prevents the moulding compound to remain in the mould after pressing/curing.
Our **Mould Release Agents** for demoulding of pressed articles, such as brake pads/linings or
clutch facings, work up to approx. 200°C.

For dry **Mould Release Agents** see **Hexagonal Boron Nitride** and also **Bone Ash**, as well as
**Alumina Papers**, which are used as mould release sheets.

## Nitrile Butadiene Rubber (NBR), spray dried

][31]

**NBR (Nitrile Butadiene Rubber)** is a functional filler, which increases the compressibility of
friction materials and gives a “cushioning” effect - especially in truck pads/blocks. This usually
leads to a noise reduction.

Other applications for our **NBR **are oil-resistant hoses, modification of PVC for better oil
resistance, shoe soles and the sealing industry.

We offer fully and partially crosslinked grades, mainly in the particle sizes of 40 mesh (= 425 µm)
and 80 mesh (= 180 µm).

## Phenolic Resins, straight & modified

][32]

**Phenolic Resins **are thermoset resins which are the primary binder used in friction materials
formulations and many other applications. The most common products are straight Phenolic Resins
which are defined and typically vary by gel time, softening temperature, hexamine content, flow and
free phenol, with gel time and flow being the most important characteristics.

Our special modified **Phenolic Resins** are used for providing specific benefits to the matrix of
friction materials that cannot be achieved with a straight resin, such as e.g. a higher temperature
stability.

The most common modifications are NBR, epoxy, CNSL, phosphorus, acrylic, silicone and aralkyl (alkyl
benzene).

## Polyethylene Oxide, also cross-linkable

][33]

**Polyethylene Oxide (PEO)** is a high molecular weight, water-soluble, micro-granular powder
ranging from a molecular weight of 100,000 g/mol to 9,000,000 g/mol. It can be used in a variety of
applications (e.g. water-based adhesives, cosmetics, water-based paints, paper pulps, concrete,
batteries, ceramics, etc.).

Depending on the grade, the transition from dispersing agent to flocculent is fluent. **PEO** also
functions as thickening and lubricating agent and can be generally regarded as processing aid and
may offer additional useful effects depending on the application.

As a novelty, we also offer modified **PEO **with lower crystallization properties or added
functional groups which increase solubility with hydrophobic ingredients (e.g. CNT) or functional
groups which add a cross-linking effect to **PEO**.

# Nano Powders

## Graphene

][21]

**Graphene** is atomically thin layered crystalline carbon. It shows great electrical conductivity,
high surface area, increased adsorption properties and is transparent. Our **Graphene **has max. 5
layers, a high purity above 99% C, and a loose bulk density of 0.01 g/cm³.

**Graphene **can be used as electrode material in batteries for increased capacity, charge-discharge
frequency and longevity. Furthermore, it can be used in transparent electronics such as touch
screens, LCDs or OLEDs and as chemical insulation material.

## Nano Silicon

][22]

**Nano Silicon Powder** (Si) is a semiconductor material with enhanced properties like a high
specific surface area and a high purity (> 98%), and is available in various particle size
distributions.

**Nano Si** has a wide range of applications. It can be incorporated in rechargeable batteries as
the negative electrode material for improved capacity and other properties. It can also be added to
lacquers to fill surface cracks and increase gloss.

## Nano Silicon Carbide

][23]

**Nano Silicon Carbide** (SiC) powder has high hardness and strength, both higher than corundum. In
addition, it shows high chemical stability and high temperature resistance while being a
semiconductor material.

**Nano SiC **powder can be used for creating nano composites that show ideal properties for the use
for electronic and optoelectronic devices, especially with low energy consumption and high
temperature resistance. It is expected to be used as field emitter in electronics.

## Nano Silicon Dioxide

][24]

**Nano Silicon Dioxide** (SiO2) has a very high specific surface area. Depending on the applied
surface treatments it is possible to achieve modifications with hydrophilic or lipophilic
properties.

**Nano SiO2 **is used in the paint, rubber and cement & concrete industry, enhancing suspension
stability, thixotropy, strength, toughness, wear resistance and aging resistance.

## Nano Silicon Nitride

][25]

**Nano Silicon Nitride **(Si3N4) has a very high hardness ranging between corundum and diamond as
well as a high tensile strength not only at room temperature but also at high temperatures.

**Nano Si3N4** can be used for treating surfaces of special devices and tools to gain higher stress
and temperature resistance. Such devices may be cutting tools, turbine blades, rotors and dies.

## Nano Silver

][26]

**Nano Silver **has excellent antibacterial and antibiotic characteristics. It is used in surface
coatings of electronics, carbons or carbon blocks, textiles, metals, woods, ceramics, glass, papers,
plastics resin and many others.

One of the main applications is in hospitals and clean rooms.

## Nano Titanium Carbide

][27]

**Nano Titanium Carbide** (TiC)** **powder shows high hardness and can withstand high temperatures,
with a melting point of above 3,100°C.

**Nano TiC** can be used for producing high quality grinding devices such as grinding pastes or
grinding wheels that show improved grinding efficiency, accuracy as well as surface finish.

## Nano Titanium Dioxide

][28]

**Nano Titanium Dioxide** (TiO2) powders (dispersed) have good transparency and excellent UV light
absorbing capabilities (UV-A and UV-B).

Furthermore, **Nano TiO2** has a good chemical and thermal stability. It is insoluble in water,
organic acid and weak inorganic acid, however is soluble in sulfuric acid, alkali and hydrofluoric
acids.

**Nano TiO2** is mainly used in cosmetics, coatings, printing inks, plastics, food packing material
and generally as a mineral UV-filter.

Available in different particle size distributions, crystal forms (rutile, or anatase, or a mix of
both) and with or without surface treatments (lipophilic, hydrophilic).

## Nano Titanium Nitride

][29]

**Nano Titanium Nitride** (TiN)** **powder is chemically stable and non-toxic, shows good thermal
conductivity and good absorption of infrared rays. The average particle size is 20 nm and the purity
is higher than 97%.

**Nano TiN** is being used for the production of high quality PET-resin for PET-bottles. Such
bottles show increased durability, reduced color change due to ageing and the contained liquids
remain fresh longer because of the IR absorption.

## Nano Tungsten Disulfide

][30]

**Nano Tungsten Disulfide** (WS2) can be used for solid lubricant materials; not only for general
lubrication, but it can also be used in work environments of high temperature, high pressure, high
vacuum, high load, with radiation and/or corrosive media.

This extremely fine powder (<100 nm) has a purity of min. 99%. It can also be added to speciality
oils in order to improve their lubricity.

## Nano Zinc Oxide

][31]

**Nano Zinc Oxide** (ZnO)** **is a white powder with peculiar properties such as screening
ultra-violet rays, absorbing infra-red rays, sterilization and health protection, lowering
temperature or heat insulation.

Commonly used in the rubber industry, **Nano Zinc Oxide** can improve tear resistance, the
comprehensive mechanical property and the life span of rubber.

It is also used as an additive in numerous materials and products including different rubber
qualities, plastics, ceramics, glass, cement, lubricants, paints, ointments, adhesives, sealants,
pigments, foods, batteries, ferrites, fire retardants and first-aid tapes.

## Nano Zirconium Carbide

][32]

**Nano Zirconium Carbide** (ZrC)** **powder possesses abilities like oxidation resistance at high
temperatures, high tensile strength, high hardness and good thermal conductivity.

**Nano ZrC** can be used in cemented carbides to produce cutting tools with improved heat transfer
and increased wear resistance as well as good surface finish.

## Nano Zirconium Dioxide

][33]

**Nano Zirconium Dioxide **(ZrO2), also called **Nano Zirconia**, is a very stable nano metal oxide.
Other properties are: Acid & alkali resistance, corrosion resistance and high-temperature
resistance.

**Nano Zirconia** is mainly used in technical ceramics, pigments, abrasive materials, jewel
materials, in batteries as well as capacitors.

Available in different particle size distributions as well as purities, and also as compound
stabilized with yttria.

## Rare Earth Powders

][34]

**Rare Earth Powders** include a set of seventeen chemical elements, specifically the fifteen
lanthanides, as well as scandium and yttrium.

Various powders in different particle size distributions are available.

## Silica, amorphous

][35]

Our **Amorphous Silica** (also Fumed Silica) is available as micro scaled and as nano scaled
material. It is for example used for strengthening concretes, or as a filler in plastics or in
insulation panels.

## Silicon Carbide

][36]

**Silicon Carbide** (SiC), also known as carborundum, is a semiconductor containing silicon and
carbon. Grains of **Silicon Carbide** can be bonded together by sintering to form very hard ceramics
that are widely used in applications requiring high endurance, such as brake pads or clutch facings,
as well as ceramic plates.

**Silicon Carbide **is a popular abrasive in modern lapidary due to the durability and low cost of
the material. In manufacturing it is used for its hardness in abrasive machining processes such as
grinding, honing, water-jet cutting and sandblasting. It is also used for high performance "ceramic"
brake discs, as it is able to withstand extreme temperatures.

We can supply green and black **Silicon Carbide**.

## Tungsten Disulfide

][37]

**Tungsten Disulfide** is a high performance solid lubricant with superior chemical and physical
properties; it is one of the most lubricious materials known in science.

Additionally, **Tungsten Disulfide** is very stable at high temperatures and under high pressure; it
offers temperature resistance from approx. -270°C to 650°C in normal atmosphere and from approx.
-188°C to 1,316°C in vacuum. **Tungsten Disulfide** is an additive in various high performance
lubricants such as greases, oils or lubricant varnishes. It is also used in high performance
friction materials.

We can supply **Tungsten Disulfide** grades with different particle size distributions including
nano.
