## Our Injectable Products

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][54] or via WhatsApp at [+91 932 797 4224][55].

### About Us

Farbe Firma Pvt Ltd is a WHO-GMP certified sterile injectable manufacturer offering CDMO, contract
manufacturing, and global pharmaceutical supply solutions.

Our ultra-modern manufacturing facility is specifically designed for external preparation dosage forms as well as repackaging of pharmaceutical formulation and adheres to the latest international regulatory standards, including those of countries like Kenya, Cambodia, etc. We have actively expanded our global footprint by applying for registrations in multiple international markets.

At Forever Lifescience, our success is driven by a steadfast commitment to creativity, continuous improvement, and an uncompromising approach to quality. We believe that excellence in healthcare begins with integrity in manufacturing.

International-Grade Compliance

Our WHO-GMP certification stands as a mark of global trust and quality. It assures our partners and customers that every product is manufactured under strict international guidelines—delivering Safety, Identity, Strength, Purity, and Quality in every batch.

Adheres to World Health Organization's Good Manufacturing Practices (WHO-GMP).

Ensures Safety, Identity, Strength, Purity, and Quality through validated systems and hygiene protocols.

Recognized globally for pharmaceutical manufacturing reliability and regulatory excellence.

Specialized in Skincare

At Forever Lifescience, skincare isn't a product category — it’s our core. Our manufacturing is completely aligned with dermatological needs, enabling us to create advanced, science-backed formulations tailored for skin health, beauty, and wellness.

Dedicated exclusively to external preparations and dermatology-focused formulations.

Expertise in developing medicated creams, ointment, gels, shampoo, lotion and skin treatment solutions.

We deliver high-grade quality paired with consumer-oriented skincare innovation, ensuring our products are both scientifically effective and tailored for everyday use.

Globally Approved, Globally Trusted

We don’t just manufacture—we navigate the complex global regulatory landscape with ease. Our seasoned compliance team ensures your products meet the standards of health authorities around the world, accelerating your path to market.

Proven track record with successful product registrations in multiple international markets.

Experienced team ensures fast, compliant market access for clients.

Skilled in preparing dossiers, managing audits, and supporting global partnerships.

Build Your Own Skincare Brand

We empower businesses to launch and grow their own skincare brands with confidence. From concept to commercialization, our private label services offer flexibility, speed, and high-quality formulations that make your brand stand out.

Comprehensive private label and contract manufacturing services for skincare products.

Customizable formulations, packaging, and branding to match client goals.

Ideal for startups, clinics, and retailers seeking turnkey skincare solutions.

Uncompromised Quality at Every Step

## OUR VISION

Our vision is to drive innovation in formulation science by developing cutting-edge, sustainable
solutions that meet the evolving needs of industries and consumers. We prioritise flexibility in our
approach, ensuring our products and processes are adaptable, environmentally responsible, and
forward-thinking.

Our commitment to innovation and excellence drives us to push the boundaries of formulation science,
delivering unparalleled solutions to meet the evolving needs of our clients.

## OUR SERVICES

Helping Big & Small Brands Innovate Faster.

### FORMULATION DEVELOPMENT

Our formulation development service combines scientific expertise with advanced research to deliver
bespoke, high-performance solutions. Whether you need to optimise an existing formulation or create
an entirely new product, we provide efficient, sustainable results tailored to your specific
requirements. From concept to final product, we ensure every formulation meets regulatory standards
and market demands.

[Chemical.webp]
[Formulation.webp]

### PRODUCT MANUFACTURING

With a reliable supply of premium raw materials, our certified, state-of-the-art facilities
manufacture products and ingredients to the highest standards of quality, safety, and consistency.
We continually invest in cutting-edge technology and expand our production capacity to meet evolving
market demands. Collaborating closely with clients, we tailor production processes to meet exact
specifications, delivering exceptional results every time.

### SAFETY &
### QUALITY ASSURANCE

Our rigorous quality control measures and unwavering commitment to compliance enable us to uphold
the highest industry standards, ensuring the safety and efficacy of the products we help bring to
market. From sourcing raw materials to final production, every step is carefully monitored, ensuring
that we deliver products of exceptional quality that customers can trust.

## WHY CHOOSE US

A Commitment to Innovative Formulation Development

As a leading formulation development and manufacturing company, we are committed to innovation at
every stage of the process. We work closely with trusted, transparent suppliers, ensuring full
traceability and ethical sourcing. Our dedication to sustainability is at the heart of everything we
do, from using eco-friendly ingredients to implementing responsible production practices that
respect nature. With a passion for quality and a forward-thinking approach, we create
high-performance products that not only meet market demands but also contribute to a more
sustainable future.

Why Choose Us

Why Formulation Experts is The Right Choice for You

Proven Expertise

With over 30 years of combined industry knowledge, our team has successfully developed formulas across cosmetics, nutraceuticals, OTC, and pharmaceuticals. This experience ensures your product benefits .

Regulatory Confidence

Navigating global compliance is complex, but we make it simple. From FDA and EU standards to two other regulatory mentions. and other international regulations, our documentation and testing expertise ensures your launch is smooth and fully compliant.

End-to-End Product Development

We don’t just stop at formulation. Our process covers every stage ideation, prototype creation, lab testing, stability checks, and scaling to contract manufacturing. This full-spectrum approach helps you move from concept to shelf faster, without compromising on safety, quality, or innovation. Whether you are a startup or an established brand, our team customizes solutions to fit your unique goals and timelines.

Innovation with Integrity

We design products that balance creativity with responsibility. Whether it’s clean-label cosmetics, natural nutraceuticals, or high-performance OTC solutions, our formulations are future-ready and market-relevant. Every project is handled with strict confidentiality, and your intellectual property always remains yours. With our scalable solutions, you can confidently expand into new markets knowing your products are built to last.

Book Consultation

Working With Us Is Easy

Turning Your Idea into a Market-Ready Product

Discovery & Consultation

We begin by understanding your vision, product goals, and target market. In this phase, we discuss your requirements whether it’s a cosmetic, nutraceutical, OTC, or pharmaceutical product and outline the right formulation pathway for you.

Research & Custom Formulation

Our team develops unique formulations tailored to your product needs. This includes ingredient research, safety assessments, and early prototypes designed to match both market trends and compliance standards.

Testing & Validation

Each formulation undergoes rigorous testing stability studies, lab trials, and quality checks to ensure safety, effectiveness, and regulatory compliance. This reduces risks and prevents costly reformulations later.

Regulatory & Documentation

We prepare and manage all necessary regulatory documentation, ensuring your product meets global standards like FDA, EU, and two other regulatory mentions. This step provides peace of mind and a smoother approval process for local or international launches.

Scale-Up & Launch Support

Once validated, we support scale-up to commercial production with our network of contract manufacturers. Our team also provides post-launch guidance, helping you adapt formulations if needed and maintain compliance as you grow.

We embrace scientific creativity to develop cutting edge formulations that meet evolving market

Every formula we create is designed to perform. We prioritize results driven development backed by

[Dr. Brijesh Patel, PhD]

#### Founder

## Dr. Brijesh Patel, PhD

Dr. Patel brings over 13 years of progressive experience in developing and manufacturing topical
liquid and semi-solid formulations for haircare, skincare, personal care, and OTC products. With 9+
years of hands-on experience, he has successfully led in-house laboratories, managed and mentored
teams of formulation scientists, laboratory technicians, QC/QA, and regulatory personnel. His
extensive experience includes managing CROs, CMOs, private label clients, and testing laboratories,
ensuring successful product manufacturing, batch validation, stability testing, claim
substantiation, clinical testing, preservative efficacy testing, and HRIPT.

Dr. Patel has prepared facilities, established company-wide cGMP and Quality Systems, and obtained
cosmetic manufacturing licenses and ISO certifications. Currently, he leads manufacturing activities
for topical products, overseeing technology transfer, scale up, product specifications, change
control, OOS investigations, batch record preparation, product release for commercialization, raw
material approval, and vendor qualification. He has developed and assisted in launching hundreds of
haircare, skincare, topical dermatological, and OTC products for both company owned brands and
private label clients. Additionally, Dr. Patel has authored over 22 scientific publications in high
impact peer reviewed journals and book chapters, and presented scientific findings at international
conferences. His extensive knowledge of human skin and hair anatomy, advanced drug delivery methods,
ingredient interactions, and clinical evaluation of results using advanced statistics, combined with
his experience working with FDA, local and international regulatory agencies, and certification
bodies, makes him an invaluable asset to our team.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

#### What do Formulation Experts do?

We are a cosmetic product development company offering custom formulation services for skincare,
haircare, personal care, and over-the-counter (OTC) products. From idea to shelf, we help beauty
brands create safe, effective, and innovative formulations tailored to their vision.

#### Who do you work with – startups or big brands?

We work with **startups, indie beauty brands, and established companies** worldwide.
Whether you're launching your first skincare line or scaling a professional haircare range, our team
adapts to your brand's needs with full flexibility.

#### Do you create natural or clean beauty formulations?

Yes, we formulate **natural, organic, and clean beauty products** based on your requirements. We can
help you create vegan, cruelty-free, sulfate-free, and paraben-free formulations that meet consumer
demand and global standards.

#### Can you improve or review an existing formulation?

Absolutely. We offer **formula review and optimization services** to improve ingredient synergy,
enhance performance, extend shelf life, or ensure regulatory compliance.

#### Do you help with manufacturing and scale-up?

Yes, while we don’t manufacture in-house, we provide full **tech transfer support** to help you move
from lab to production. This includes:
* Manufacturer sourcing
* GMP scale-up support
* Batch size optimization
* Transfer documents and regulatory packaging

#### What makes Formulation Experts different from other formulation labs?

With over 14 years of experience and a PhD in pharmaceutical sciences, our founder Dr. Brijesh Patel
leads a team that combines scientific precision with creative product development. We offer:
* Fast turnaround times
* Cost-effective formulation packages
* High-performing, stable, and market-ready products

#### Do you provide documentation for regulatory compliance?

Yes. We deliver all essential technical documentation, including:
* Ingredient lists & formulation sheets
* Stability protocols
* Safety assessments (SDS, COA)
* EU PIF, CPNP, and FDA/OTC regulatory support

#### How long does it take to develop a product?

Timelines depend on product type and testing needs. On average:
* A basic prototype takes 3–5 weeks
* A full product development cycle with testing and documentation takes 6–12 weeks

#### How much does formulation development cost?

Pricing varies by complexity and scope. We offer:
* Fixed-fee packages for startups
* Hourly consulting for formulation reviews
* Custom quotes for end-to-end development projects

#### Is my idea or formula safe with you?

Yes. We take confidentiality seriously. All projects are protected with **Non-Disclosure Agreements
(NDAs)** before we begin any discussion.

#### How do I start a formulation project with you?

Getting started is easy:
1. Fill out our [**Contact Form**][28] on the website
2. Book a [**free consultation call**** **][29]
3. Share your product idea or target formulation

We’ll guide you every step of the way from concept to launch.

#### Do you have a free guide or eBook for beauty startups?

Yes! We’ve created **"The Ultimate Cosmetic Product Launch Checklist"** a free downloadable eBook
designed for skincare, haircare, and derma brand founders.

It covers everything from formulation and compliance to packaging and launch strategy.

👉 [Download the free eBook here][30]

#### Can you help with ingredient sourcing or suggesting trending activities?

Yes! We stay up to date with the latest ingredient innovations and can help you source
**clinical-grade actives**, **natural extracts**,** cosmeceutical ingredients**, and **eco-certified
raw materials** from verified global suppliers.

#### Can you help with label claims and marketing copy?

Yes. Once the formulation is finalized, we can assist in reviewing** INCI names, product claims
(e.g., anti-aging, brightening, hydrating)**, and compliance with marketing regulations in your
target country.

#### What industries or product categories do you not support?

We do not formulate **color cosmetics, vape or CBD products, or regulated pharmaceuticals**, unless
explicitly discussed and legally permitted in your market. We also do not support formulation
cloning or unethical product requests.

#### Can you work with international clients?

Yes! We serve clients across the US, UK, EU, Middle East, and Asia. All communication, formulation,
and documentation can be done **remotely via email, video calls, and secure file sharing**.

#### What happens if my formula needs revisions?

We include a defined number of **revisions or prototype iterations** in every package. We'll work
with you to ensure the final product meets your performance, sensory, and regulatory expectations.

### Custom Product Formulation – Your IP, Engineered for Market Success

### Bespoke. Evidence-Led. Built for Commercial Reality.

Every formula we create is engineered around your brand vision, performance claims, and cost targets
never from templates. Your intellectual property remains fully protected, while your product is
built for scale, stability, and regulatory success.

## What You Get

### A True Custom Formula Package From Concept to CMO Handoff
* Fully bespoke composition built around your target claims, market positioning, and cost of goods.
* Ingredient shortlisting with evidence-based rationale supported by supplier data and scientific
literature.
* Compatibility mapping across actives, thickeners, emulsifiers, and packaging systems.
* Complete formula package including:
* Master Batch Record (MBR)
* Batch records
* SOPs
* QC specifications
* COA templates
* BOM & COGS model

## Topical Focus & Capabilities

### Versatile Systems Across All Core Formulation Types
* Emulsions (O/W, W/O)
* Gels (carbomer, acrylates, natural gums)
* Suspensions
* Anhydrous systems
* Hydroalcoholic systems
* Preservative strategy based on risk profiles: low-pH systems, anhydrous products, high water
activity, botanical-heavy formulas.
* Aesthetic tuning for glide, playtime, and dry-down; pigment dispersion and film-forming where
required.

## Process & Timeline Discipline

### Structured Development with Measurable Progress
* Phase-gated workflow:
Brief → Formula Map → Prototype(s) → Stability → Pilot
* Transparent revision cycles guided by data-driven decisions.
* Rapid iteration windows to maintain development momentum and meet launch timelines.

## Why This Matters

### Your Formula Is Not Just Custom It’s Commercially Engineered.

Our structured, science-driven formulation approach ensures your product is not only innovative, but
also stable, manufacturable, regulatory-ready, and cost-aligned for a successful market launch.

## Our Process

From concept to commercialization, we guide you through every step

#### Concept Development

Collaborate with our experts to define your product’s unique selling points, from texture and
fragrance to performance and packaging.

#### Formulation & Testing

Our scientists create and refine formulations, conducting rigorous stability and safety tests to
ensure quality and efficacy.

#### Regulatory Compliance

We handle all documentation and compliance requirements, ensuring your products meet regional and
global standards.

#### Prototype Creation

Receive testable samples to evaluate and refine, ensuring the final product aligns with your vision.

#### Production & Scale Up

Partner with our trusted manufacturers to produce your cosmetics at scale, maintaining consistency
and quality.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

#### What do Formulation Experts do?

We are a cosmetic product development company offering custom formulation services for skincare,
haircare, personal care, and over-the-counter (OTC) products. From idea to shelf, we help beauty
brands create safe, effective, and innovative formulations tailored to their vision.

#### Who do you work with – startups or big brands?

We work with **startups, indie beauty brands, and established companies** worldwide.
Whether you're launching your first skincare line or scaling a professional haircare range, our team
adapts to your brand's needs with full flexibility.

#### Do you create natural or clean beauty formulations?

Yes, we formulate **natural, organic, and clean beauty products** based on your requirements. We can
help you create vegan, cruelty-free, sulfate-free, and paraben-free formulations that meet consumer
demand and global standards.

#### Can you improve or review an existing formulation?

Absolutely. We offer **formula review and optimization services** to improve ingredient synergy,
enhance performance, extend shelf life, or ensure regulatory compliance.

#### Do you help with manufacturing and scale-up?

Yes, while we don’t manufacture in-house, we provide full **tech transfer support** to help you move
from lab to production. This includes:
* Manufacturer sourcing
* GMP scale-up support
* Batch size optimization
* Transfer documents and regulatory packaging

#### What makes Formulation Experts different from other formulation labs?

With over 14 years of experience and a PhD in pharmaceutical sciences, our founder Dr. Brijesh Patel
leads a team that combines scientific precision with creative product development. We offer:
* Fast turnaround times
* Cost-effective formulation packages
* High-performing, stable, and market-ready products

#### Do you provide documentation for regulatory compliance?

Yes. We deliver all essential technical documentation, including:
* Ingredient lists & formulation sheets
* Stability protocols
* Safety assessments (SDS, COA)
* EU PIF, CPNP, and FDA/OTC regulatory support

#### How long does it take to develop a product?

Timelines depend on product type and testing needs. On average:
* A basic prototype takes 3–5 weeks
* A full product development cycle with testing and documentation takes 6–12 weeks

#### How much does formulation development cost?

Pricing varies by complexity and scope. We offer:
* Fixed-fee packages for startups
* Hourly consulting for formulation reviews
* Custom quotes for end-to-end development projects

#### Is my idea or formula safe with you?

Yes. We take confidentiality seriously. All projects are protected with **Non-Disclosure Agreements
(NDAs)** before we begin any discussion.

#### How do I start a formulation project with you?

Getting started is easy:
1. Fill out our [**Contact Form**][28] on the website
2. Book a [**free consultation call**** **][29]
3. Share your product idea or target formulation

We’ll guide you every step of the way from concept to launch.

#### Do you have a free guide or eBook for beauty startups?

Yes! We’ve created **"The Ultimate Cosmetic Product Launch Checklist"** a free downloadable eBook
designed for skincare, haircare, and derma brand founders.

It covers everything from formulation and compliance to packaging and launch strategy.

👉 [Download the free eBook here][30]

#### Can you help with ingredient sourcing or suggesting trending activities?

Yes! We stay up to date with the latest ingredient innovations and can help you source
**clinical-grade actives**, **natural extracts**,** cosmeceutical ingredients**, and **eco-certified
raw materials** from verified global suppliers.

#### Can you help with label claims and marketing copy?

Yes. Once the formulation is finalized, we can assist in reviewing** INCI names, product claims
(e.g., anti-aging, brightening, hydrating)**, and compliance with marketing regulations in your
target country.

#### What industries or product categories do you not support?

We do not formulate **color cosmetics, vape or CBD products, or regulated pharmaceuticals**, unless
explicitly discussed and legally permitted in your market. We also do not support formulation
cloning or unethical product requests.

#### Can you work with international clients?

Yes! We serve clients across the US, UK, EU, Middle East, and Asia. All communication, formulation,
and documentation can be done **remotely via email, video calls, and secure file sharing**.

#### What happens if my formula needs revisions?

We include a defined number of **revisions or prototype iterations** in every package. We'll work
with you to ensure the final product meets your performance, sensory, and regulatory expectations.

## Our Mission

Our mission is to deliver exceptional formulation development services that transform ideas into
successful, market-ready products. We strive to provide expert guidance, innovative solutions, and
unparalleled support, ensuring our clients’ success through excellence, collaboration, and a
customer focused approach.

[Our Vision]
[target]

## Our Vision

To be the leading global provider of innovative and effective formulation solutions, empowering our
clients to achieve their product development goals with confidence and efficiency.

#### Our Values

## We are driven by values

[Innovation]

### Innovation

We embrace scientific creativity to develop cutting edge formulations that meet evolving market
needs. Our approach combines advanced technologies with practical solutions to deliver meaningful
product differentiation.

[Efficacy]

### Efficacy

Every formula we create is designed to perform. We prioritize results driven development backed by
scientific evidence, functional actives, and consumer relevant testing.

[Quality]

### Quality

We are committed to excellence at every stage from raw material selection to final product ensuring
consistent, high quality outcomes across all products.

[Safety]

### Safety

Product safety is non negotiable. We ensure each formulation is developed with proven ingredients,
rigorous testing protocols, and global safety standards in mind.

[Regulatory Compliance]

### Regulatory Compliance

We navigate complex regulatory landscapes with precision. Our team ensures full compliance with FDA,
EU, and global regulations to protect both your brand and your customers.

[Dr. Brijesh Patel, PhD]

#### Founder

## Dr. Brijesh Patel, PhD

Dr. Patel brings over 13 years of progressive experience in developing and manufacturing topical
liquid and semi-solid formulations for haircare, skincare, personal care, and OTC products. With 9+
years of hands-on experience, he has successfully led in-house laboratories, managed and mentored
teams of formulation scientists, laboratory technicians, QC/QA, and regulatory personnel. His
extensive experience includes managing CROs, CMOs, private label clients, and testing laboratories,
ensuring successful product manufacturing, batch validation, stability testing, claim
substantiation, clinical testing, preservative efficacy testing, and HRIPT.

Dr. Patel has prepared facilities, established company-wide cGMP and Quality Systems, and obtained
cosmetic manufacturing licenses and ISO certifications. Currently, he leads manufacturing activities
for topical products, overseeing technology transfer, scale up, product specifications, change
control, OOS investigations, batch record preparation, product release for commercialization, raw
material approval, and vendor qualification. He has developed and assisted in launching hundreds of
haircare, skincare, topical dermatological, and OTC products for both company owned brands and
private label clients. Additionally, Dr. Patel has authored over 22 scientific publications in high
impact peer reviewed journals and book chapters, and presented scientific findings at international
conferences. His extensive knowledge of human skin and hair anatomy, advanced drug delivery methods,
ingredient interactions, and clinical evaluation of results using advanced statistics, combined with
his experience working with FDA, local and international regulatory agencies, and certification
bodies, makes him an invaluable asset to our team.

#### Why Choose Us

## Why Formulation Experts is The Right Choice for You

[Proven Expertise]

### Proven Expertise

With over 30 years of combined industry knowledge, our team has successfully developed formulas
across cosmetics, nutraceuticals, OTC, and pharmaceuticals. This experience ensures your product
benefits .

[Regulatory Confidence]

### Regulatory Confidence

Navigating global compliance is complex, but we make it simple. From FDA and EU standards to two
other regulatory mentions. and other international regulations, our documentation and testing
expertise ensures your launch is smooth and fully compliant.

[End-to-End Product Development]

### End-to-End Product Development

We don’t just stop at formulation. Our process covers every stage ideation, prototype creation, lab
testing, stability checks, and scaling to contract manufacturing. This full-spectrum approach helps
you move from concept to shelf faster, without compromising on safety, quality, or innovation.
Whether you are a startup or an established brand, our team customizes solutions to fit your unique
goals and timelines.

[Innovation with Integrity Icon]

### Innovation with Integrity

We design products that balance creativity with responsibility. Whether it’s clean-label cosmetics,
natural nutraceuticals, or high-performance OTC solutions, our formulations are future-ready and
market-relevant. Every project is handled with strict confidentiality, and your intellectual
property always remains yours. With our scalable solutions, you can confidently expand into new
markets knowing your products are built to last.

#### Our Global Impact

## Delivering innovative formulations that reach markets worldwide.

At Formulation Experts, our reach goes beyond local markets we collaborate with businesses and
brands across the world. From North America to Europe, Asia, and the Middle East, our innovative
solutions have helped companies launch products that meet diverse consumer needs and strict
regulatory standards.

By combining scientific expertise with cultural awareness and international compliance, we ensure
every product we develop is not only effective but also adaptable to global market demands.

Our impact is measured in successful launches, trusted partnerships, and products that touch
millions of lives worldwide.

What We Provide

GCCPL Pharmaceuticals is a trusted name among pharmaceutical drug manufacturers in India. We specialize in the production and supply of high-quality active pharma ingredients (API), pharmaceutical intermediates, finished dosage forms, and innovative nutraceuticals. With robust pharmaceutical manufacturing capabilities, we cater to domestic and international markets, offering end-to-end solutions, from manufacturing to exporting and distribution, ensuring global compliance and reliability.

Products

G.C Chemie Pharmie, is an innovative Indian pharmaceutical, nutraceutical & functional foods company with a global presence.

Services

Market Research and Development, Concept Selling, Reach & Penetration, Right Infrastructure, Market Intelligence.

Our Story

G.C Chemie Pharmie, is an innovative Indian Pharmaceutical, Health Supplements & Functional Foods company with a global presence.
Founded in the year 1981 by Gautam Shah, GCCPL aims to be one the leading pharma players in the Indian markets. We partner with associates & clients alike to deliver customized solutions that resolve their significant issues and create lasting competitive advantage.
GCCPL is proud to serve the pharmaceutical and food supplement industry for the past 43 years and aim to continue doing so for years to come.

READ MORE

Our Manufacturing Facilities

GCCPL operates state-of-the-art facilities strategically located across India. Our two facilities are state of the art, regulation compliant plants. Our facility in Vapi, Gujarat, manufactures API, Minerals & Peptide while the second facility specializes in Excipients. Each facility adheres to WHO-GMP and other international regulatory standards. With advanced automation, strict quality controls, and scalable production lines, we ensure efficiency in producing APIs, intermediates, and finished dosage forms as leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers known for superior pharmaceutical manufacturing practices.

VIEW DETAILS

Novomix

Excipients are offered via our manufacturing plant, Novo Excipients Pvt Ltd. Readymix film coating material followed by HPMC, PVP series under the brand Novo integrated to Novomix from Indian manufacturing facilities and Novodone/Novocoat from China.

Eagle Chemical Works

Eagle Chemical Works is an API, Minerals & Peptide manufacturing company which was established in 1978 at Vapi, Gujarat. The Company is now poised to grow further by expanding its facilities by creating plants which would be approved by USFDA and EU authorities.

Our Products

GCCPL offers a diverse portfolio of pharmaceutical and healthcare products designed to meet global standards. Our range includes Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Pharmaceutical Intermediates manufactured under strict quality controls. We provide Health Supplements and Functional Foods to support wellness and preventive care. Our advanced Biologics and Vaccines address evolving medical needs and public health priorities. The Finished Dosage Forms segment features tablets, capsules, and injectables for reliable patient outcomes. Additionally, our Branded Formulations are developed for therapeutic effectiveness and affordability in specific markets. With innovation and trust, GCCPL is your reliable partner in pharmaceutical excellence.

Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

High-quality APIs manufactured under stringent quality standards for use in a variety of therapeutic segments globally.

Pharmaceutical Intermediates

Critical building blocks for complex drug synthesis, produced with precision and consistency to support reliable formulations.

Health Supplements & Functional Food

Innovative nutraceuticals formulated to promote wellness, immunity, and preventive healthcare.

Biologics

Advanced biological products, including proteins and antibodies, developed to support cutting-edge medical treatments.

Vaccines

Safe and effective vaccines aimed at addressing key public health needs across multiple regions.

Finished Dosage Forms

A wide array of tablets, capsules, and injectables manufactured to ensure efficacy, stability, and patient compliance.

Branded Formulations

Market-specific finished products designed to combine therapeutic effectiveness with accessibility and affordability.

Why G.C. Chemie Pharmie Ltd.

G.C. Chemie Pharmie Ltd. is a trusted name among active pharma ingredients manufacturers and nutraceutical suppliers in India, known for delivering excellence across the pharmaceutical value chain. With WHO-GMP certified facilities and global quality accreditations, we ensure safe, compliant, and consistent manufacturing standards. Our robust global supply chain enables timely and efficient exports to 30+ countries, reinforcing our reliability as a long-term partner. We drive sustainable growth through continuous innovation, offering flexible and cost-effective manufacturing solutions for APIs, intermediates, FDFs, biologics, and nutraceuticals.

Expertise in global supply chain and export

We ensure seamless delivery and reliable supply to partners across international markets.

Innovation-led, sustainable growth

Our focus on continuous innovation drives long-term, responsible growth.

Cost-effective, scalable manufacturing

We offer flexible production volumes, balancing quality with affordability.

WHO-GMP & international certifications

All our facilities meet rigorous global standards for safety, quality, and compliance.

Wide-ranging product portfolio

Strong R&D and custom manufacturing solutions

Our team develops tailored solutions to meet specific client requirements.

Leadership with deep pharma industry experience

Our experienced leadership ensures reliable, insight-driven partnerships.

Why Partners with us?

At GCCPL Pharmaceuticals, we go beyond manufacturing, we become your strategic growth partners committed to shared success. Our team provides comprehensive regulatory and compliance support, helping you navigate complex global standards with ease. We offer flexible and scalable manufacturing options to meet changing business needs, along with timely delivery and dependable supply chains that ensure continuity. With transparent and ethical business practices, we build trust that lasts. What We Provide

GCCPL Pharmaceuticals is a trusted name among pharmaceutical drug manufacturers in India. We specialize in the production and supply of high-quality active pharma ingredients (API), pharmaceutical intermediates, finished dosage forms, and innovative nutraceuticals. With robust pharmaceutical manufacturing capabilities, we cater to domestic and international markets, offering end-to-end solutions, from manufacturing to exporting and distribution, ensuring global compliance and reliability.

Our Story

G.C Chemie Pharmie, is an innovative Indian Pharmaceutical, Health Supplements & Functional Foods company with a global presence.
Founded in the year 1981 by Gautam Shah, GCCPL aims to be one the leading pharma players in the Indian markets. We partner with associates & clients alike to deliver customized solutions that resolve their significant issues and create lasting competitive advantage.
GCCPL is proud to serve the pharmaceutical and food supplement industry for the past 43 years and aim to continue doing so for years to come.

READ MORE

Our Manufacturing Facilities

GCCPL operates state-of-the-art facilities strategically located across India. Our two facilities are state of the art, regulation compliant plants. Our facility in Vapi, Gujarat, manufactures API, Minerals & Peptide while the second facility specializes in Excipients. Each facility adheres to WHO-GMP and other international regulatory standards. With advanced automation, strict quality controls, and scalable production lines, we ensure efficiency in producing APIs, intermediates, and finished dosage forms as leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers known for superior pharmaceutical manufacturing practices.

VIEW DETAILS

Novomix

Excipients are offered via our manufacturing plant, Novo Excipients Pvt Ltd. Readymix film coating material followed by HPMC, PVP series under the brand Novo integrated to Novomix from Indian manufacturing facilities and Novodone/Novocoat from China.

Eagle Chemical Works

Eagle Chemical Works is an API, Minerals & Peptide manufacturing company which was established in 1978 at Vapi, Gujarat. The Company is now poised to grow further by expanding its facilities by creating plants which would be approved by USFDA and EU authorities.

Our Products

GCCPL offers a diverse portfolio of pharmaceutical and healthcare products designed to meet global standards. Our range includes Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Pharmaceutical Intermediates manufactured under strict quality controls. We provide Health Supplements and Functional Foods to support wellness and preventive care. Our advanced Biologics and Vaccines address evolving medical needs and public health priorities. The Finished Dosage Forms segment features tablets, capsules, and injectables for reliable patient outcomes. Additionally, our Branded Formulations are developed for therapeutic effectiveness and affordability in specific markets. With innovation and trust, GCCPL is your reliable partner in pharmaceutical excellence.

Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

High-quality APIs manufactured under stringent quality standards for use in a variety of therapeutic segments globally.

Pharmaceutical Intermediates

Critical building blocks for complex drug synthesis, produced with precision and consistency to support reliable formulations.

Health Supplements & Functional Food

Innovative nutraceuticals formulated to promote wellness, immunity, and preventive healthcare.

Biologics

Advanced biological products, including proteins and antibodies, developed to support cutting-edge medical treatments.

Vaccines

Safe and effective vaccines aimed at addressing key public health needs across multiple regions.

Finished Dosage Forms

A wide array of tablets, capsules, and injectables manufactured to ensure efficacy, stability, and patient compliance.

Branded Formulations

Market-specific finished products designed to combine therapeutic effectiveness with accessibility and affordability.

Why G.C. Chemie Pharmie Ltd.

G.C. Chemie Pharmie Ltd. is a trusted name among active pharma ingredients manufacturers and nutraceutical suppliers in India, known for delivering excellence across the pharmaceutical value chain. With WHO-GMP certified facilities and global quality accreditations, we ensure safe, compliant, and consistent manufacturing standards. Our robust global supply chain enables timely and efficient exports to 30+ countries, reinforcing our reliability as a long-term partner. We drive sustainable growth through continuous innovation, offering flexible and cost-effective manufacturing solutions for APIs, intermediates, FDFs, biologics, and nutraceuticals.

Expertise in global supply chain and export

We ensure seamless delivery and reliable supply to partners across international markets.

Innovation-led, sustainable growth

Our focus on continuous innovation drives long-term, responsible growth.

Cost-effective, scalable manufacturing

We offer flexible production volumes, balancing quality with affordability.

WHO-GMP & international certifications

All our facilities meet rigorous global standards for safety, quality, and compliance.

Wide-ranging product portfolio

From APIs and intermediates to FDFs, biologics, and nutraceuticals, we serve diverse healthcare needs.

Strong R&D and custom manufacturing solutions

Our team develops tailored solutions to meet specific client requirements.

Leadership with deep pharma industry experience

Our experienced leadership ensures reliable, insight-driven partnerships.

Why Partners with us?

At GCCPL Pharmaceuticals, we go beyond manufacturing, we become your strategic growth partners committed to shared success. Our team provides comprehensive regulatory and compliance support, helping you navigate complex global standards with ease. We offer flexible and scalable manufacturing options to meet changing business needs, along with timely delivery and dependable supply chains that ensure continuity. With transparent and ethical business practices, we build trust that lasts. Our customized product development services are designed to align with your specific market goals, while our focus on long-term partnerships ensures sustainable growth and collaboration. Together, we deliver solutions that drive value and innovation.

**[Home][54]** / Management

## Gautam Shah

Progressive Entrepreneur having 3+ decades of experience in the Life Sciences Space, Gautam has a
futuristic vision of the life Sciences Sector with a focus on changing the dynamic of the market and
its current needs. Gautam has excellent networking with respective FDA’s and Key Stakeholders in the
industry.

Young and enthusiastic entrepreneur with specialization in the discipline of Immunology from Oxford
University, UK, Manitt has hands-on experience in manufacturing and quality control of vaccines with
leading manufacturers of international repute before joining GCCPL. During the course of his present
assignment Manitt’s responsibility includes identification of potential molecules, their development
and marketing.

Young and dynamic, qualified Chemical Engineer and Masters in Business Administration from ISB, an

collaborative team effort, a CAGR rate of 45% is recorded consistently.

## CA Arvind Sanghvi

Mr Arvind Sanghvi is the API Sales & Marketing Head of the Company and has over 20 years of diverse
experience in the field of active pharmaceutical industry. He is an experienced business
front-runner with demonstrated leadership skills. He has successfully served multiple roles in the
Organisation – Sourcing & Procurement, Marketing & Sales, Finance & Legal and Logistics. He has
contributed significantly to Growth and Success of GCCPL.

## Rajesh Sharma

An experienced business leader with demonstrated leadership skills, Mr. Rajesh Sharma has a total of
36 years of experience in Marketing, sales and business operations under his belt. He has managed
multiple businesses with value sales of $154 Mn and team size of 2200 people. With a proven track
record, he is a turnaround leader in the Indian Pharmaceutical Market.

## Hiten Soni

A chemical engineer by profession from UICT, the No.1 institute in India, Mr. Hiten Soni has 5+
years of designed experience in consulting firms of TATA. He is currently in charge of the
Manufacturing facility at Vapi.

## Tarun Bhatnagar

A seasoned professional with a lifetime of experience in the life-sciences sector, Mr. Tarun
Bhatnagar worked with a leading MNC for more than 43+ years. He handled their public policies,

of pharmaceuticals by federal and state Governments. He specializes in IPR related complexities and
has done advanced courses in IPR related laws from ASCI Hyderabad.

## Vishwanath Desai

Possessing a B’Pharma degree and a PGDM in Marketing and Finance, he boasts 27 years of sales and

His diverse skillset encompasses launching vaccines, managing P&L, nurturing business development
and growth, crafting strategic sales and marketing plans, conducting market intelligence, leading

Mr. Venkantasubbaiah Narra is a Head of Regulatory Affairs having almost 18 years of experience in

Fulfilling entire GCCPL and Its subsidiary companies regulatory requirements effectively from last 5

COO – VitaMystic Healthcare – India’s First dedicated preventive healthcare company.

A post graduate in marketing with more than 23 years of all-round experience in healthcare ranging

Suche

Unser Antrieb

Ein besseres Leben für Millionen von Menschen

Mit unseren Produkten helfen wir mit, die Gesundheit von Millionen von Menschen zu schützen und
ermöglichen Betroffenen mehr Lebensqualität. «Innovating for a better life» lautet die Devise, nach
welcher rund 13'000 Gerresheimer Mitarbeitende auf drei Kontinenten täglich entwickeln und mit hoher
industrieller Kompetenz und Schlagkraft produzieren.

Nachhaltigkeit

Nachhaltigkeit auf allen Stufen

Bis 2030 bezieht Gerresheimer Strom nur noch aus erneuerbaren Energiequellen und senkt seine
CO2-Emissionen bis 2030 um 50%. Diese ambitionierten Nachhaltigkeitsziele setzen wir uns, weil wir
der festen Überzeugung sind, dass nur verantwortungsvoll und nachhaltig agierende Unternehmen eine
Zukunft haben.

Benchmark für Qualität

Qualität steht bei Gerresheimer an erster Stelle – als täglich gelebte Philosophie und Verpflichtung
unseren Kunden gegenüber. Unter Einsatz modernster Technologien stellen wir sicher, dass unsere
Produkte höchste Hygiene- und Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen und strengsten gesetzlichen Vorgaben
entsprechen.

Globale Ausrichtung

Global tätig und nah bei den Kunden

Gerresheimer entwickelt und produziert in 39 Produktionsstandorten in Europa, Amerika und Asien. Wir
kennen die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und die Märkte. So finden wir schneller die richtigen Lösungen
und können eine nachhaltige und umweltgerechte Produktion mit hoher Wertschöpfung an den einzelnen
Standorte sicherstellen.

# LEADING API manufacturE

Harman Finochem Limited is a leading India-based Pharmaceutical Company which specializes in the
manufacture and export of more than 45^{+} Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APls) of which 10^{+}
are Essential Drugs as per the WHO Model List.

We deliver top quality products to more than 75^{+} countries across the globe.

# Management Team

Mr. Harpreet Singh Minhas

Director

Dr. Gurpreet Singh Minhas

Director

The founder of Harman Finochem and a dedicated pharma professional since past 30 years. Under his
guidance and support the company has achieved magnificent milestones.

Mr. Manhas earned a Master’s degree in Science.

Mr Minhas has extensive industrial experience in the pharmaceutical industry and personally led
various departments of Harman Finochem. A man with a vision par excellence. He heads HR, Business
Development, Operations and Projects.

Mr. Minhas is a Science graduate with a Master’s degree in Finance.

With a dynamic approach towards Marketing and Product development, he who travels extensively across
the globe, exploring opportunities for innovation and growth. He ably leads the Marketing, Purchase,
Regulatory and R&D teams.

Dr. Minhas holds a Doctorate in Pharmaceutical Chemistry.

Harman Finochem ensures that its customers worldwide are delighted by receiving APl’s which are
safe, efficient and of highest quality. We adhere to principles of cGmp and our team at all levels

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

all_classified.polished_summary: Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited, headquartered in Mumbai, India, is a globally recognized pharmaceutical company specializing in a diverse range of formulations, including tablets, capsules, injectables, and external preparations. With a commitment to quality and innovation, the company operates in over 30 countries and is dedicated to addressing the healthcare needs of patients through continuous research and development. Healthy Life Pharma is certified by WHO, cGMP, and ISO 9001:2000, ensuring high standards in its manufacturing processes.

ICH E6 (R3) Guideline on good clinical practice (GCP)

International Conference on Harmonisation of technical requirements for registration of pharmaceuticals for human use
GOOD CLINICAL PRACTICE (GCP) E6(R3) Step 5
23 January 2025. Date for coming into effect 23 July 2025
ICH E6(R3) introduces innovative provisions designed to apply across various types and settings of clinical trials, ensuring continued relevance in the face of ongoing technological and methodological advancements. This guideline provides a new language to facilitate innovations in clinical trial design, technology, and operational approaches. It encourages a risk-based and proportionate approach to conducting clinical trials, promoting fit-for-purpose solutions. It fosters transparency through clinical trial registration and result reporting and offers additional guidance to enhance the informed consent process.​
The overarching principles and Annex 1, adopted by ICH and CHMP, came into effect on 23 July 2025.
With the public consultation now concluded, the Annex 2 is expected to be finalised later in 2025.

23 January 2025. Date for coming into effect 23 July 2025
ICH E6(R3) introduces innovative provisions designed to apply across various types and settings of clinical trials, ensuring continued relevance in the face of ongoing technological and methodological advancements. This guideline provides a new language to facilitate innovations in clinical trial design, technology, and operational approaches. It encourages a risk-based and proportionate approach to conducting clinical trials, promoting fit-for-purpose solutions. It fosters transparency through clinical trial registration and result reporting and offers additional guidance to enhance the informed consent process.​
The overarching principles and Annex 1, adopted by ICH and CHMP, came into effect on 23 July 2025.
With the public consultation now concluded, the Annex 2 is expected to be finalised later in 2025.

# Advancing world-class nanoscience research

The International Institute for Nanotechnology represents and unites more than $2.7 billion in
nanoscience research, educational programs, and supporting infrastructure.

As the first and largest institute of its kind in the United States, the IIN brings together
exceptional researchers across multiple disciplines to make groundbreaking scientific and
technological advances.

[Learn more about us][33]

Our work

# Transformative research

Nanotechnology has the potential to dramatically improve the lives of people across the world. For
example, researchers at the IIN have developed diagnostic tests that can be used to detect harmful
viruses, bacteria, and genetic mutations, with greater sensitivities and selectivities than ever
before; organic solar cells that achieve incredible efficiencies; smart materials that remove
pollutants from drinking water; and many other astonishing systems enabled by nanotechnology.

From electronics and energy to therapeutics and biomaterials, the future is happening right now in
nanoscience research.

# Extraordinary people

Led by Chad Mirkin, the IIN has a deep talent pool of more than 230 affiliated faculty members from
35 departments across four schools at Northwestern University.

With insights from the forward-thinking business leaders on the IIN’s Executive Council and Steering
Committee, and support from an outstanding group of administrators, this is a unique and fertile
ground for collaboration and discovery.

# Advancing world-class nanoscience research

The International Institute for Nanotechnology represents and unites more than $2.7 billion in
nanoscience research, educational programs, and supporting infrastructure.

As the first and largest institute of its kind in the United States, the IIN brings together
exceptional researchers across multiple disciplines to make groundbreaking scientific and
technological advances.

[Learn more about us][33]

Our work

# Transformative research

Nanotechnology has the potential to dramatically improve the lives of people across the world. For
example, researchers at the IIN have developed diagnostic tests that can be used to detect harmful
viruses, bacteria, and genetic mutations, with greater sensitivities and selectivities than ever
before; organic solar cells that achieve incredible efficiencies; smart materials that remove
pollutants from drinking water; and many other astonishing systems enabled by nanotechnology.

From electronics and energy to therapeutics and biomaterials, the future is happening right now in
nanoscience research.

# Extraordinary people

Led by Chad Mirkin, the IIN has a deep talent pool of more than 230 affiliated faculty members from
35 departments across four schools at Northwestern University.

With insights from the forward-thinking business leaders on the IIN’s Executive Council and Steering
Committee, and support from an outstanding group of administrators, this is a unique and fertile
ground for collaboration and discovery.

# History, Business Model & Mission

# About Integral BioSystems | Biosystems Solutions

## Company Vision and Business Model

### Who We Are

Integral BioSystems is a drug delivery company developing complex dosage forms.

Founded in 2009 and fully operational in 2011, Integral BioSystems is situated in 10,000 square feet
of customized laboratory and office space at 23 Crosby Road, Suite 100A, Bedford, MA 01730. We are a
fully outfitted development and process engineering laboratory with an established [Quality
policy][73]. We have a quality system that can address both R&D and cGLP activities. Thus, we can be
nimble and flexible performing R&D exploratory and early development of dosage forms, as well as
establish a well-documented program for cGLP studies.

### What We Do

Our expertise is in drug delivery, in the development of biocompatible formulations that are
compatible with physiological fluids and tissues.

We have expertise in ophthalmic, oral, sublingual, intranasal, inhalation, otic, rectal, vaginal,
IV/IM and transdermal routes.

Integral BioSystems has a translational medicinal approach to drug development, customizing delivery
systems to accomplish the biologically effective objectives of the therapy.

Delivery systems are customized to achieve sustained release or targeted, tissue-focused delivery or
fast-release/instant delivery, depending upon the desired product attributes. We scale-up our
formulations to process engineering principles to develop process controls. We work with start-ups,
small companies and large pharma, whether it is to manage and develop the program from
“soup-to-nuts”, or take on projects to be an “extended R&D arm” for an established company.

# History, Business Model & Mission

# About Integral BioSystems | Biosystems Solutions

## Company Vision and Business Model

### Who We Are

Integral BioSystems is a drug delivery company developing complex dosage forms.

Founded in 2009 and fully operational in 2011, Integral BioSystems is situated in 10,000 square feet
of customized laboratory and office space at 23 Crosby Road, Suite 100A, Bedford, MA 01730. We are a
fully outfitted development and process engineering laboratory with an established [Quality
policy][73]. We have a quality system that can address both R&D and cGLP activities. Thus, we can be
nimble and flexible performing R&D exploratory and early development of dosage forms, as well as
establish a well-documented program for cGLP studies.

### What We Do

Our expertise is in drug delivery, in the development of biocompatible formulations that are
compatible with physiological fluids and tissues.

We have expertise in ophthalmic, oral, sublingual, intranasal, inhalation, otic, rectal, vaginal,
IV/IM and transdermal routes.

Integral BioSystems has a translational medicinal approach to drug development, customizing delivery
systems to accomplish the biologically effective objectives of the therapy.

Delivery systems are customized to achieve sustained release or targeted, tissue-focused delivery or
fast-release/instant delivery, depending upon the desired product attributes. We scale-up our
formulations to process engineering principles to develop process controls. We work with start-ups,
small companies and large pharma, whether it is to manage and develop the program from
“soup-to-nuts”, or take on projects to be an “extended R&D arm” for an established company.

## Specific Expertise

Integral BioSystems has specific expertise in [ophthalmic drug delivery][74], known as one of a
handful of CROs working in the field. We have worked on both back-of-the-eye and front-of-the-eye
indications.

Additionally, we are experts in [injectables][75], whether these are injections, infusions and
sustained release. We are experts in [microencapsulate][76]– and [nanocrystal-based delivery][77]
systems, taking the API from analytical development, pre-formulation and formulation prototype
development.

## Hybrid Business Model

Integral BioSystems has established our credibility in industry as a top-notch CRO
(fee-for-service). In addition, we have an out-licensing model. We have two proprietary drug
delivery systems that can be evaluated with your API for improved performance (**NanoM™, OcuHeal™**)

[Integral BioSystems Hybrid Business Model]

## Our Mission

Integral BioSystems mission as a **Contract Research Organization** (CRO) is to provide quality,
[high-end R&D and cGLP technical services][78] in specialty formulation development services for a
variety of dosage forms.

In our mission to “**Innovate to Improve**”, we have developed and patented two [proprietary
platform delivery systems][79] that can be applied with various APIs, routes and indications.

We have developed the [OcuHeal™ technology][80], developed for bioavailability enhancement. We have
developed the [NanoM Wafer™ technology][81] to provide sustained release technologies for use in
ophthalmology, urology and other tissue types. These technologies are patented, and are available
for licensing for development with your API.

## Collaborate with us

Whether you are looking to accelerate drug development with a CRO, collaborate with a technology
partner to develop innovative drugs, or license technologies for bioavailability enhancement or
sustained release, Integral BioSystems is here to help you advance your goals. Harness our expertise
for your next breakthrough. Contact us today!

Integral BioSystems has specific expertise in [ophthalmic drug delivery][74], known as one of a
handful of CROs working in the field. We have worked on both back-of-the-eye and front-of-the-eye
indications.

Additionally, we are experts in [injectables][75], whether these are injections, infusions and
sustained release. We are experts in [microencapsulate][76]– and [nanocrystal-based delivery][77]
systems, taking the API from analytical development, pre-formulation and formulation prototype
development.

## Hybrid Business Model

Integral BioSystems has established our credibility in industry as a top-notch CRO
(fee-for-service). In addition, we have an out-licensing model. We have two proprietary drug
delivery systems that can be evaluated with your API for improved performance (**NanoM™, OcuHeal™**)

[Integral BioSystems Hybrid Business Model]

## Our Mission

Integral BioSystems mission as a **Contract Research Organization** (CRO) is to provide quality,
[high-end R&D and cGLP technical services][78] in specialty formulation development services for a
variety of dosage forms.

In our mission to “**Innovate to Improve**”, we have developed and patented two [proprietary
platform delivery systems][79] that can be applied with various APIs, routes and indications.

We have developed the [OcuHeal™ technology][80], developed for bioavailability enhancement. We have
developed the [NanoM Wafer™ technology][81] to provide sustained release technologies for use in
ophthalmology, urology and other tissue types. These technologies are patented, and are available
for licensing for development with your API.

## Collaborate with us

Whether you are looking to accelerate drug development with a CRO, collaborate with a technology
partner to develop innovative drugs, or license technologies for bioavailability enhancement or
sustained release, Integral BioSystems is here to help you advance your goals. Harness our expertise
for your next breakthrough. Contact us today!

## Every project still starts with the same manual work.

[Inven founders]
Niilo, Tommi and Ekku
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

About us

What we’re building

Born from firsthand experience in M&A research, Inven is building the default AI for M&A. Today,
1,000+ investment banks, private equity firms, consultancies, and corporate development teams use
Inven to see the full private market, map sectors across 28M+ companies, and turn investment
questions into defensible outputs.

### 2022

#### Where it began

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, our founders spent days searching for companies, piecing together
ownership and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets across projects.

They knew there had to be a better way. In 2022, they left consulting to build it.

### 2023

#### Seed funding

Inven raised €1.5M in seed funding led by Lifeline Ventures, the VC behind Finnish companies such as
Wolt, Smartly, and Supercell.

At the time, it was the largest round ever raised in Finland by a founding team under 25.

### 2024

#### 7× growth

Inven grew 670% year over year and doubled the team.

The year marked a shift from early traction to global demand, with more M&A teams using Inven to map
markets, find off-market targets, and move from research to decision-ready outputs faster.

### 2025

#### $12.75M Series A

Inven closed a $12.75M Series A led by Ventech and Vendep Capital, with participation from Lifeline
Ventures and Joint Effects.

The same year, Inven was named Finland’s AI Startup of the Year, ranked #10 among Europe’s
fastest-growing early-stage startups by Sifted, and reached 1,000+ customers globally.

### 2026

#### The part where you join in

Inven is scaling globally to become the default AI for M&A.

We’re expanding across North America and key financial hubs, deepening our work with leading
investment banks and private equity firms, and building the infrastructure behind faster, more
defensible M&A research. This is the part where you join in.

# Augusta Advisors identifies 30%+ more high-quality targets with Inven

Augusta Advisors is a Chicago-based M&A advisory firm specializing in buy-side acquisitions for
clients across multiple US verticals. Founded by Cam Bryan after a career in private equity, the
firm uses Inven to identify 30% more high-quality acquisition targets per engagement compared to
other deal-sourcing platforms. By combining Inven’s similar-company search, intent-to-sell signals,
and headcount growth data, Augusta delivers thorough, client-specific target lists that match each
buyer’s unique acquisition criteria.

The challenge

### Identifying all small businesses within specific verticals

Augusta Advisors saw a problem across the M&A industry: target lists heavy on quantity, light on
quality. Founder Cam Bryan, who came to advisory from a career in private equity, wanted to change
that — helping clients find not just a big list of target companies, but the right target companies
for each unique mandate.

With clients spanning multiple buy-side industries across the US, each engagement came with its own
acquisition criteria. Augusta needed software that could cover them all. The team explored various
tools, but several fell short. Platforms relying on conference lists for their data missed most
smaller businesses entirely. Others excelled in narrow industries but couldn’t scale across
verticals.

Bryan realized a modern AI solution might be the answer. Then he found Inven.

"If one company is a fit for that buyer, you’re obviously going to want to find something very
similar to that. I’ve gotten good use out of that particular feature."

Cam Bryan
Managing Partner, Augusta Advisors

The Solution

### Identifying similar companies and their data effortlessly with AI

Several of Inven’s features stood out for Augusta Advisors. The most-used is the ability to search
using example companies — finding similar businesses to a known-good fit.

“If one company is a fit for that buyer, you’re obviously going to want to find something very
similar to that. I’ve gotten good use out of that particular feature.” — Cam Bryan

The intent-to-sell signal adds another layer of filtering, surfacing companies where the owner is
already in or near a sale decision.

“Having that additional context on both the company and the decision-maker is definitely helpful. It
allows you to prioritize which companies make the most sense to reach out to first — based not only
on the company’s characteristics but also on the founder’s current situation.” — Cam Bryan

Bryan also highlights headcount growth tracking and custom company descriptions as features that
round out each search. “Inven just feels very thorough,” he notes.

"Having that additional context on both the company and the decision-maker is definitely helpful. It
allows you to prioritize which companies make the most sense to reach out to first — based not only
on the company’s characteristics but also on the founder’s current situation."

Cam Bryan
Managing Partner, Augusta Advisors

The result

### Over 30% more target companies compared to other software

Where other platforms left gaps in Augusta’s searches, Inven filled them.

“Inven really just checked all the boxes — like, okay, I’m really capturing everything here.” — Cam
Bryan

“Compared to other platforms, Inven has added at least 30% more targets for me. It provides a more
thorough search experience, almost like scrubbing the entire internet.” — Cam Bryan

The result is a sourcing process Bryan describes as “a more fulsome, thorough search” — one that
delivers not just more targets, but the right ones for each client’s mandate.

"Compared to other platforms, Inven has added at least 30% more targets for me. It provides a more
thorough search experience, almost like scrubbing the entire internet."

Cam Bryan
Managing Partner, Augusta Advisors

Crossroads Capital is an M&A advisory in the DC Metro area, focused on GovCon/Defense, IT Services,
and SaaS in the lower middle market. With Inven, work that previously took ten hours now takes two
to three — letting co-founder Richard Phillips spend the saved time on deeper target analysis
instead of search.

The challenge

### Flying blind: The pitfalls of a fragmented process

Phillips had experimented with various deal sourcing tools in the past, but none quite hit the mark.
“To put it simply,” he stated, “– other software solutions just haven’t been effective enough at
intelligent targeting.”

Some tools failed to address their buy-side needs, while others excelled in specific industries but
fell short when deployed in broader sectors. Additionally, many of the software solutions they had
tested weren’t intuitive enough, making it difficult to find what they were looking for and be more
systematic in their approach.

Their process ended up consisting of a mix of different databases, direct communication with
companies, and a lot of internet searches, but it didn’t feel ideal. “We knew we were missing out on
targets and intelligence, it felt like we were flying blind a little bit,” Phillips admitted.

"We knew we were missing out on targets and intelligence, it felt like we were flying blind a little
bit."

Richard Phillips
Senior Partner & Co-Founder, Crossroads Capital

The Solution

### Enhanced target quality: Deeper analysis and better results

Turns out, Inven was the missing piece. When Crossroads Capital discovered Inven, it was
revolutionary for them.

Phillips recalls, “When we saw the interface, I remember thinking that this is great. It’s creative.
Easy to use, easy to understand, easy to navigate. Easy to find what you’re looking for quickly.”

“I absolutely love it. I sing its praises a lot to other folks,” Phillips says. They have found

software’s nuanced understanding of the context and criteria of each search. “It’s a great business
intelligence tool and its ease of use is on top of all those things.”

"When we saw the interface, I remember thinking that this is great. It’s creative. Easy to use, easy
to understand, easy to navigate. Easy to find what you’re looking for quickly."

or three – and we’re able to do a deeper analysis on targets with that saved time.”

For Crossroads Capital, Inven has improved the quality of targets and allowed them to spend their
time more effectively and thoughtfully.

“Of all the tools I’ve used, and I’ve used pretty much all of them – Inven is the easiest to use,

# Desert Horizon Capital sourced 100+ off-market owner conversations through Inven — including three
# signed LOIs

Firm type

Headquarters
United States
3 of 10

LOIs signed via Inven

all from off-market deals

100+

from Inven-built target lists

response rate

with tailoring vs. generic messaging

Desert Horizon Capital is a search fund founded by Craig McNally and Kamran Cheema. Since starting
their acquisition search in 2023, the team has had over 100 owner conversations sourced directly
through Inven — including three that progressed to signed LOIs from proprietary, off-market
outreach. Inven is now Desert Horizon’s main source of proprietary deals, surfacing companies before
they hit the market and owners before they engage a broker.

The challenge

### Building a proprietary deal channel

Desert Horizon built its acquisition strategy on three sourcing channels: personal networks,
brokered deals, and proprietary off-market outreach. The third is where the upside lives — owners
who haven’t yet engaged a broker bring realistic price expectations, no third party pushing for a
higher multiple, and longer runway for trust to build.

It’s also the hardest channel to run systematically. Every search fund operates against a clock, and
off-market sourcing offers no market signal pointing to which owners are quietly considering a sale.

"The same search on Inven surfaced a vast number of companies that Grata missed."

Craig McNally
Co-Founder & Managing Partner, Desert Horizon Capital

The Solution

## Finding off-market companies before they surface

Inven gave Desert Horizon the signals they were missing. Craig and Kamran tested [**Inven against
****Grata**][48], the deal-sourcing software they were already using, with a head-to-head trial.

The result: Inven returned a much wider universe of relevant companies — including the financial
services firm that became Desert Horizon's first strategic partnership, and the off-market business
that became their first LOI sourced through Inven.

"There are a lot of companies that Inven has which other platforms don't. The same search on Inven
surfaced a vast number of companies that software like Grata missed," says Craig McNally, Co-Founder
and Managing Partner at Desert Horizon Capital.

Beyond breadth, the team uses Inven's descriptive search to find companies by describing what they
do in plain English, the intent-to-sell signal to surface owners who are quietly considering a sale,
and the LinkedIn integration to find warm introductions through the team's network. Together these
turn cold outreach into informed, personalized outreach with higher response rates.

"I think what really sets Inven apart is the intent-to-sell feature. That's something many searchers
need, as we look for owners wanting to retire or entrepreneurs looking to move onto their next
venture," says Kamran Cheema, Co-Founder and Managing Partner at Desert Horizon Capital

"List-building and outreach are so much faster with Inven that it’s hard to quantify. Without it,
we’d probably be running mostly a brokered search."

Craig McNally
Co-Founder & Managing Partner, Desert Horizon Capital

The result

## Three LOIs from off-market deals

Two years into Desert Horizon's search, Inven has produced 3 of the firm's 10 signed LOIs — all on
companies that weren't on the market and weren't engaged with brokers. One came from an owner who
had thought about selling but had never spoken to a buyer.

Beyond the LOIs, Inven has surfaced over 100 owner responses to the team's personalized outreach.
The team builds targeted lists in Inven, uses the company data to write non-generic email campaigns,
and runs the LinkedIn integration to find warm intros — lifting response rates from the typical 5%
to closer to 10%.

"Brokered deals come with a broker pushing for the highest possible price. When we're working with
an owner directly, we can build the relationship without that pressure — and that often leads to a
more realistic conversation," says Craig.

"Without a service like Inven, we wouldn’t be finding these companies. Inven completely opens up the
proprietary off-market world for us."

Craig McNally
Co-Founder & Managing Partner, Desert Horizon Capital
